v: श्रुतं ते पूर्वमेतद्धि मया सर्वं सुरैः सह ।
t: śrutaṁ te pūrvametaddhi mayā sarvaṁ suraiḥ saha,

v: शेषं भविष्यं काकुत्स्थ काव्यं रामायणं शृणु ॥२०॥
t: śeṣaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ kākutstha kāvyaṁ rāmāyaṇaṁ śr̥ṇu ॥20॥

v: जगाम त्रिदिवं देवो देवैः सह सबान्धवैः ॥२३॥
t: jagāma tridivaṁ devo devaiḥ saha sabāndhavaiḥ ॥23॥

v: ये च तत्र महात्मान ऋषयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः ।
t: ye ca tatra mahātmāna r̥ṣayo brāhmalaukikāḥ,

v: ततो रामः शुभां वाणीं देवदेवस्य भाषिताम् ॥२५॥
t: tato rāmaḥ śubhāṁ vāṇīṁ devadevasya bhāṣitām ॥25॥

v: तामेव शोचतः सीता सा व्यतीता च शर्वरी ॥२८॥
t: tāmeva śocataḥ sītā sā vyatītā ca śarvarī ॥28॥

v: एवं समाप्य यज्ञं तु विधिवत् स तु राघवः ।
ततो विसृज्य तान् सर्वान् रामो राजीवलोचनः ॥६॥
t: evaṁ samāpya yajñaṁ tu vidhivat sa tu rāghavaḥ,
tato visr̥jya tān sarvān rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ॥6॥

v: हृदि कृत्वा तदा सीतामयोध्यां प्रविवेश ह ।
t: hr̥di kr̥tvā tadā sītāmayodhyāṁ praviveśa ha,

v: न सीतायाः परां भार्यां वव्रे स रघुनन्दनः ।
यज्ञे यज्ञे च पत्न्यर्थं जानकी काञ्चनीभवत् ॥८॥
t: na sītāyāḥ parāṁ bhāryāṁ vavre sa raghunandanaḥ,
yajñe yajñe ca patnyarthaṁ jānakī kāñcanībhavat ॥8॥

v: एवं स कालः सुमहान् राज्यस्थस्य महात्मनः ।
t: evaṁ sa kālaḥ sumahān rājyasthasya mahātmanaḥ,

v: काले वर्षति पर्जन्यः सुभिक्षं विमला दिशः ।
t: kāle varṣati parjanyaḥ subhikṣaṁ vimalā diśaḥ,

v: नाकाले म्रियते कश्चिन्न व्याधिः प्राणिनां तथा ।
नानर्थो विद्यते कश्चिद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥१४॥
t: nākāle mriyate kaścinna vyādhiḥ prāṇināṁ tathā,
nānartho vidyate kaścid rāme rājyaṁ praśāsati ॥14॥

v: अन्वियाय सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च यशस्विनी ।
t: anviyāya sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca yaśasvinī,

v: सर्वाः प्रमुदिताः स्वर्गे राज्ञा दशरथेन च ।
t: sarvāḥ pramuditāḥ svarge rājñā daśarathena ca,

v: तासां रामो महादानं काले काले प्रयच्छति ।
t: tāsāṁ rāmo mahādānaṁ kāle kāle prayacchati,

v: चकार रामो धर्मात्मा पितृन् देवान् विवर्धयन् ॥१९॥
t: cakāra rāmo dharmātmā pitr̥n devān vivardhayan ॥19॥

v: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित् केकयो नृपः ।
t: kasyacit tvatha kālasya yudhājit kekayo nr̥paḥ,

v: श्रुत्वा तु राघवो धीमान् महर्षिं गार्ग्यमागतम् ।
t: śrutvā tu rāghavo dhīmān maharṣiṁ gārgyamāgatam,

v: तथा सम्पूज्य तमृषिं तद् धनं प्रतिगृह्य च ।
पृष्ट्वा प्रतिपदं सर्वं कुशलं मातुलस्य च ॥६॥
t: tathā sampūjya tamr̥ṣiṁ tad dhanaṁ pratigr̥hya ca,
pr̥ṣṭvā pratipadaṁ sarvaṁ kuśalaṁ mātulasya ca ॥6॥

v: तं च रक्षन्ति गन्धर्वाः सायुधा युद्धकोविदाः ॥११॥
t: taṁ ca rakṣanti gandharvāḥ sāyudhā yuddhakovidāḥ ॥11॥

v: शैलूषस्य सुता वीर तिस्रः कोट्यो महाबलाः ।
t: śailūṣasya sutā vīra tisraḥ koṭyo mahābalāḥ,

v: रोचतां ते महाबाहो नाहं त्वामहितं वदे ॥१३॥
t: rocatāṁ te mahābāho nāhaṁ tvāmahitaṁ vade ॥13॥

v: इमौ कुमारौ तं देशं ब्रह्मर्षे विचरिष्यतः ॥१५॥
t: imau kumārau taṁ deśaṁ brahmarṣe vicariṣyataḥ ॥15॥

v: भरतस्यात्मजौ वीरौ तक्षः पुष्कल एव च ।
t: bharatasyātmajau vīrau takṣaḥ puṣkala eva ca,

v: निवेश्य ते पुरवरे आत्मजौ संनिवेश्य च ।
t: niveśya te puravare ātmajau saṁniveśya ca,

v: मांसाशिनश्च ये सत्त्वा रक्षांसि सुमहान्ति च ।
t: māṁsāśinaśca ye sattvā rakṣāṁsi sumahānti ca,

v: श्रुत्वा तु भरतं प्राप्तं गन्धर्वास्ते समागताः ।
t: śrutvā tu bharataṁ prāptaṁ gandharvāste samāgatāḥ,

v: तद् युद्धं तादृशं घोरं न स्मरन्ति दिवौकसः ।
t: tad yuddhaṁ tādr̥śaṁ ghoraṁ na smaranti divaukasaḥ,

v: निवेशनं च देशस्य श्रुत्वा प्रीतोऽस्य राघवः ॥१८॥
t: niveśanaṁ ca deśasya śrutvā prīto’sya rāghavaḥ ॥18॥

v: न राज्ञां यत्र पीडा स्यान्नाश्रमाणां विनाशनम् ।
स देशो दृश्यतां सौम्य नापराध्यामहे यथा ॥४॥
t: na rājñāṁ yatra pīḍā syānnāśramāṇāṁ vināśanam,
sa deśo dr̥śyatāṁ saumya nāparādhyāmahe yathā ॥4॥

v: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह ।
t: tathoktavati rāme tu bharataḥ pratyuvāca ha,

v: तं च कृत्वा वशे देशमङ्गदस्य न्यवेशयत् ॥७॥
t: taṁ ca kr̥tvā vaśe deśamaṅgadasya nyaveśayat ॥7॥

v: ततो रामः परां प्रीतिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तथा ।
t: tato rāmaḥ parāṁ prītiṁ lakṣmaṇo bharatastathā,

v: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य रामे धर्मपरे स्थिते ।
t: kasyacit tvatha kālasya rāme dharmapare sthite,

v: तद् वाक्यं लक्ष्मणोक्तं वै श्रुत्वा राम उवाच ह ।
t: tad vākyaṁ lakṣmaṇoktaṁ vai śrutvā rāma uvāca ha,

v: पृष्टश्च कुशलं तेन रामेण वदतां वरः ।
t: pr̥ṣṭaśca kuśalaṁ tena rāmeṇa vadatāṁ varaḥ,

v: तमुवाच ततो रामः स्वागतं ते महामते ।
t: tamuvāca tato rāmaḥ svāgataṁ te mahāmate,

v: द्वन्द्वे ह्येतत् प्रवक्तव्यं हितं वै यद्यवेक्षसे ॥१२॥
t: dvandve hyetat pravaktavyaṁ hitaṁ vai yadyavekṣase ॥12॥

v: यः शृणोति निरीक्षेद् वा स वध्यो भविता तव ।
t: yaḥ śr̥ṇoti nirīkṣed vā sa vadhyo bhavitā tava,

v: स मे वध्यः खलु भवेद् वाचं द्वन्द्वसमीरितम् ।
ऋषेर्मम च सौमित्रे पश्येद् वा शृणुयाच्च यः ॥१५॥
t: sa me vadhyaḥ khalu bhaved vācaṁ dvandvasamīritam,
r̥ṣermama ca saumitre paśyed vā śr̥ṇuyācca yaḥ ॥15॥

v: ततो निक्षिप्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं द्वारि सङ्ग्रहम् ।
t: tato nikṣipya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṁ dvāri saṅgraham,

v: तत् ते मनीषितं वाक्यं येन वासि समाहितः ।
t: tat te manīṣitaṁ vākyaṁ yena vāsi samāhitaḥ,

v: सङ्क्षिप्य हि पुरा लोकान् मायया स्वयमेव हि ।
t: saṅkṣipya hi purā lokān māyayā svayameva hi,

v: मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ ॥५॥
t: māyayā janayitvā tvaṁ dvau ca sattvau mahābalau ॥5॥

v: प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म मयि सर्वं निवेशितम् ॥७॥
t: prājāpatyaṁ tvayā karma mayi sarvaṁ niveśitam ॥7॥

v: रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान् ॥८॥
t: rakṣāṁ vidhatsva bhūteṣu mama tejaskaro bhavān ॥8॥

v: स त्वं वित्रास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतां वर ।
t: sa tvaṁ vitrāsyamānāsu prajāsu jagatāṁ vara,

v: वस वा वीर भद्रं ते एवमाह पितामहः ॥१४॥
t: vasa vā vīra bhadraṁ te evamāha pitāmahaḥ ॥14॥

v: अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव ।
t: atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava,

v: हृद्गतो ह्यसि सम्प्राप्तो न मे तत्र विचारणा ।
t: hr̥dgato hyasi samprāpto na me tatra vicāraṇā,

v: रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मेऽर्थोऽतिवर्तते ॥२॥
t: rāmaṁ darśaya me śīghraṁ purā me’rtho’tivartate ॥2॥

v: किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन् को ह्यर्थः किं करोम्यहम् ।
व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन् मुहूर्तं परिपाल्यताम् ॥४॥
t: kiṁ kāryaṁ brūhi bhagavan ko hyarthaḥ kiṁ karomyaham,
vyagro hi rāghavo brahman muhūrtaṁ paripālyatām ॥4॥

v: अस्मिन् क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय ।
अस्मिन् क्षणे गां सौमित्रे न निवेदयसे यदि ।
विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा ॥६॥
t: asmin kṣaṇe māṁ saumitre rāmāya prativedaya,
asmin kṣaṇe gāṁ saumitre na nivedayase yadi,
viṣayaṁ tvāṁ puraṁ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṁ tathā ॥6॥

v: भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च सन्ततिः ।
न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं भूयो मन्युं धारयितुं हृदि ॥७॥
t: bharataṁ caiva saumitre yuṣmākaṁ yā ca santatiḥ,
na hi śakṣyāmyahaṁ bhūyo manyuṁ dhārayituṁ hr̥di ॥7॥

v: एकस्य मरणं मेऽस्तु मा भूत् सर्वविनाशनम् ।
t: ekasya maraṇaṁ me’stu mā bhūt sarvavināśanam,

v: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च ।
निःसृत्य त्वरितो राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह ॥१०॥
t: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ kālaṁ visr̥jya ca,
niḥsr̥tya tvarito rājā atreḥ putraṁ dadarśa ha ॥10॥

v: तद् वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुः ।
t: tad vākyaṁ rāghaveṇoktaṁ śrutvā munivaraḥ prabhuḥ,

v: अवाङ् मुखो दीनमना व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ॥१७॥
t: avāṅ mukho dīnamanā vyāhartuṁ na śaśāka ha ॥17॥

v: जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धं प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय ।
t: jahi māṁ saumya visrabdhaṁ pratijñāṁ paripālaya,

v: जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव ॥४॥
t: jahi māṁ nirviśaṅkastvaṁ dharmaṁ vardhaya rāghava ॥4॥

v: अब्रवीच्च तदा वृत्तं तेषां मध्ये स राघवः ।
t: abravīcca tadā vr̥ttaṁ teṣāṁ madhye sa rāghavaḥ,

v: त्यजैनं बलवान् कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृथाः ।
प्रतिज्ञायां हि नष्टायां धर्मो हि विलयं व्रजेत् ॥९॥
t: tyajainaṁ balavān kālo mā pratijñāṁ vr̥thā kr̥thāḥ,
pratijñāyāṁ hi naṣṭāyāṁ dharmo hi vilayaṁ vrajet ॥9॥

v: ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।
सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत् तु न संशयः ॥१०॥
t: tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokyaṁ sacarācaram,
sadevarṣigaṇaṁ sarvaṁ vinaśyet tu na saṁśayaḥ ॥10॥

v: लक्ष्मणेन विना चाद्य जगत् स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह ॥११॥
t: lakṣmaṇena vinā cādya jagat svasthaṁ kuruṣva ha ॥11॥

v: विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद् धर्मविपर्ययः ।
त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनां ह्युभयं समम् ॥१३॥
t: visarjaye tvāṁ saumitre mā bhūd dharmaviparyayaḥ,
tyāgo vadho vā vihitaḥ sādhūnāṁ hyubhayaṁ samam ॥13॥

v: लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितं प्रायात् स्वगृहं न विवेश ह ॥१४॥
t: lakṣmaṇastvaritaṁ prāyāt svagr̥haṁ na viveśa ha ॥14॥

v: निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह ॥१५॥
t: nigr̥hya sarvasrotāṁsi niḥśvāsaṁ na mumoca ha ॥15॥

v: हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म राघवम् ॥१८॥
t: hr̥ṣṭāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve pūjayanti sma rāghavam ॥18॥

v: अयोध्यायाः पतिं वीरं ततो यास्याम्यहं वनम् ॥२॥
t: ayodhyāyāḥ patiṁ vīraṁ tato yāsyāmyahaṁ vanam ॥2॥

v: प्रवेशयत सम्भारान् मा भूत् कालात्ययो यथा ।
t: praveśayata sambhārān mā bhūt kālātyayo yathā,

v: सत्येनाहं शपे राजन् स्वर्गभोगेन चैव हि ।
न कामये यथा राज्यं त्वां विना रघुनन्दन ॥६॥
t: satyenāhaṁ śape rājan svargabhogena caiva hi,
na kāmaye yathā rājyaṁ tvāṁ vinā raghunandana ॥6॥

v: वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणिं प्रकृतीर्गताः ।
ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः ॥१०॥
t: vatsa rāma imāḥ paśya dharaṇiṁ prakr̥tīrgatāḥ,
jñātvaiṣāmīpsitaṁ kāryaṁ mā caiṣāṁ vipriyaṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥10॥

v: पौरेषु यदि ते प्रीतिर्यदि स्नेहो ह्यनुत्तमः ।
t: paureṣu yadi te prītiryadi sneho hyanuttamaḥ,

v: तपोवनं वा दुर्गं वा नदीमम्भोनिधिं तथा ।
वयं ते यदि न त्याज्याः सर्वान्नो नय ईश्वर ॥१४॥
t: tapovanaṁ vā durgaṁ vā nadīmambhonidhiṁ tathā,
vayaṁ te yadi na tyājyāḥ sarvānno naya īśvara ॥14॥

v: एषा नः परमा प्रीतिरेष नः परमो वरः ।
t: eṣā naḥ paramā prītireṣa naḥ paramo varaḥ,

v: स्वे पुरे प्रेषयामास भ्रातरौ तौ कुशीलवौ ॥२०॥
t: sve pure preṣayāmāsa bhrātarau tau kuśīlavau ॥20॥

v: अभिषिच्य ततो वीरौ प्रस्थाप्य स्वपुरे तदा ।
t: abhiṣicya tato vīrau prasthāpya svapure tadā,

v: कुशावतीति नाम्ना सा कृता रामेण धीमता ॥४॥
t: kuśāvatīti nāmnā sā kr̥tā rāmeṇa dhīmatā ॥4॥

v: श्रावस्तीति पुरी रम्या श्राविता च लवस्य ह ।
t: śrāvastīti purī ramyā śrāvitā ca lavasya ha,

v: द्विधा कृत्वा तु तां सेनां माधुरीं पुत्रयोर्द्वयोः ।
धनं च युक्तं कृत्वा वै स्थापयामास पार्थिवः ॥१०॥
t: dvidhā kr̥tvā tu tāṁ senāṁ mādhurīṁ putrayordvayoḥ,
dhanaṁ ca yuktaṁ kr̥tvā vai sthāpayāmāsa pārthivaḥ ॥10॥

v: न चान्यदद्य वक्तव्यमतो वीर न शासनम् ।
t: na cānyadadya vaktavyamato vīra na śāsanam,

v: सुग्रीवं ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः ।
t: sugrīvaṁ te puraskr̥tya sarva eva samāgatāḥ,

v: रामक्षयं विदित्वा ते सर्व एव समागताः ॥१९॥
t: rāmakṣayaṁ viditvā te sarva eva samāgatāḥ ॥19॥

v: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा रामो रमयतां वरः ।
t: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā rāmo ramayatāṁ varaḥ,

v: सखे शृणुष्व सुग्रीव न त्वयाहं विनाकृतः ।
गच्छेयं देवलोकं वा परमं वा पदं महत् ॥२५॥
t: sakhe śr̥ṇuṣva sugrīva na tvayāhaṁ vinākr̥taḥ,
gaccheyaṁ devalokaṁ vā paramaṁ vā padaṁ mahat ॥25॥

v: यावत् प्रजा धरिष्यन्ति तावत् त्वं वै विभीषण ।
t: yāvat prajā dhariṣyanti tāvat tvaṁ vai vibhīṣaṇa,

v: यावच्च मत्कथा लोके तावद् राज्यं तवास्त्विह ॥२८॥
t: yāvacca matkathā loke tāvad rājyaṁ tavāstviha ॥28॥

v: शासितश्च सखित्वेन कार्यं ते मम शासनम् ।
t: śāsitaśca sakhitvena kāryaṁ te mama śāsanam,

v: जीविते कृतबुद्धिस्त्वं मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृथाः ।
t: jīvite kr̥tabuddhistvaṁ mā pratijñāṁ vr̥thā kr̥thāḥ,

v: यावत् तव कथा लोके विचरिष्यति पावनी ॥३५॥
t: yāvat tava kathā loke vicariṣyati pāvanī ॥35॥

v: जाम्बवन्तं तथोक्त्वा तु वृद्धं ब्रह्मसुतं तदा ॥३६॥
t: jāmbavantaṁ tathoktvā tu vr̥ddhaṁ brahmasutaṁ tadā ॥36॥

v: मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव पञ्च जाम्बवता सह ।
t: maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ caiva pañca jāmbavatā saha,

v: उवाच बाढं गच्छध्वं मया सार्धं यथोदितम् ॥३८॥
t: uvāca bāḍhaṁ gacchadhvaṁ mayā sārdhaṁ yathoditam ॥38॥

v: ते च सर्वे महात्मानः साग्निहोत्राः समागताः ।
t: te ca sarve mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samāgatāḥ,

v: न तत्र कश्चिद् दीनो वा व्रीडितो वापि दुःखितः ।
t: na tatra kaścid dīno vā vrīḍito vāpi duḥkhitaḥ,

v: यः प्राप्तः सोऽपि दृष्ट्वैव स्वर्गायानुगतो जनः ॥१८॥
t: yaḥ prāptaḥ so’pi dr̥ṣṭvaiva svargāyānugato janaḥ ॥18॥

v: यानि पश्यन्ति काकुत्स्थं स्थावराणि चराणि च ।
t: yāni paśyanti kākutsthaṁ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,

v: अथ तस्मिन् मुहूर्ते तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।
t: atha tasmin muhūrte tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ,

v: आगच्छ विष्णो भद्रं ते दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव ॥८॥
t: āgaccha viṣṇo bhadraṁ te diṣṭyā prāpto’si rāghava ॥8॥

v: भ्रातृभिः सह देवाभैः प्रविशस्व स्विकां तनुम् ।
यामिच्छसि महाबाहो तां तनुं प्रविश स्विकाम् ॥९॥
t: bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha devābhaiḥ praviśasva svikāṁ tanum,
yāmicchasi mahābāho tāṁ tanuṁ praviśa svikām ॥9॥

v: त्वं हि लोकगतिर्देव न त्वां केचित् प्रजानते ॥१०॥
t: tvaṁ hi lokagatirdeva na tvāṁ kecit prajānate ॥10॥

v: ततो विष्णुमयं देवं पूजयन्ति स्म देवताः ।
t: tato viṣṇumayaṁ devaṁ pūjayanti sma devatāḥ,

v: ये च दिव्या ऋषिगणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च याः ।
t: ye ca divyā r̥ṣigaṇā gandharvāpsarasaśca yāḥ,

v: अवगाह्याप्सु यो यो वै प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा प्रहृष्टवत् ॥२३॥
t: avagāhyāpsu yo yo vai prāṇāṁstyaktvā prahr̥ṣṭavat ॥23॥

v: दिव्या दिव्येन वपुषा देवा दीप्ता इवाभवन् ॥२५॥
t: divyā divyena vapuṣā devā dīptā ivābhavan ॥25॥

v: गत्वा तु सरयूतोयं स्थावराणि चराणि च ।
t: gatvā tu sarayūtoyaṁ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,

v: ततः प्रतिष्ठितो विष्णुः स्वर्गलोके यथा पुरा ।
t: tataḥ pratiṣṭhito viṣṇuḥ svargaloke yathā purā,

v: नित्यं शृण्वन्ति संहृष्टाः काव्यं रामायणं दिवि ॥३॥
t: nityaṁ śr̥ṇvanti saṁhr̥ṣṭāḥ kāvyaṁ rāmāyaṇaṁ divi ॥3॥

v: वाचके परितुष्टे तु तुष्टाः स्युः सर्वदेवताः ॥७॥
t: vācake parituṣṭe tu tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ॥7॥

v: अयोध्यापि पुरी रम्या शून्या वर्षगणान् बहून् ।
t: ayodhyāpi purī ramyā śūnyā varṣagaṇān bahūn,

v: गतानि तेन लोकेऽस्मिन् येन रामायणं श्रुतम् ।
t: gatāni tena loke’smin yena rāmāyaṇaṁ śrutam,

v: यः शृणोति सदा भक्त्या स गच्छेद् वैष्णवीं तनुम् ।
t: yaḥ śr̥ṇoti sadā bhaktyā sa gacched vaiṣṇavīṁ tanum,

v: चिन्तयेद् राघवं नित्यं श्रेयः प्राप्तुं य इच्छति ।
t: cintayed rāghavaṁ nityaṁ śreyaḥ prāptuṁ ya icchati,

v: तत्पिता तत्पिता चैव विष्णुं यान्ति न संशयः ॥२२॥
t: tatpitā tatpitā caiva viṣṇuṁ yānti na saṁśayaḥ ॥22॥

v: तस्माद् यत्नवता नित्यं श्रोतव्यं परमं सदा ॥२३॥
t: tasmād yatnavatā nityaṁ śrotavyaṁ paramaṁ sadā ॥23॥

v: शृण्वन् रामायणं भक्त्या यः पादं पदमेव वा ।
स याति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं ब्रह्मणा पूज्यते सदा ॥२४॥
t: śr̥ṇvan rāmāyaṇaṁ bhaktyā yaḥ pādaṁ padameva vā,
sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṁ brahmaṇā pūjyate sadā ॥24॥

topics.hi: नारदजीका वाल्मीकि मुनिको संक्षेपसे श्रीरामचरित्र सुनाना
topics.en: The celestial sage Narad narrates to Valmiki the Story of Shri Ram in a nutshell

topics.hi: रामायणकाव्यका उपक्रम—तमसाके तटपर क्रौञ्चवधसे संतप्त हुए महर्षि वाल्मीकिके शोकका श्लोकरूपमें प्रकट होना तथा ब्रह्माजीका उन्हें रामचरित्रमय काव्यके निर्माणका आदेश देना
topics.en: Brahma’s visit

topics.hi: वाल्मीकि मुनिद्वारा रामायणकाव्यमें निबद्ध विषयोंका संक्षेपसे उल्लेख
topics.en: A brief outline of the Ramayan as given by the poet himself

topics.hi: महर्षि वाल्मीकिका चौबीस हजार श्लोकोंसे युक्त रामायणकाव्यका निर्माण करके उसे लव-कुशको पढ़ाना, मुनिमण्डलीमें रामायणगान करके लव और कुशका प्रशंसित होना तथा अयोध्यामें श्रीरामद्वारा सम्मानित हो उन दोनोंका रामदरबारमें रामायणगान सुनाना
topics.en: After his ascension to the throne of Ayodhya, Shri Ram listens to his own story as sung by his sons (Kush and Lav)

topics.hi: राजा दशरथद्वारा सुरक्षित अयोध्यापुरीका वर्णन
topics.en: A description of the city of Ayodhya

topics.hi: राजा दशरथके शासनकालमें अयोध्या और वहाँके नागरिकोंकी उत्तम स्थितिका वर्णन
topics.en: A description of the city of Ayodhya and the prosperity of its inhabitants during the reign of King Dashrath

topics.hi: राजमन्त्रियोंके गुण और नीतिका वर्णन
topics.en: The virtue and upright conduct of the eight ministers of Emperor Dashrath

topics.hi: राजाका पुत्रके लिये अश्वमेधयज्ञ करनेका प्रस्ताव और मन्त्रियों तथा ब्राह्मणोंद्वारा उनका अनुमोदन
topics.en: The king’s proposal to perform a horse-sacrifice for being blessed with a son and the acclamation of the counsellors and other Brahmins

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रका राजाको ऋष्यश्रृंग मुनिको बुलानेकी सलाह देते हुए उनके अंगदेशमें जाने और शान्तासे विवाह करनेका प्रसंग सुनाना
topics.en: A dialogue between Emperor Dashrath and Sumantra

topics.hi: अंगदेशमें ऋष्यश्रृंगके आने तथा शान्ताके साथ विवाह होनेके प्रसंगका कुछ विस्तारके साथ वर्णन
topics.en: How the sage Rishyashring was lured away to the capital of Romapad and married to his adopted daughter, Shanta

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रके कहनेसे राजा दशरथका सपरिवार अंगराजके यहाँ जाकर वहाँसे शान्ता और ऋष्यश्रृंगको अपने घर ले आना
topics.en: Urged by Sumantra, Emperor Dashrath calls on his friend, King Romapad, and brings with the latter’s permission Shanta and Rishyashring to his own palace

topics.hi: राजाका ऋषियोंसे यज्ञ करानेके लिये प्रस्ताव, ऋषियोंका राजाको और राजाका मन्त्रियोंको यज्ञकी आवश्यक तैयारी करनेके लिये आदेश देना
topics.en: Emperor Dashrath gives his consent to the performance of a horse-sacrifice for being blessed with a son

topics.hi: राजाका वसिष्ठजीसे यज्ञकी तैयारीके लिये अनुरोध, वसिष्ठजीद्वारा इसके लिये सेवकोंकी नियुक्ति और सुमन्त्रको राजाओंको बुलानेके लिये आदेश, समागत राजाओंका सत्कार तथा पत्नियोंसहित राजा दशरथका यज्ञकी दीक्षा लेना
topics.en: Feudatory chiefs called under orders of the Emperor and charged with the duty of setting up stables etc.

topics.hi: महाराज दशरथके द्वारा अश्वमेध यज्ञका सांगोपांग अनुष्ठान
topics.en: King Dashrath proceeds with the horse-sacrifice; Rishyashring grants him a boon regarding the birth of four sons

topics.hi: ऋष्यश्रृंगद्वारा राजा दशरथके पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञका आरम्भ, देवताओंकी प्रार्थनासे ब्रह्माजीका रावणके वधका उपाय ढूँढ़ निकालना तथा भगवान् विष्णुका देवताओंको आश्वासन देना
topics.en: Rishyashring conducts a sacrifice for securing the birth of sons to Dashrath; the gods approach Brahma in that very sacrifice with a prayer for bringing about the death of Ravan; Brahma implores Lord Vishnu (also present there) to descend in the house of Dashrath and do away with Ravan and the Lord undertakes to kill Ravan

topics.hi: देवताओंका श्रीहरिसे रावणवधके लिये मनुष्यरूपमें अवतीर्ण होनेको कहना, राजाके पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञमें अग्निकुण्डसे प्राजापत्य पुरुषका प्रकट होकर खीर अर्पण करना और उसे खाकर रानियोंका गर्भवती होना
topics.en: A dialogue between Lord Vishnu and the gods bearing on Ravan; on the disappearance of the Lord an attendant of Prajapati (Lord Vishnu, the Protector of all created beings) rises from the sacrificial pit and hands over to Dashrath a basin containing milk boiled with rice and sugar and the latter divides it among his wives

topics.hi: ब्रह्माजीकी प्रेरणासे देवता आदिके द्वारा विभिन्न वानरयूथपतियोंकी उत्पत्ति
topics.en: Birth of monkey chiefs from the loins of different gods under the directions of Brahma

topics.hi: राजाओं तथा ऋष्यश्रृंगको विदा करके राजा दशरथका रानियोंसहित पुरीमें आगमन, श्रीराम, भरत, लक्ष्मण तथा शत्रुघ्नके जन्म, संस्कार, शील-स्वभाव एवं सद्गुण, राजाके दरबारमें विश्वामित्रका आगमन और उनका सत्कार
topics.en: Advent of Shri Ram, Bharat and others; festivities in heaven as well as in Ayodhya; their investiture with the sacred thread; the arrival of Vishwamitra

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रके मुखसे श्रीरामको साथ ले जानेकी माँग सुनकर राजा दशरथका दु:खित एवं मूर्च्छित होना
topics.en: King Dashrath is stunned to hear the request of Vishwamitra to send Shri Ram with him to dispose of the Rakshasas that interfered with his sacred observances

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका विश्वामित्रको अपना पुत्र देनेसे इनकार करना और विश्वामित्रका कुपित होना
topics.en: Dashrath shows disinclination to part with Shri Ram, thereby enraging Vishwamitra

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रके रोषपूर्ण वचन तथा वसिष्ठका राजा दशरथको समझाना
topics.en: The wrath of Vishwamitra; the intercession of Vashishtha in favour of Vishwamitra

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वक राम-लक्ष्मणको मुनिके साथ भेजना, मार्गमें उन्हें विश्वामित्रसे बला और अतिबला नामक विद्याकी प्राप्ति
topics.en: King Dashrath sends Shri Ram and Lakshman with Vishwamitra and the two princes receive initiation from the latter in the two mystic spells, Bala and Atibala

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रसहित श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका सरयू-गंगासंगमके समीप पुण्य आश्रममें रातको ठहरना
topics.en: Night-long sojourn of Shri Ram and Lakshman with Vishwamitra in a holy hermitage at the confluence of the Ganga and the Sarayu

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका गंगापार होते समय विश्वामित्रजीसे जलमें उठती हुई तुमुलध्वनिके विषयमें प्रश्न करना, विश्वामित्रजीका उन्हें इसका कारण बताना तथा मलद, करूष एवं ताटका वनका परिचय देते हुए इन्हें ताटकावधके लिये आज्ञा प्रदान करना
topics.en: An account of the Sarayu given by Vishwamitra; some facts relating to the ogress Tataka revealed and hints given about killing her

topics.hi: श्रीरामके पूछनेपर विश्वामित्रजीका उनसे ताटकाकी उत्पत्ति, विवाह एवं शाप आदिका प्रसंग सुनाकर उन्हें ताटका-वधके लिये प्रेरित करना
topics.en: Questioned by Shri Ram, Vishwamitra tells him more about the birth of Tataka, of her marriage with Sunda, as well as about the birth of Marich as a result of their union, and how the latter was subjected to an execration by sage Agastya, and finally urges Shri Ram to despatch the ogress

topics.hi: श्रीरामद्वारा ताटकाका वध
topics.en: Shri Ram kills Tataka

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रद्वारा श्रीरामको दिव्यास्त्र-दान
topics.en: Gratified with the death of Tataka, Vishwamitra imparts to Shri Ram the knowledge of the various missiles

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रका श्रीरामको अस्त्रोंकी संहारविधि बताना तथा उन्हें अन्यान्य अस्त्रोंका उपदेश करना, श्रीरामका एक आश्रम एवं यज्ञस्थानके विषयमें मुनिसे प्रश्न
topics.en: At the request of Shri Ram the sage Vishwamitra instructs him as well as Lakshman in the process of calling back the missiles and delivers some more missiles to them

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रजीका श्रीरामसे सिद्धाश्रमका पूर्ववृत्तान्त बताना और उन दोनों भाइयोंके साथ अपने आश्रमपर पहुँचकर पूजित होना
topics.en: Vishwamitra tells Shri Ram the history of Siddhashram and arrives at his own hermitage with the two brothers

topics.hi: श्रीरामद्वारा विश्वामित्रके यज्ञकी रक्षा तथा राक्षसोंका संहार
topics.en: Shri Ram protects the sacrifice of Vishwamitra against the onslaught of the Rakshasas and gets rid of them

topics.hi: श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण तथा ऋषियोंसहित विश्वामित्रका मिथिलाको प्रस्थान तथा मार्गमें संध्याके समय शोणभद्रतटपर विश्राम
topics.en: Accompanied by Shri Ram, Lakshman and a host of Rishis, Sage Vishwamitra proceeds northward in the direction of Mithila to witness the bow-sacrifice of King Janak and breaks his journey on the bank of the Sona at sunset

topics.hi: ब्रह्मपुत्र कुशके चार पुत्रोंका वर्णन, शोणभद्र-तटवर्ती प्रदेशको वसुकी भूमि बताना, कुशनाभकी सौ कन्याओंका वायुके कोपसे ‘कुब्जा’ होना
topics.en: An account of the four sons of Kush; the hundred daughters of Kushanabh turn hunch-backed under a curse of the wind-god

topics.hi: राजा कुशनाभद्वारा कन्याओंके धैर्य एवं क्षमाशीलताकी प्रशंसा, ब्रह्मदत्तकी उत्पत्ति तथा उनके साथ कुशनाभकी कन्याओंका विवाह
topics.en: Kushanabh applauds the forbearance and forgiveness of his daughters; the story of the birth of Brahmadatt and his marriage with Kushanabh’s daughters

topics.hi: गाधिकी उत्पत्ति, कौशिकीकी प्रशंसा, विश्वामित्रजीका कथा बंद करके आधी रातका वर्णन करते हुए सबको सोनेकी आज्ञा देकर शयन करना
topics.en: Kushanabh performs a sacrifice for the birth of a son and is blessed with one, Gadhi by name; the glory of the river Kaushiki (the modern Kosi in Bihar)

topics.hi: शोणभद्र पार करके विश्वामित्र आदिका गंगाजीके तटपर पहुँचकर वहाँ रात्रिवास करना तथा श्रीरामके पूछनेपर विश्वामित्रजीका उन्हें गंगाजीकी उत्पत्तिकी कथा सुनाना
topics.en: Crossing the Sona, Vishwamitra and party reach the bank of the holy Ganga and spend the night there. Requested by Shri Ram, he narrates the story of the origin of the Ganga

topics.hi: देवताओंका शिव-पार्वतीको सुरतक्रीडासे निवृत्त करना तथा उमादेवीका देवताओं और पृथ्वीको शाप देना
topics.en: Gods interrupt the amorous pastimes of Lord Shiv and His Consort, Goddess Uma, on which She curses gods, including Mother Earth

topics.hi: गंगासे कार्तिकेयकी उत्पत्तिका प्रसंग
topics.en: A detailed account of Kartikey’s birth through Ganga

topics.hi: राजा सगरके पुत्रोंकी उत्पत्ति तथा यज्ञकी तैयारी
topics.en: The narrative of King Sagar, a former king of Ayodhya and a forefather of Shri Ram

topics.hi: इन्द्रके द्वारा राजा सगरके यज्ञसम्बन्धी अश्वका अपहरण, सगरपुत्रोंद्वारा सारी पृथ्वीका भेदन तथा देवताओंका ब्रह्माजीको यह सब समाचार बताना
topics.en: Indra steals away the horse released by Sagar as a prelude to his horse-sacrifice; his sixty thousand sons proceed to excavate the earth in quest of the horse and the gods in terror apprise Brahma of this daring of theirs

topics.hi: सगरपुत्रोंके भावी विनाशकी सूचना देकर ब्रह्माजीका देवताओंको शान्त करना, सगरके पुत्रोंका पृथ्वीको खोदते हुए कपिलजीके पास पहुँचना और उनके रोषसे जलकर भस्म होना
topics.en: Brahma reassures the gods by telling them that the sons of Sagar will be destroyed by the curse of Sage Kapil. The sons of Sagar in the course of their excavation arrive in the presence of Kapil and, behaving insolently towards him, are forthwith reduced to ashes by the fire of his wrath

topics.hi: सगरकी आज्ञासे अंशुमान्का रसातलमें जाकर घोड़ेको ले आना और अपने चाचाओंके निधनका समाचार सुनाना
topics.en: Under orders of Sagar his grandson Anshuman proceeds to Rasatal through the underground passage made by his uncles and, bringing back the sacrificial horse, tells the king about the fate of his uncles

topics.hi: अंशुमान् और भगीरथकी तपस्या, ब्रह्माजीका भगीरथको अभीष्ट वर देकर गंगाजीको धारण करनेके लिये भगवान् शङ्करको राजी करनेके निमित्त प्रयत्न करनेकी सलाह देना
topics.en: Anshuman and his grandson, Bhagirath, successively practise austerities for bringing down the Ganga to the terrestrial plane. Brahma grants a boon to Bhagirath and exhorts him to propitiate Lord Shiv and secure His consent to receive the Ganga on His head

topics.hi: भगीरथकी तपस्यासे संतुष्ट हुए भगवान् शङ्करका गंगाको अपने सिरपर धारण करके बिन्दुसरोवरमें छोड़ना और उनका सात धाराओंमें विभक्त हो भगीरथके साथ जाकर उनके पितरोंका उद्धार करना
topics.en: Pleased with the asceticism of Bhagirath, Lord Shiv receives the Ganga on His head and discharges it into Bindu Sarovar. Branching forth into seven streams it then accompanies Bhagirath to Rasatal and liberates his forbears on the way

topics.hi: ब्रह्माजीका भगीरथकी प्रशंसा करते हुए उन्हें गंगाजलसे पितरोंके तर्पणकी आज्ञा देना और राजाका वह सब करके अपने नगरको जाना, गंगावतरणके उपाख्यानकी महिमा
topics.en: Applauding Bhagirath, Brahma urges him to gratify the souls of his departed great grand-uncles by offering them the water of the Ganga, and after doing his bidding, Bhagirath returns to his capital; the glory of hearing and reading the story of Ganga’s descent on earth

topics.hi: देवताओं और दैत्योंद्वारा क्षीर-समुद्र-मन्थन, भगवान् रुद्रद्वारा हालाहल विषका पान, भगवान् विष्णुके सहयोगसे मन्दराचलका पातालसे उद्धार और उसके द्वारा मन्थन, धन्वन्तरि, अप्सरा, वारुणी, उच्चै:श्रवा, कौस्तुभ तथा अमृतकी उत्पत्ति और देवासुर-संग्राममें दैत्योंका संहार
topics.en: Vishwamitra tells Shri Ram how in the remote past the gods and the demons conjointly churned the ocean of milk, using Mount Mandar as the churning rod, how Lord Shiv drank off the deadly poison skimmed out of it, how as a result of that churning appeared Lord Dhanvantari, a bevy of Apsaras, the beverage known by the name of Varuni, the horse Uchchaihshrava, the Kaustubh gem and nectar, and how the conflict of gods and the Daityas ended in the destruction of the latter

topics.hi: पुत्रवधसे दु:खी दितिका कश्यपजीसे इन्द्रहन्ता पुत्रकी प्राप्तिके उद्देश्यसे तपके लिये आज्ञा लेकर कुशप्लवमें तप करना, इन्द्रद्वारा उनकी परिचर्या तथा उन्हें अपवित्र अवस्थामें पाकर इन्द्रका उनके गर्भके सात टुकड़े कर डालना
topics.en: Disconsolate over the death of her sons, Diti embarks on a course of austerities at Kushaplav with the permission of her husband, Sage Kashyap, with the object of securing a son capable of killing Indra. The latter on coming to know of her intention serves her during the period of her consecration and, taking advantage of her falling asleep on one occasion with her head in a wrong position, and thereby transgressing the rules of purity, enters her womb and carves the foetus

topics.hi: दितिका अपने पुत्रोंको मरुद्गण बनाकर देवलोकमें रखनेके लिये इन्द्रसे अनुरोध, इन्द्रद्वारा उसकी स्वीकृति, दितिके तपोवनमें ही इक्ष्वाकु-पुत्र विशालद्वारा विशाला नगरीका निर्माण तथा वहाँके तत्कालीन राजा सुमतिद्वारा विश्वामित्र मुनिका सत्कार
topics.en: Vishwamitra tells Shri Ram how on the very site of the grove where Diti practised her austerities, Vishal, a son of Ikshvaku, built the city of Vishala. Sumati, the contemporary ruler of Vishala, receives Vishwamitra and his party as his distinguished guests

topics.hi: राजा सुमतिसे सत्कृत हो एक रात विशालामें रहकर मुनियोंसहित श्रीरामका मिथिलापुरीमें पहुँचना और वहाँ सूने आश्रमके विषयमें पूछनेपर विश्वामित्रजीका उनसे अहल्याको शाप प्राप्त होनेकी कथा सुनाना
topics.en: Having stayed overnight at Vishala as an honoured guest of Sumati, Shri Ram, accompanied by Vishwamitra and the other sages, heads towards Mithila (the capital of King Janak) and, on reaching on the way a deserted hermitage and, inquiring about it, is told by Vishwamitra how Ahalya, wife of Sage Gautam, whose hermitage it was, was subjected to a curse by her husband

topics.hi: पितृदेवताओंद्वारा इन्द्रको भेड़ेके अण्डकोषसे युक्त करना तथा भगवान् श्रीरामके द्वारा अहल्याका उद्धार एवं उन दोनों दम्पतिके द्वारा इनका सत्कार
topics.en: At the intercession of the gods, Indra is supplied with testicles of a ram; Ahalya gets back her pristine celestial form at the very sight of Shri Ram, the moment he enters the hermitage, and the two divine brothers are entertained by the lady with the help of her husband

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिका मिथिला-गमन, राजा जनकद्वारा विश्वामित्रका सत्कार तथा उनका श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके विषयमें जिज्ञासा करना एवं परिचय पाना
topics.en: Shri Ram and others reach Mithila and are received in advance by King Janak, headed by his family priest, Shatananda; Vishwamitra satisfies their curiosity about the two princes of Ayodhya

topics.hi: शतानन्दके पूछनेपर विश्वामित्रका उन्हें श्रीरामके द्वारा अहल्याके उद्धारका समाचार बताना तथा शतानन्दद्वारा श्रीरामका अभिनन्दन करते हुए विश्वामित्रजीके पूर्वचरित्रका वर्णन
topics.en: At the request of Shatananda, Vishwamitra tells him how Ahalya was redeemed by Shri Ram and entertained him with the help of her husband. And Shatananda in his turn commences narrating to Shri Ram the story of Vishwamitra

topics.hi: महर्षि वसिष्ठद्वारा विश्वामित्रका सत्कार और कामधेनुको अभीष्ट वस्तुओंकी सृष्टि करनेका आदेश
topics.en: Vashishtha enjoins his cow of plenty, Shabala by name, to yield necessary articles for entertaining Vishwamitra

topics.hi: कामधेनुकी सहायतासे उत्तम अन्न-पानद्वारा सेनासहित तृप्त हुए विश्वामित्रका वसिष्ठसे उनकी कामधेनुको माँगना और उनका देनेसे अस्वीकार करना
topics.en: Heartily entertained alongwith his army by Vashishtha with delicious foods and drinks yielded by his cow of plenty, Vishwamitra asks of him the cow, which Vashishtha declines to part with

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रका वसिष्ठजीकी गौको बलपूर्वक ले जाना, गौका दु:खी होकर वसिष्ठजीसे इसका कारण पूछना और उनकी आज्ञासे शक, यवन, पह्लव आदि वीरोंकी सृष्टि करके उनके द्वारा विश्वामित्रजीकी सेनाका संहार करना
topics.en: On Vishwamitra attempting to take her away by force, Shabala seeks to know Vashishtha’s mind, and at his instance produces a multitude of warriors that disperse Vishwamitra’s army

topics.hi: अपने सौ पुत्रों और सारी सेनाके नष्ट हो जानेपर विश्वामित्रका तपस्या करके महादेवजीसे दिव्यास्त्र पाना तथा उनका वसिष्ठके आश्रमपर प्रयोग करना एवं वसिष्ठजीका ब्रह्मदण्ड लेकर उनके सामने खड़ा होना
topics.en: His entire army having been exterminated by the warriors produced by Shabala and his hundred sons reduced to ashes by the very roar of Vashishtha even as they assailed him, Vishwamitra retires to the Himalayas for austerities and, receiving a number of missiles from Lord Shiv, tries them on the inmates of Vashishtha’s hermitage; Vashishtha meets him with a mere staff appropriate to a Brahmin

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रद्वारा वसिष्ठजीपर नाना प्रकारके दिव्यास्त्रोंका प्रयोग और वसिष्ठद्वारा ब्रह्मदण्डसे ही उनका शमन एवं विश्वामित्रका ब्राह्मणत्वकी प्राप्तिके लिये तप करनेका निश्चय
topics.en: With his Brahmanical staff alone Vashishtha renders ineffectual all the mystic missiles discharged by Vishwamitra, whereupon the latter condemns military strength and makes up his mind to practise austerities with a view to attaining Brahmanhood

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रकी तपस्या, राजा त्रिशंकुका अपना यज्ञ करानेके लिये पहले वसिष्ठजीसे प्रार्थना करना और उनके इन्कार कर देनेपर उन्हींके पुत्रोंकी शरणमें जाना
topics.en: Vishwamitra embarks on a severe course of austerities with a view to attaining Brahmanhood. In the meantime, King Trishanku of Ayodhya requests Vashishtha to conduct for him a sacrifice which may enable him bodily to ascend to heaven and, on Vashishtha declining to comply with his request, approaches his sons for the same purpose

topics.hi: वसिष्ठ ऋषिके पुत्रोंका त्रिशंकुको डाँट बताकर घर लौटनेके लिये आज्ञा देना तथा उन्हें दूसरा पुरोहित बनानेके लिये उद्यत देख शाप-प्रदान और उनके शापसे चाण्डाल हुए त्रिशंकुका विश्वामित्रजीकी शरणमें जाना
topics.en: Having been repulsed by Vashishtha’s sons as well, Trishanku gets ready to seek another priest, whereupon he is degraded by the curse of Vashishtha’s sons to the position of a Chandal and approaches Vishwamitra with the same request

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रका त्रिशंकुको आश्वासन देकर उनका यज्ञ करानेके लिये ऋषि-मुनियोंको आमन्त्रित करना और उनकी बात न माननेवाले महोदय तथा ऋषिपुत्रोंको शाप देकर नष्ट करना
topics.en: Vishwamitra assures Trishanku of his help, sends word to a number of sages, inviting them to conduct a sacrifice for Trishanku, and pronounces a curse on those who decline to come

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रका ऋषियोंसे त्रिशंकुका यज्ञ करानेके लिये अनुरोध, ऋषियोंद्वारा यज्ञका आरम्भ, त्रिशंकुका सशरीर स्वर्गगमन, इन्द्रद्वारा स्वर्गसे उनके गिराये जानेपर क्षुब्ध हुए विश्वामित्रका नूतन देवसर्गके लिये उद्योग, फिर देवताओंके अनुरोधसे उनका इस कार्यसे विरत होना
topics.en: At the instance of Vishwamitra the sages assembled at his hermitage commence a sacrifice; on the gods failing to appear at the sacrifice to accept the offerings, Vishwamitra sends Trishanku bodily to heaven by dint of his own spiritual power, but the latter is expelled by Indra, on which Vishwamitra stops him in the air and proceeds to create a new heaven and desists from his purpose only on the gods granting his desire

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रकी पुष्कर तीर्थमें तपस्या तथा राजर्षि अम्बरीषका ऋचीकके मध्यम पुत्र शुन:शेपको यज्ञ-पशु बनानेके लिये खरीदकर लाना
topics.en: The animal to be sacrificed at the sacrificial performance of King Ambarish having been stolen away by Indra appearing in disguise, the arch-priest enjoined the king to secure a human beast as a substitute. Wandering in search of such a beast, Ambarish saw the sage Richik at Bhrigutunga and requested him to hand over his juvenile son in exchange for a hundred thousand cows. On the parents declining to part with their eldest and youngest sons, the middle one, Shunahshep by name, voluntarily offered himself for being sold and the king returned with him to his capital

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रद्वारा शुन:शेपकी रक्षाका सफल प्रयत्न और तपस्या
topics.en: On reaching Pushkar, while Ambarish is taking rest, Shunahshep approaches Vishwamitra, who was practising austerities there, and inquires of him a means of escaping death without meeting with the king’s opposition, whereupon Vishwamitra teaches him a prayer each for propitiating Indra and Lord Vishnu, respectively, by reciting which the boy secures release from Ambarish’s bondage and the latter gets the reward of the sacrifice without sacrificing him

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रको ऋषि एवं महर्षिपदकी प्राप्ति, मेनकाद्वारा उनका तपोभंग तथा ब्रह्मर्षिपदकी प्राप्तिके लिये उनकी घोर तपस्या
topics.en: Brahma pays a visit to Vishwamitra at Pushkar and rewards him with the status of a Rishi (seer). There he feels enamoured of Menaka, a celestial nymph deputed by Indra, and enjoys life with her for ten years. At last he realizes his folly and retires to the Himalayas, where he renews his austerities and is rewarded with the status of a Maharshi by Brahma. Still dissatisfied, he prosecutes his austerities with renewed vigour

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रका रम्भाको शाप देकर पुन: घोर तपस्याके लिये दीक्षा लेना
topics.en: Petrifying by means of a curse Rambha, the celestial nymph sent by Indra to wean him from his austerities, Vishwamitra resolves upon a further course of austerities

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रकी घोर तपस्या, उन्हें ब्राह्मणत्वकी प्राप्ति तथा राजा जनकका उनकी प्रशंसा करके उनसे विदा ले राजभवनको लौटना
topics.en: On Vishwamitra not ceasing from his austerities even on his being conferred the title of a Brahmarshi by Brahma, Vashishtha, as urged by gods, recognizes it and here ends the narration of Shatananda. Having worshipped Vishwamitra, King Janak then returns to his palace

topics.hi: राजा जनकका विश्वामित्र और राम-लक्ष्मणका सत्कार करके उन्हें अपने यहाँ रखे हुए धनुषका परिचय देना और धनुष चढ़ा देनेपर श्रीरामके साथ उनके ब्याहका निश्चय प्रकट करना
topics.en: On Vishwamitra apprising Janak of the eagerness of Shri Ram and Lakshman to see his famous bow, Janak reveals to him its glory and tells him how he got it as well as Sita and also of his pledge to give her in marriage to Shri Ram if he would string it

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा धनुर्भंग तथा राजा जनकका विश्वामित्रकी आज्ञासे राजा दशरथको बुलानेके लिये मन्त्रियोंको भेजना
topics.en: Urged by Vishwamitra, Shri Ram bends the bow, sent by Janak to the sacrificial hall, in order to string it and in the process breaks it, whereupon Janak with the concurrence of Vishwamitra sends his counsellors to Ayodhya to invite Emperor Dashrath for the wedding

topics.hi: राजा जनकका संदेश पाकर मन्त्रियोंसहित महाराज दशरथका मिथिला जानेके लिये उद्यत होना
topics.en: Reaching Ayodhya, the counsellors of Janak tell Dashrath how Shri Ram broke the bow of Lord Shiv in Janak’s custody and won the hand of his daughter, and convey to him their master’s invitation for the wedding, on which Dashrath makes up his mind in consultation with Vashishtha to depart for Mithila at an early date

topics.hi: दल-बलसहित राजा दशरथकी मिथिला-यात्रा और वहाँ राजा जनकके द्वारा उनका स्वागत-सत्कार
topics.en: With a large number of followers, Dashrath proceeds to Mithila for the wedding and is received with signal honour by Janak and his people and comfortably lodged

topics.hi: राजा जनकका अपने भाई कुशध्वजको सांकाश्या नगरीसे बुलवाना, राजा दशरथके अनुरोधसे वसिष्ठजीका सूर्यवंशका परिचय देते हुए श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके लिये सीता तथा ऊर्मिलाको वरण करना
topics.en: Janak sends for his younger brother, Kushadhwaj, from Sankashya. Invited by him, Dashrath meets Janak at the latter’s palace, where at the instance of Dashrath, Vashishtha glorifies the race of Ikshvaku

topics.hi: राजा जनकका अपने कुलका परिचय देते हुए श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके लिये क्रमश: सीता और ऊर्मिलाको देनेकी प्रतिज्ञा करना
topics.en: Recounting his own pedigree, Janak offers the hand of his two daughters, Sita and Urmila, to Shri Ram and Lakshman, respectively

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रद्वारा भरत और शत्रुघ्नके लिये कुशध्वजकी कन्याओंका वरण, राजा जनकद्वारा इसकी स्वीकृति तथा राजा दशरथका अपने पुत्रोंके मंगलके लिये नान्दीश्राद्ध एवं गोदान करना
topics.en: Vashishtha and Vishwamitra jointly ask for the hand of the two daughters of Kushadhwaj in favour of Bharat and Shatrughna and Janak acquiesces in the proposal. Thereupon Dashrath gets his sons to perform the rite of Samavartan and himself performs the Nandishraddh

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदि चारों भाइयोंका विवाह
topics.en: Janak escorts Dashrath and his four sons clad in nuptial attire to the pavilion erected for the wedding. Placing Vishwamitra and Shatananda ahead, Vashishtha conducts the marriage ceremony. Shri Ram and his three brothers clasp the hand of Sita and her sisters. Singing and dancing for joy, the gods rain heavenly flowers on the brides and bridegrooms

topics.hi: विश्वामित्रका अपने आश्रमको प्रस्थान, राजा जनकका कन्याओंको भारी दहेज देकर राजा दशरथ आदिको विदा करना, मार्गमें शुभाशुभ शकुन और परशुरामजीका आगमन
topics.en: Taking leave of Janak and Dashrath, Vishwamitra returns to his own hermitage and, accepting large wedding presents, Dashrath too turns back to Ayodhya alongwith his sons and their newly- wedded brides. On the way the irascible and redoubtable Parshuram, a sworn enemy of the Kshatriyas, suddenly appears before them, axe in hand, and Vashishtha and the other sages accompanying the party offer worship to him

topics.hi: राजा दशरथकी बात अनसुनी करके परशुरामका श्रीरामको वैष्णव-धनुषपर बाण चढ़ानेके लिये ललकारना
topics.en: Turning a deaf ear to Dashrath’s prayer, Parshuram relates the history of the bows belonging to Lords Shiv and Vishnu and challenges Shri Ram to string the bow of Lord Vishnu in his possession

topics.hi: श्रीरामका वैष्णव-धनुषको चढ़ाकर अमोघ बाणके द्वारा परशुरामके तप:प्राप्त पुण्यलोकोंका नाश करना तथा परशुरामका महेन्द्रपर्वतको लौट जाना
topics.en: Fitting the arrow to the bow of Lord Vishnu and declaring it as unfailing, Shri Ram asks Parshuram to point out at whom it may be discharged, and at the instance of the latter puts an end to his title to the (ethereal) worlds earned by him through his austerities. Recognizing Shri Ram to be no other than Lord Vishnu and taking leave of him, Parshuram withdraws to Mount Mahendra in order to resume his austerities

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका पुत्रों और वधुओंके साथ अयोध्यामें प्रवेश, शत्रुघ्नसहित भरतका मामाके यहाँ जाना, श्रीरामके बर्तावसे सबका संतोष तथा सीता और श्रीरामका पारस्परिक प्रेम
topics.en: On the departure of Parshuram, Shri Ram hands over the bow of Lord Vishnu to Varun (the god of water) and, sending his army ahead, King Dashrath enters Ayodhya. After some days Prince Yudhajit, Bharat’s maternal uncle takes away Bharat and Shatrughna to his father’s capital

topics.hi: श्रीरामके सद्गुणोंका वर्णन, राजा दशरथका श्रीरामको युवराज बनानेका विचार तथा विभिन्न नरेशों और नगर एवं जनपदके लोगोंको मन्त्रणाके लिये अपने दरबारमें बुलाना
topics.en: Bharat having left for his maternal grandfather’s capital alongwith Shatrughna, Emperor Dashrath makes up his mind to install Shri Ram as his Regent and, summoning a number of princes for consultation, confers with them on the subject

topics.hi: राजा दशरथद्वारा श्रीरामके राज्याभिषेकका प्रस्ताव तथा सभासदोंद्वारा श्रीरामके गुणोंका वर्णन करते हुए उक्त प्रस्तावका सहर्ष युक्तियुक्त समर्थन
topics.en: Dashrath apprises the assembly of his intention to retire from active rule after relegating the power to Shri Ram’s able hands and the councillors with one voice ditto the proposal and urge the Emperor to expedite matters

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका वसिष्ठ और वामदेवजीको श्रीरामके राज्याभिषेककी तैयारी करनेके लिये कहना और उनका सेवकोंको तदनुरूप आदेश देना; राजाकी आज्ञासे सुमन्त्रका श्रीरामको राजसभामें बुला लाना और राजाका अपने पुत्र श्रीरामको हितकर राजनीतिकी बातें बताना
topics.en: Urged by the Emperor to solemnize the installation of Shri Ram as Prince Regent, Vashishtha enjoins in his turn Dashrath’s ministers, Sumantra and others, to get ready all requisites for the ceremony. Sent by Sumantra, Shri Ram in the meantime calls on his father, who announces his decision to install him as Prince Regent and also tenders some opportune advice to him. Shri Ram’s chums break the news to Shri Ram’s mother, Kaushalya; treasuring in his mind the exhortation of his father and bowing low to him, Shri Ram returns to his own apartments

topics.hi: श्रीरामको राज्य देनेका निश्चय करके राजाका सुमन्त्रद्वारा पुन: श्रीरामको बुलवाकर उन्हें आवश्यक बातें बताना, श्रीरामका कौसल्याके भवनमें जाकर माताको यह समाचार बताना और मातासे आशीर्वाद पाकर लक्ष्मणसे प्रेमपूर्वक वार्तालाप करके अपने महलमें जाना
topics.en: Apprehending obstruction of Shri Ram’s installation from an ominous dream, Dashrath summons Shri Ram immediately and asks him to observe certain sacred vows preliminary to installation alongwith Sita. Bidding him go by his father, Shri Ram enters his mother’s gynaeceum and, after receiving her blessings, retires alongwith Sita, already present there, to his own palace

topics.hi: राजा दशरथके अनुरोधसे वसिष्ठजीका सीतासहित श्रीरामको उपवासव्रतकी दीक्षा देकर आना और राजाको इस समाचारसे अवगत कराना; राजाका अन्त:पुरमें प्रवेश
topics.en: At the instance of the Emperor, Vashishtha calls at Shri Ram’s palace and instructing him alongwith Sita to fast for the night, returns to Dashrath. Permitted by the sage, the Emperor adjourns the assembly and retires to the gynaeceum

topics.hi: सीतासहित श्रीरामका नियमपरायण होना, हर्षमें भरे पुरवासियोंद्वारा नगरकी सजावट, राजाके प्रति कृतज्ञता प्रकट करना तथा अयोध्यापुरीमें जनपदवासी मनुष्योंकी भीड़का एकत्र होना
topics.en: Enjoined by sage Vashishtha, Shri Ram undertakes a vow to bathe early next morning, worship the gods and sleep for the night on a mat of Kush grass. On waking up the next morning, he says his Sandhya prayers and Brahmins wish him a propitious day. The citizens decorate the city in order to give it a festal appearance and it is thronged with men eager to witness the installation of Shri Ram as Prince Regent

topics.hi: श्रीरामके अभिषेकका समाचार पाकर खिन्न हुई मन्थराका कैकेयीको उभाड़ना, परंतु प्रसन्न हुई कैकेयीका उसे पुरस्काररूपमें आभूषण देना और वर माँगनेके लिये प्रेरित करना
topics.en: Beholding the festivities and finding Kaushalya bestowing large gifts of money on the Brahmins, Manthara, a hunchback hereditary maid- servant of Queen Kaikeyi, who had accidentally ascended the roof of the palace, inquires of Shri Ram’s erstwhile nurse the occasion for the festivities and, on being told of Shri Ram’s forthcoming installation, feels enraged and, approaching Kaikeyi, instigates her to stop the installation. Kaikeyi, on the other hand, feels rejoiced over the news and gifts her a jewel as a token of her pleasure

topics.hi: मन्थराका पुन: श्रीरामके राज्याभिषेकको कैकेयीके लिये अनिष्टकारी बताना, कैकेयीका श्रीरामके गुणोंको बताकर उनके अभिषेकका समर्थन करना तत्पश्चात् कुब्जाका पुन: श्रीरामराज्यको भरतके लिये भयजनक बताकर कैकेयीको भड़काना
topics.en: While Manthara was thus trying to impress on Kaikeyi’s mind that the installation of Shri Ram on the throne of Ayodhya would spell disaster to Bharat, Kaikeyi for her part went on harping on Shri Ram’s virtues and maintained that his installation as Prince Regent was quite welcome to her. Manthara, however, goes on labouring her point and urges Kaikeyi to interrupt the installation

topics.hi: कुब्जाके कुचक्रसे कैकेयीका कोपभवनमें प्रवेश
topics.en: Kaikeyi, whose heart was poisoned by the malicious gossip of Manthara as aforesaid, takes a vow to see that Ram is sent into exile and Bharat installed as Prince Regent, and asks Manthara herself how to secure that consummation. Manthara tells her how in the course of a conflict between gods and demons, in which Dashrath’s help was enlisted by the gods, the queen, who had accompanied her husband to the field of operations and had rendered valuable assistance to him at a critical juncture, was offered a couple of boons, which she had kept in abeyance. Manthara now asks Kaikeyi to demand the banishment of Ram and the installation of Bharat against the two promised boons. Kaikeyi accordingly throws away her ornaments and lies down on the bare floor in the sulking-room in a sullen mood

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका कैकेयीके भवनमें जाना, उसे कोपभवनमें स्थित देखकर दु:खी होना और उसको अनेक प्रकारसे सान्त्वना देना
topics.en: Having told off Sumantra and others to get together necessaries for the installation of Shri Ram, Dashrath calls on Kaikeyi to break the happy news to her. Not finding her in her apartments, however, he makes inquiries from the portress, who tells him of her presence in the sulking-chamber. The Emperor calls on her there and, lifting her up, cajoles her

topics.hi: कैकेयीका राजाको प्रतिज्ञाबद्ध करके उन्हें पहलेके दिये हुए दो वरोंका स्मरण दिलाकर भरतके लिये अभिषेक और रामके लिये चौदह वर्षोंका वनवास माँगना
topics.en: Egged on by Kaikeyi to grant her desire, Dashrath gives his word of honour to her to that effect. Invoking the presence of gods as witnesses and reminding the Emperor of what took place during the conflict of gods and demons, Kaikeyi asks of him the two boons promised by him in the shape of exiling Shri Ram for a period of fourteen years and installing Bharat as Prince Regent

topics.hi: महाराज दशरथकी चिन्ता, विलाप, कैकेयीको फटकारना, समझाना और उससे वैसा वर न माँगनेके लिये अनुरोध करना
topics.en: Extolling the virtues of Shri Ram and showing him undeserving of exile, the Emperor endeavours to dissuade Kaikeyi from her pertinacity in sending Shri Ram into exile. Quoting the examples of Harishchandra and others, Kaikeyi, however, redoubles her insistence. The Emperor for his part rebukes her in harsh words and goes the length of falling at her feet in order to bring her round but in vain

topics.hi: राजाका विलाप और कैकेयीसे अनुनय-विनय
topics.en: Further tormented by Kaikeyi through her importunity to have the boons granted by the Emperor implemented, the latter piteously wails his lot and reproaches her. The sun having set in the meanwhile, the Emperor continues till the following morning his solicitations to Kaikeyi to allow Ram to be installed as Prince Regent. But, Kaikeyi remaining adamant, the king in his extreme anguish of mind sinks down unconscious on the floor and, on regaining his consciousness, stops all music pertaining to the occasion of the king’s quitting his bed

topics.hi: कैकेयीका राजाको सत्यपर दृढ़ रहनेके लिये प्रेरणा देकर अपने वरोंकी पूर्तिके लिये दुराग्रह दिखाना, महर्षि वसिष्ठका अन्त:पुरके द्वारपर आगमन और सुमन्त्रको महाराजके पास भेजना, राजाकी आज्ञासे सुमन्त्रका श्रीरामको बुलानेके लिये जाना
topics.en: Citing other instances of the Emperor’s fidelity to truth and threatening to lay down her life in the event of his not carrying out her wishes, Kaikeyi insists on his sending Shri Ram into exile at once and does not desist from her purpose even when railed at by her husband. In the meantime Sumantra makes his appearance in the gynaeceum and, extolling the Emperor, reminds him of his intention to install Shri Ram as Prince Regent and eventually leaves the gynaeceum in order to summon Shri Ram at the instance of the Emperor

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रका राजाकी आज्ञासे श्रीरामको बुलानेके लिये उनके महलमें जाना
topics.en: While going out of the gynaeceum to bring Shri Ram, Sumantra sees Vashishtha and others as well as a number of kings waiting at the gate and hastens back to announce their presence to the king. He is, however, sent back to fetch Shri Ram and forthwith enters the latter’s apartments

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रका श्रीरामके महलमें पहुँचकर महाराजका संदेश सुनाना और श्रीरामका सीतासे अनुमति ले लक्ष्मणके साथ रथपर बैठकर गाजे-बाजेके साथ मार्गमें स्त्री-पुरुषोंकी बातें सुनते हुए जाना
topics.en: Seeking the presence of Shri Ram, Sumantra communicates to him the Emperor’s command asking Sumantra to bring Ram with him, and departs. Mounting his gold chariot and accompanied by Lakshman, who holds an umbrella over the former’s head and waves a pair of chowries in order to fan him, and followed by a number of elephants and horses, Shri Ram drives in state to see Dashrath, listening en route to his own glory sung by jubilant men and women

topics.hi: श्रीरामका राजपथकी शोभा देखते और सुहृदोंकी बातें सुनते हुए पिताके भवनमें प्रवेश
topics.en: Shri Ram drives in state to his father’s gynaeceum, beholding en route the charms of Ayodhya, hearing the blessings and encomia of his friends and relations and ravishing the eyes of all on-lookers, and on reaching his destination sends back his retinue and seeks the presence of his royal father alone

topics.hi: श्रीरामका कैकेयीसे पिताके चिन्तित होनेका कारण पूछना और कैकेयीका कठोरतापूर्वक अपने माँगे हुए वरोंका वृत्तान्त बताकर श्रीरामको वनवासके लिये प्रेरित करना
topics.en: Questioned by Shri Ram as to what preyed on his father’s mind, Kaikeyi tells him all that had happened in the meantime and sternly urges him to depart for the woods

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी कैकेयीके साथ बातचीत और वनमें जाना स्वीकार करके उनका माता कौसल्याके पास आज्ञा लेनेके लिये जाना
topics.en: Having agreed to leave for the forest, Shri Ram proceeds to take leave of his mother Kaushalya

topics.hi: राजा दशरथकी अन्य रानियोंका विलाप, श्रीरामका कौसल्याजीके भवनमें जाना और उन्हें अपने वनवासकी बात बताना, कौसल्याका अचेत होकर गिरना और श्रीरामके उठा देनेपर उनकी ओर देखकर विलाप करना
topics.en: Even as Shri Ram issued forth from the palace of Queen Kaikeyi, the inmates of the gynaeceum burst into a piteous wail, extolling the prince’s virtues. Mother Kaushalya embraces and pronounces her benedictions on Shri Ram as the latter approaches her and falls at her feet. On being apprised of the circumstances that had brought him there, she falls to the ground overwhelmed with grief, and weeps bitterly expressing her deep sorrow

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका रोष, उनका श्रीरामको बलपूर्वक राज्यपर अधिकार कर लेनेके लिये प्रेरित करना तथा श्रीरामका पिताकी आज्ञाके पालनको ही धर्म बताकर माता और लक्ष्मणको समझाना
topics.en: Consoling Kaushalya in her grief over the impending exile of Shri Ram, Prince Lakshman opposes the idea of Shri Ram’s leaving for the forest and, censuring Dashrath, makes up his mind to accompany his eldest brother. Kaushalya too deters Shri Ram from going into exile, branding Kaikeyi’s command as unjust. Shri Ram, however, justifies the command on the ground of its being countenanced by the Emperor and requests his mother to grant him leave and perform auspicious rites connected with his departure

topics.hi: श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणको समझाते हुए अपने वनवासमें दैवको ही कारण बताना और अभिषेककी सामग्रीको हटा लेनेका आदेश देना
topics.en: Shri Ram pacifies Lakshman, who was angry with Kaikeyi, by denying the instrumentality of Kaikeyi in his banishment and laying the entire blame on his own fate

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणकी ओजभरी बातें, उनके द्वारा दैवका खण्डन और पुरुषार्थका प्रतिपादन तथा उनका श्रीरामके अभिषेकके निमित्त विरोधियोंसे लोहा लेनेके लिये उद्यत होना
topics.en: Enraged to hear the exhortation of Shri Ram, Lakshman urges in reply that the word of their father was worth ignoring inasmuch as it was divorced from righteousness and, further emphasizing the predominance of personal effort over destiny, persuades Shri Ram to take up arms against those who interfere with his installation and occupy the throne of Ayodhya by force. Shri Ram, however, pacifies Lakshman and impresses on him the imperative necessity of their carrying out the command of their father

topics.hi: विलाप करती हुई कौसल्याका श्रीरामसे अपनेको भी साथ ले चलनेके लिये आग्रह करना तथा पतिकी सेवा ही नारीका धर्म है, यह बताकर श्रीरामका उन्हें रोकना और वन जानेके लिये उनकी अनुमति प्राप्त करना
topics.en: Finding Shri Ram firm in his obedience to the command of his parents, Kaushalya (Shri Ram’s mother) urges him to take her alongwith him. On being told, however, that it was incumbent on a matron whose husband was alive to remain with the latter and serve him, she consents to Shri Ram’s departure to the forest

topics.hi: कौसल्याका श्रीरामकी वनयात्राके लिये मङ्गलकामनापूर्वक स्वस्तिवाचन करना और श्रीरामका उन्हें प्रणाम करके सीताके भवनकी ओर जाना
topics.en: Having received the mother’s benedictions for the journey, Shri Ram falls at her feet and proceeds to the apartments of Sita in order to see her

topics.hi: श्रीरामको उदास देखकर सीताका उनसे इसका कारण पूछना और श्रीरामका पिताकी आज्ञासे वनमें जानेका निश्चय बताते हुए सीताको घरमें रहनेके लिये समझाना
topics.en: Beholding Shri Ram depressed in spirits and lustreless with frustration writ large on his countenance, Sita, who knew nothing about the interruption of his installation and had been eagerly and joyfully awaiting his return, inquires about the cause of his dejection and is told how his installation has been stopped and how he is going to be sent into exile by his father, and exhorted to look after her father-in-law and mothers-in-law as before and to treat Bharat and Shatrughna as her own brothers or sons and never to harbour malice towards them

topics.hi: सीताकी श्रीरामसे अपनेको भी साथ ले चलनेके लिये प्रार्थना
topics.en: Exhorted by Shri Ram to stay in Ayodhya to look after his parents, Sita submits in reply that she being his counterpart, her exile is implied in his and insists on her being taken with him since she would not be able to bear separation from him

topics.hi: श्रीरामका वनवासके कष्टका वर्णन करते हुए सीताको वहाँ चलनेसे मना करना
topics.en: Bringing home to Sita the austerity and hardships of forest life, Shri Ram tries once more to dissuade her from her insistence on accompanying him to the forest

topics.hi: सीताका श्रीरामके समक्ष उनके साथ अपने वनगमनका औचित्य बताना
topics.en: Sita continues to implore Shri Ram to take her to the forest alongwith him. Shri Ram, however, is adamant and goes on consoling her and asking her to stay on in Ayodhya

topics.hi: सीताका वनमें चलनेके लिये अधिक आग्रह, विलाप और घबराहट देखकर श्रीरामका उन्हें साथ ले चलनेकी स्वीकृति देना, पिता-माता और गुरुजनोंकी सेवाका महत्त्व बताना तथा सीताको वनमें चलनेकी तैयारीके लिये घरकी वस्तुओंका दान करनेकी आज्ञा देना
topics.en: Though consoled by Shri Ram in many ways, Sita did not change her mind and seeing her insistent on accompanying him, Shri Ram agrees to take her to the forest and asks her to prepare for the journey and to give away all her personal belongings in charity

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका संवाद, श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे लक्ष्मणका सुहृदोंसे पूछकर और दिव्य आयुध लाकर वनगमनके लिये तैयार होना, श्रीरामका उनसे ब्राह्मणोंको धन बाँटनेका विचार व्यक्त करना
topics.en: Hearing the dialogue of Shri Ram and Sita, Lakshman seeks his permission to accompany him to the forest. Shri Ram desires him to stay in Ayodhya in order to look after his mothers. But seeing his insistence, he agrees to take him as well and urges him to bring Suyajna and other Rishis, accounting them worthy of receiving gifts from him

topics.hi: सीतासहित श्रीरामका वसिष्ठपुत्र सुयज्ञको बुलाकर उनके तथा उनकी पत्नीके लिये बहुमूल्य आभूषण, रत्न और धन आदिका दान तथा लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामद्वारा ब्राह्मणों, ब्रह्मचारियों, सेवकों, त्रिजट ब्राह्मण और सुहृज्जनोंको धनका वितरण
topics.en: Having received gifts of jewels and ornaments from Shri Ram and Sita, Suyajna invokes divine blessings on the couple. Enjoined by Shri Ram, Lakshman then bestows silk costumes and ornaments etc., on the sons of Sage Agastya and others. Urged by his wife, a sage, Trijat by name, approaches Shri Ram and seeks riches from him. Shri Ram thereupon bestows on him thousands of cows and distributes his remaining wealth among other Brahmins as well as among his relations and dependants

topics.hi: सीता और लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका दु:खी नगरवासियोंके मुखसे तरह-तरहकी बातें सुनते हुए पिताके दर्शनके लिये कैकेयीके महलमें जाना
topics.en: Having distributed his immense riches among the Brahmins and others, Shri Ram, accompanied by Sita and Lakshman, proceeds to his father’s gynaeceum to take leave of him. Remaining unruffled even on hearing en route the diverse talks of the citizens gathered here and there, with melancholy writ large on their faces, the royal trio reach their destination and urge Sumantra to apprise their royal father of their arrival

topics.hi: सीता और लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका रानियोंसहित राजा दशरथके पास जाकर वनवासके लिये विदा माँगना, राजाका शोक और मूर्च्छा, श्रीरामका उन्हें समझाना तथा राजाका श्रीरामको हृदयसे लगाकर पुन: मूर्च्छित हो जाना
topics.en: Apprised of Shri Ram’s arrival by Sumantra, Dashrath commands him to usher in Shri Ram with his consort. Seeing the Emperor fall unconscious at the very sight of the heir-apparent, the ladies of the royal household start wailing piteously. On Shri Ram’s soliciting his permission to retire to the woods, the king enjoins him to take his father captive and ascend the throne. Shri Ram in his turn consoles his father by assuring him that he has no hankering for royal fortune and that to him obedience to his father’s command is of utmost importance. Dashrath, however, falls unconscious again at the very thought of his separation from Shri Ram and Sumantra as well as all the ladies of the gynaeceum follow suit

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रके समझाने और फटकारनेपर भी कैकेयीका टस-से-मस न होना
topics.en: Hoping that by being provoked to anger Kaikeyi might come round and relax her insistence on sending Shri Ram into exile, Sumantra harshly reproaches her, reminding her of her mother’s misbehaviour towards her husband (Kaikeyi’s father). Kaikeyi, however, remains adamant and does not budge even an inch from her purpose

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका श्रीरामके साथ सेना और खजाना भेजनेका आदेश, कैकेयीद्वारा इसका विरोध, सिद्धार्थका कैकेयीको समझाना तथा राजाका श्रीरामके साथ जानेकी इच्छा प्रकट करना
topics.en: Dashrath instructs Sumantra to take a detachment of the army and the exchequer alongwith Shri Ram, to which Kaikeyi objects and insists on his being sent into exile without any resources on the analogy of Asamanj, son of the king’s forefather, Sagar. Another minister of the king, Siddhartha by name, who was present there, opposes Kaikeyi and urges that the analogy of Asamanj, who was a perverse lad, could not be applied in the case of Shri Ram, who possessed an ideal character and deserved in every way to be installed in the office of Prince Regent. In the event of Kaikeyi vetoing the proposal, the king threatens to accompany the heir-apparent

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिका वल्कल-वस्त्र-धारण, सीताके वल्कल-धारणसे रनिवासकी स्त्रियोंको खेद तथा गुरु वसिष्ठका कैकेयीको फटकारते हुए सीताके वल्कल-धारणका अनौचित्य बताना
topics.en: Shri Ram urges his servants to fetch the bark of trees for being used as his wearing apparel. At this Kaikeyi herself brings them the desired dress, which both Shri Ram and Lakshman cover themselves with, taking off their princely robes. Sita, however, finds it difficult to wear the bark supplied to her and ultimately puts it on over her own dress with the help of Shri Ram despite the remonstrances of Vashishtha, who severely castigates Kaikeyi for her cruelty in exiling them

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका सीताको वल्कल धारण कराना अनुचित बताकर कैकेयीको फटकारना और श्रीरामका उनसे कौसल्यापर कृपादृष्टि रखनेके लिये अनुरोध करना
topics.en: Incensed to hear the loud wailing of those present at the scene, on Sita being dressed as a hermitess, Dashrath reproaches Kaikeyi. While departing, Shri Ram entreats his father to take care of his mother

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका विलाप, उनकी आज्ञासे सुमन्त्रका रामके लिये रथ जोतकर लाना, कोषाध्यक्षका सीताको बहुमूल्य वस्त्र और आभूषण देना, कौसल्याका सीताको पतिसेवाका उपदेश, सीताके द्वारा उसकी स्वीकृति तथा श्रीरामका अपनी मातासे पिताके प्रति दोषदृष्टि न रखनेका अनुरोध करके अन्य माताओंसे भी विदा माँगना
topics.en: Sent away by Dashrath, Sumantra gets a chariot ready to take Shri Ram and his party to the forest and Sita adorns herself with jewels brought by the Chancellor of the Exchequer. Kaushalya tenders opportune advice to her daughter-in-law and the latter bows to it. Shri Ram comforts Kaushalya and offers apology to his other mothers, who burst into a wail

topics.hi: सीता, राम और लक्ष्मणका दशरथकी परिक्रमा करके कौसल्या आदिको प्रणाम करना, सुमित्राका लक्ष्मणको उपदेश, सीतासहित श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका रथमें बैठकर वनकी ओर प्रस्थान, पुरवासियों तथा रानियोंसहित महाराज दशरथकी शोकाकुल अवस्था
topics.en: Going clockwise round Dashrath (as a token of respect), Sita, Ram and Lakshman greet him. Accompanied by Sita, Shri Ram salutes Kaushalya. Lakshman too hails Kaushalya first and then his own mother, Sumitra. Sumitra for her part tenders salutary advice to her son. The princes and the princess having mounted the chariot, Sumantra flicks the horses. The citizens that had assembled, closely follow the chariot; but unable to keep pace with its swift movement, they return desolate. Dashrath too runs after the chariot alongwith Kaushalya and others, but being unable to walk begins to totter and stops short on the road yielding to the remonstrances of his wise ministers

topics.hi: श्रीरामके वनगमनसे रनवासकी स्त्रियोंका विलाप तथा नगरनिवासियोंकी शोकाकुल अवस्था
topics.en: The ladies of the royal gynaeceum bewail the exile of Shri Ram and others and the citizens of Ayodhya too are reduced to a miserable plight

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका पृथ्वीपर गिरना, श्रीरामके लिये विलाप करना, कैकेयीको अपने पास आनेसे मना करना और उसे त्याग देना, कौसल्या और सेवकोंकी सहायतासे उनका कौसल्याके भवनमें आना और वहाँ भी श्रीरामके लिये दु:खका ही अनुभव करना
topics.en: Shri Ram having departed for the forest in an exceptionally swift-going chariot, Dashrath vainly seeks to cover the intervening distance on foot. The very dust raised by the chariot having disappeared after a while, the Emperor feels doubly disconsolate and drops to the ground. When Kaikeyi comes forward to support him, he scolds her and asks her not to touch his person. Kaushalya then lifts him up and persuades him to return. His personal attendants take him to the latter’s apartments and, seeing him plunged in grief, Kaushalya seats herself beside him and begins to lament in various ways

topics.hi: महारानी कौसल्याका विलाप
topics.en: The Lament of Kaushalya

topics.hi: सुमित्राका कौसल्याको आश्वासन देना
topics.en: Establishing the greatness of Shri Ram, Sumitra, who is a pastmaster in eloquence, assuages Kaushalya’s grief

topics.hi: श्रीरामका पुरवासियोंसे भरत और महाराज दशरथके प्रति प्रेम-भाव रखनेका अनुरोध करते हुए लौट जानेके लिये कहना; नगरके वृद्ध ब्राह्मणोंका श्रीरामसे लौट चलनेके लिये आग्रह करना तथा उन सबके साथ श्रीरामका तमसातटपर पहुँचना
topics.en: When the citizens that followed Shri Ram in his journey to the forest refuse to return even when pleaded by Shri Ram in many ways, unable as they were to bear separation from him, Shri Ram, with Sita and Lakshman, gets down from his chariot and begins to walk. The citizens try to deflect him from his course and persuade him to return, but in vain. At the close of the day they all reach the bank of the Tamasa

topics.hi: सीता और लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका रात्रिमें तमसा-तटपर निवास, माता-पिता और अयोध्याके लिये चिन्ता तथा पुरवासियोंको सोते छोड़कर वनकी ओर जाना
topics.en: Having reached the bank of the Tamasa and thinking of the plight of the people of Ayodhya, Shri Ram lays himself down on a bed of leaves bewailing the lot of his parents and feeling reassured by the thought of Bharat’s noble qualities; while Lakshman opens his dialogue with Sumantra on the divine excellences of Shri Ram. Waking up in the meantime, Shri Ram urges the charioteer-minister to drive the chariot in such a way as to put the citizens, that had accompanied them, off the scent and lead them to think that the chariot had turned back towards Ayodhya instead of proceeding towards the forest. He then mounts the chariot alongwith Sita and Lakshman and presses on to the forest

topics.hi: प्रात:काल उठनेपर पुरवासियोंका विलाप करना और निराश होकर नगरको लौटना
topics.en: The citizens that had followed Shri Ram in his journey to the forest woke to find Shri Ram and his party gone and begin to reproach themselves. Overcome with grief they hunt up the tracks of his chariot; but unable to find them, they helplessly return to Ayodhya in utter despondency

topics.hi: नगरनिवासिनी स्त्रियोंका विलाप करना
topics.en: Told of Shri Ram’s departure for the forest by the citizens, who had gone out with Shri Ram and returned, unable as they were to find out the tracks of his chariot, their wives reproach Kaikeyi and break into lamentation

topics.hi: ग्रामवासियोंकी बातें सुनते हुए श्रीरामका कोसल जनपदको लाँघते हुए आगे जाना और वेदश्रुति, गोमती एवं स्यन्दिका नदियोंको पार करके सुमन्त्रसे कुछ कहना
topics.en: Having covered a long distance in the meantime, Shri Ram finishes his morning bath and devotions and, having crossed the Vedashruti, Gomati and Syandika rivers, presses forward talking with Sumantra

topics.hi: श्रीरामका मार्गमें अयोध्यापुरीसे वनवासकी आज्ञा माँगना और श्रृङ्गवेरपुरमें गङ्गातटपर पहुँचकर रात्रिमें निवास करना, वहाँ निषादराज गुहद्वारा उनका सत्कार
topics.en: Standing with his face turned towards Ayodhya, Shri Ram bids farewell to his birth-place and, sending back the people hailing from the countryside, who had come to see him, and crossing the frontiers of Kosal, Shri Ram reaches the bank of the holy Ganga. Alighting from the chariot under an Ingudi tree standing on the bank, he goes forward to meet Guha, the chief of the Nishads, who had come to meet him. Nay, worshipping the evening twilight and taking water only (for food and drink), the prince lies down on the ground to repose for the night; while Sumantra, Guha and Lakshman spend the night talking together

topics.hi: निषादराज गुहके समक्ष लक्ष्मणका विलाप
topics.en: Expressing his readiness to guard the Crown prince and his consort, keeping awake the whole night, Guha importunes Lakshman to repose. Reminding Guha of Shri Ram’s greatness, Lakshman, however, tells him that even though the duty of guarding his princely brother and his consort could as well be entrusted to Guha, he felt that he did not deserve to lie down in the presence of his elder brother and sister-in-law and preferred to remain awake. Expressing grief for his royal father and loving mothers he therefore spends the night talking with Guha

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे गुहका नाव मँगाना, श्रीरामका सुमन्त्रको समझा-बुझाकर अयोध्यापुरी लौट जानेके लिये आज्ञा देना और माता-पिता आदिसे कहनेके लिये संदेश सुनाना, सुमन्त्रके वनमें ही चलनेके लिये आग्रह करनेपर श्रीरामका उन्हें युक्तिपूर्वक समझाकर लौटनेके लिये विवश करना, फिर तीनोंका नावपर बैठना, सीताकी गङ्गाजीसे प्रार्थना, नावसे पार उतरकर श्रीराम आदिका वत्सदेशमें पहुँचना और सायंकालमें एक वृक्षके नीचे रहनेके लिये जाना
topics.en: While about to step into the boat brought by Guha’s men and asked by Guha if he could be of any further use to the prince, Shri Ram enjoins him to obey the Emperor. Importuned by Sumantra to take him as a personal attendant to the forest, the prince declines his loving offer and, expostulating with him, sends him back to Ayodhya. Entangling their locks into a thick mass with the milk of a banyan tree, procured by Guha, Shri Ram and Lakshman with Sita get into the boat. On reaching the middle of the stream, Sita offers prayers to Mother Ganga (the deity presiding over the stream) and after crossing the river all the three halt for the night at the foot of a tree

topics.hi: श्रीरामका राजाको उपालम्भ देते हुए कैकेयीसे कौसल्या आदिके अनिष्टकी आशङ्का बताकर लक्ष्मणको अयोध्या लौटानेके लिये प्रयत्न करना, लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामके बिना अपना जीवन असम्भव बताकर वहाँ जानेसे इनकार करना, फिर श्रीरामका उन्हें वनवासकी अनुमति देना
topics.en: Apprehending trouble for Kaushalya and others at the hands of Kaikeyi, Shri Ram, who was seated at the foot of a banyan tree and was a past master in the art of persuasion, persuades Lakshman to the best of his ability to return to Ayodhya. Lakshman, however, pleads inability to survive in his absence and does not budge an inch from his resolution to stay with his eldest brother. Shri Ram, therefore, yields and sets his seal to his continuing with him during his exile

topics.hi: लक्ष्मण और सीतासहित श्रीरामका प्रयागमें गङ्गा-यमुना-संगमके समीप भरद्वाज-आश्रममें जाना, मुनिके द्वारा उनका अतिथिसत्कार, उन्हें चित्रकूट पर्वतपर ठहरनेका आदेश तथा चित्रकूटकी महत्ता एवं शोभाका वर्णन
topics.en: Set out on his journey for the Dandak forest with Sita and Lakshman, Shri Ram reaches at dusk the hermitage of Sage Bharadwaj in the vicinity of the confluence of the holy Ganga and Yamuna rivers. Paying due honours to Shri Ram and his party, the sage recommends Chitrakoot as the fittest place for him to sojourn in. Spending the night in discourses on various topics with him, the sage grants him leave early next morning to depart for Chitrakoot

topics.hi: भरद्वाजजीका श्रीराम आदिके लिये स्वस्तिवाचन करके उन्हें चित्रकूटका मार्ग बताना, उन सबका अपने ही बनाये हुए बेड़ेसे यमुनाजीको पार करना, सीताकी यमुना और श्यामवटसे प्रार्थना, तीनोंका यमुनाके किनारेके मार्गसे एक कोसतक जाकर वनमें घूमना-फिरना, यमुनाजीके समतल तटपर रात्रिमें निवास करना
topics.en: Sage Bharadwaj tells Shri Ram and Lakshman, even as they set out on their journey to Chitrakoot, the route by which they should proceed. Accompanied by Sita, Shri Ram and Lakshman cross the Yamuna on a raft prepared by themselves. In the evening they halt on the bank of the Yamuna alongwith Sita, who is rejoiced to get fruits and blossoms of her liking

topics.hi: वनकी शोभा देखते-दिखाते हुए श्रीराम आदिका चित्रकूटमें पहुँचना, वाल्मीकिजीका दर्शन करके श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे लक्ष्मणद्वारा पर्णशालाका निर्माण तथा उसकी वास्तुशान्ति करके उन सबका कुटीमें प्रवेश
topics.en: Moving further next morning and rejoicing on the way to see the loveliness of the forest, the party reaches Chitrakoot and enters the hermitage of Valmiki. Making up his mind to sojourn there with the permission of the sage, Shri Ram gets Lakshman to erect a hut of leaves for themselves and, worshipping the deities presiding over the structure, they solemnly enter their abode at a propitious hour

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रका अयोध्याको लौटना, उनके मुखसे श्रीरामका संदेश सुनकर पुरवासियोंका विलाप, राजा दशरथ और कौसल्याकी मूर्च्छा तथा अन्त:पुरकी रानियोंका आर्तनाद
topics.en: Having been told of Shri Ram’s departure for Chitrakoot by the spies of Guha and taking leave of the latter, Sumantra drives back to Ayodhya. Entering the royal gynaeceum, he submits to the Emperor what he reported earlier to the citizens who followed his chariot. Dashrath and Kaushalya fall into a swoon to hear about Shri Ram’s departure for Chitrakoot and all the inmates of the gynaeceum burst into a wail from agony

topics.hi: महाराज दशरथकी आज्ञासे सुमन्त्रका श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके संदेश सुनाना
topics.en: Bewailing the lot of Shri Ram, Sita and Lakshman, who did not in anyway deserve the hardships they were undergoing in the forest, the Emperor urges Sumantra to deliver their parting message and the charioteer proceeds to tell him what they said

topics.hi: सुमन्त्रद्वारा श्रीरामके शोकसे जड-चेतन एवं अयोध्यापुरीकी दुरवस्थाका वर्णन तथा राजा दशरथका विलाप
topics.en: To satisfy the Emperor’s curiosity, Sumantra tells him further of Shri Ram’s departure for the forest, and also apprises him of the pitiable condition of the animate as well as of the inanimate creation in his realm as also of his capital consequent on Shri Ram’s exile. Hearing of the woeful tale, Dashrath raves like a madman in many ways in the presence of the charioteer-minister

topics.hi: कौसल्याका विलाप और सारथि सुमन्त्रका उन्हें समझाना
topics.en: Sumantra does not succeed in soothing the agony of Kaushalya, who tossed about on the floor due to excess of grief over her separation from Shri Ram, even though he consoles her by telling her that Shri Ram, being resolute and high-minded, was living in the forest free from agony

topics.hi: कौसल्याका विलापपूर्वक राजा दशरथको उपालम्भ देना
topics.en: Apprehending danger to the king from his inability to bear the grief caused by separation from Shri Ram, Kaushalya, though foremost among devoted wives, twits Dashrath

topics.hi: दु:खी हुए राजा दशरथका कौसल्याको हाथ जोड़कर मनाना और कौसल्याका उनके चरणोंमें पड़कर क्षमा माँगना
topics.en: When reproached in harsh words by Kaushalya, though already feeling disconsolate through separation from his sons and daughter-in-law, Dashrath falls into a swoon recalling his past sin in the form of killing a hermit boy, which was responsible for his present misfortune. On waking from his swoon he tries with folded hands to conciliate Kaushalya and on the latter reciprocating his sentiments, the Emperor is lulled into a nap

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका शोक और उनका कौसल्यासे अपने द्वारा मुनिकुमारके मारे जानेका प्रसङ्ग सुनाना
topics.en: Waking from sleep after a while and recalling his sinful deed, which spelt death to him, Dashrath proceeds to tell Kaushalya how, while he was Prince Regent of Ayodhya, he went out a-hunting in the forest one day and heard during the last watch of the night the sound of a hermit boy filling his pitcher with water by submerging into Sarayu river. Mistaking the gurgling sound for the trumpeting of an elephant, Dashrath hit the boy with an arrow, which dug deep into his body and mortally wounded him. On approaching his quarry he discovered the fatal blunder and tendered his heartfelt apology to the hermit boy, who asked him to extract the arrow from his body and report the matter to his aged parents. The boy died immediately the arrow was taken out of his body

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका अपने द्वारा मुनिकुमारके वधसे दु:खी हुए उनके माता-पिताके विलाप और उनके दिये हुए शापका प्रसंग सुनाकर कौसल्याके समीप रोते-बिलखते हुए आधी रातके समय अपने प्राणोंको त्याग देना
topics.en: Dashrath continues to tell Kaushalya how, having sought the presence of the aged parents of the deceased, he apprised them of the sad incident and escorted them to the river bank, where their son lay dead; how, clasping the boy to their bosom, they both piteously wailed and offered libations of water to his spirit for its benefit; how, invested with an ethereal body, the spirit ascended to heaven while consoling the aged couple and finally how, having cursed the king that he too would meet his death in his agony of separation from his son, the ascetic couple gave up the ghost and attained the Supreme. Having thus related the story of his imprecation and loudly lamenting, the Emperor breathes his last with the thought of Shri Ram foremost in his mind

topics.hi: वन्दीजनोंका स्तुतिपाठ, राजा दशरथको दिवंगत हुआ जान उनकी रानियोंका करुण विलाप
topics.en: When the Emperor did not wake up even though roused by means of panegyrics sung by bards, accompanied by musical instruments played upon for the same purpose, the ladies of the gynaeceum conclude by other means that the king is dead; and soon after commences the loud wail of Kaushalya, Sumitra and other queens

topics.hi: राजाके लिये कौसल्याका विलाप और कैकेयीकी भर्त्सना, मन्त्रियोंका राजाके शवको तेलसे भरे हुए कड़ाहमें सुलाना, रानियोंका विलाप, पुरीकी श्रीहीनता और पुरवासियोंका शोक
topics.en: Resting the head of the lifeless monarch in her own lap and severely reproaching Kaikeyi, Kaushalya grievously mourns for Shri Ram and other exiles. Holding back Kaushalya—who was lamenting with her arms placed round her deceased husband’s bosom— and consigning the Emperor’s dead body to a trough filled with oil, the ministers and other functionaries return each to his own abode in the evening

topics.hi: मार्कण्डेय आदि मुनियों तथा मन्त्रियोंका राजाके बिना होनेवाली देशकी दुरवस्थाका वर्णन करके वसिष्ठजीसे किसीको राजा बनानेके लिये अनुरोध
topics.en: Attributing the rise and fall of a kingdom to the presence and disappearance of its ruler, Markandey and other great sages, who attended the king’s court the following day, urge Vashishtha to install any of the princes on the throne immediately

topics.hi: वसिष्ठजीकी आज्ञासे पाँच दूतोंका अयोध्यासे केकयदेशके राजगृह नगरमें जाना
topics.en: With the concurrence of Markandey and other sages, Vashishtha despatches messengers to call back Bharat and Shatrughna from their maternal grandfather’s. They leave forthwith for the capital of Kekay and quickly enter that city

topics.hi: भरतकी चिन्ता, मित्रोंद्वारा उन्हें प्रसन्न करनेका प्रयास तथा उनके पूछनेपर भरतका मित्रोंके समक्ष अपने देखे हुए भयंकर दु:स्वप्नका वर्णन करना
topics.en: Finding Bharat oppressed and sad, his friends try to beguile him by means of music and narration of stories. But when the prince does not return to his normal mood even then, they inquire of him as to what makes him pensive and Bharat tells them how he saw a bad dream the previous night

topics.hi: दूतोंका भरतको उनके नाना और मामाके लिये उपहारकी वस्तुएँ अर्पित करना और वसिष्ठजीका संदेश सुनाना, भरतका पिता आदिकी कुशल पूछना और नानासे आज्ञा तथा उपहारकी वस्तुएँ पाकर शत्रुघ्नके साथ अयोध्याकी ओर प्रस्थान करना
topics.en: While Bharat was narrating to his friends the dream seen by him the previous night, the messengers from Ayodhya arrive in his presence and, bowing low to Bharat, communicate to him the orders of Sage Vashishtha. Having heard of the welfare of all from the mouth of the messengers, the prince takes leave of his maternal grandfather and others and departs for Ayodhya

topics.hi: रथ और सेनासहित भरतकी यात्रा, विभिन्न स्थानोंको पार करके उनका उज्जिहाना नगरीके उद्यानमें पहुँचना और सेनाको धीरे-धीरे आनेकी आज्ञा दे स्वयं रथद्वारा तीव्र वेगसे आगे बढ़ते हुए सालवनको पार करके अयोध्याके निकट जाना, वहाँसे अयोध्याकी दुरवस्था देखते हुए आगे बढ़ना और सारथिसे अपना दु:खपूर्ण उद्गार प्रकट करते हुए राजभवनमें प्रवेश करना
topics.en: When Bharat reaches Ayodhya after crossing many streams and rivers and passing through different territories and finds the city cheerless and wearing a deserted look, he sets about brooding and speculating as to what may be the reason for this and, speaking to the charioteer about it, enters the palace dejected and disconsolate
