topics.hi: भरतका कैकेयीके भवनमें जाकर उसे प्रणाम करना, उसके द्वारा पिताके परलोकवासका समाचार पा दु:खी हो विलाप करना तथा श्रीरामके विषयमें पूछनेपर कैकेयीद्वारा उनका श्रीरामके वनगमनके वृत्तान्तसे अवगत होना
topics.en: Entering his father’s apartments and not finding him there, Bharat moves to his mother’s apartments and, having communicated to her the welfare of his maternal grandfather and others on being questioned by her, inquires of her the whereabouts of his father. Kaikeyi then breaks to him the news of his father’s death, attributing it to Shri Ram’s exile and holding herself responsible for the latter, and after comforting him calls upon him to get himself installed on the throne after finishing his father’s obsequies

topics.hi: भरतका कैकेयीको धिक्कारना और उसके प्रति महान् रोष प्रकट करना
topics.en: Bitterly reproaching Kaikeyi in many ways, and cutting her to the quick by his caustic remarks, Bharat takes a vow before her to bring back Shri Ram from the forest, install him on the throne of Ayodhya and wait upon him as an attendant to offend her

topics.hi: भरतका कैकेयीको कड़ी फटकार देना
topics.en: Severely reproaching his mother once more, and making up his mind not only to bring back Shri Ram from the forest and crown him king, but also to go into exile for fourteen years in order to redeem his elder brother’s vow; Bharat, who is filled with rage at the thought of the mischief wrought by his mother, cannot contain his grief and falls unconscious on the ground

topics.hi: कौसल्याके सामने भरतका शपथ खाना
topics.en: Swearing that what had already come to pass in the shape of exile of Shri Ram, Sita and Lakshman and the resultant death of the King-Emperor was not to his liking, Bharat moves with Shatrughna to the apartments of his stepmother, Kaushalya, who speaks unkindly to him taunting him with the remark that his mother, Kaikeyi, had rendered good offices to him by securing for him the kingdom of Kosal, sought after by him. Bharat, however, politely denies on a number of oaths all complicity in the machinations of his vile mother. Thereby coming to know of his heart, the guileless Kaushalya places Bharat on her lap and weeps bitterly

topics.hi: राजा दशरथका अन्त्येष्टिसंस्कार
topics.en: Removing his father’s dead body from the vessel full of oil and cremating it with the help of articles befitting an Emperor, and offering libations of water to the spirit of the deceased on the bank of the Sarayu, as enjoined by Vashishtha, Bharat returns to Ayodhya

topics.hi: भरतका पिताके श्राद्धमें ब्राह्मणोंको बहुत धन-रत्न आदिका दान देना, तेरहवें दिन अस्थि-संचयका शेष कार्य पूर्ण करनेके लिये पिताकी चिताभूमिपर जाकर भरत और शत्रुघ्नका विलाप करना और वसिष्ठ तथा सुमन्त्रका उन्हें समझाना
topics.en: Having performed with the help of Shatrughna all the obsequial rites relating to his deceased father on the twelfth day after his death, Bharat gifts to the Brahmins abundant gold and jewels as a part of the obsequies. Overwhelmed with grief on reaching the funeral pile in order to pick up the principal bones of the deceased on the thirteenth day, the prince drops to the ground. Rolling on the ground, Shatrughna for his part wails in profusion. Comforted by Vashishtha and Sumantra, the two brothers urge the ministers to expedite the work of picking up the bones

topics.hi: शत्रुघ्नका रोष, उनका कुब्जाको घसीटना और भरतजीके कहनेसे उसे मूर्च्छित अवस्थामें छोड़ देना
topics.en: While Bharat is contemplating to undertake a journey to meet Shri Ram, Shatrughna blames Lakshman for failing to restrain his father and forcibly prevent Shri Ram’s exile. In the meantime Bharat catches sight of Manthara standing at the door decked with ornaments and points to her as the root of all mischief. Shatrughna thereupon pounces upon the maidservant standing in the midst of her companions and, seizing her by her locks, drags her on the floor and reproaches Kaikeyi too. On the latter pleading for mercy on Manthara’s behalf, Bharat intervenes and Shatrughna lets her go

topics.hi: मन्त्री आदिका भरतसे राज्य ग्रहण करनेके लिये प्रस्ताव तथा भरतका अभिषेक-सामग्रीकी परिक्रमा करके श्रीरामको ही राज्यका अधिकारी बताकर उन्हें लौटा लानेके लिये चलनेके निमित्त व्यवस्था करनेकी सबको आज्ञा देना
topics.en: On the fourteenth day the foremost of counsellors entreat Bharat to accept the throne. Turning down their entreaty, Bharat, who is keen to bring Shri Ram back to Ayodhya, urges them to detail expert engineers to construct a road, bridges and causeways etc., to facilitate his journey to the place of Shri Ram’s abode

topics.hi: अयोध्यासे गङ्गातटतक सुरम्य शिविर और कूप आदिसे युक्त सुखद राजमार्गका निर्माण
topics.en: The engineers detailed by Bharat’s ministers construct a broad passage from Ayodhya to the bank of the Ganga and render it easy to tread by erecting pavilions and digging wells here and there on the roadside

topics.hi: प्रात:कालके मङ्गलवाद्य-घोषको सुनकर भरतका दु:खी होना और उसे बंद कराकर विलाप करना, वसिष्ठजीका सभामें आकर मन्त्री आदिको बुलानेके लिये दूत भेजना
topics.en: The king’s bards, panegyrists and minstrels having commenced eulogizing Bharat in the customary way in the midst of festal music at sunrise the following morning, Bharat stops it, disclaiming sovereignty, and complains to Shatrughna of the ill—turn done to the world by his own mother. In the meantime Sage Vashishtha enters the royal court and sends messengers to Bharat urging him to be present in the court; and in response to his call Bharat, accompanied by Shatrughna and others, enters the assembly

topics.hi: वसिष्ठजीका भरतको राज्यपर अभिषिक्त होनेके लिये आदेश देना तथा भरतका उसे अनुचित बताकर अस्वीकार करना और श्रीरामको लौटा लानेके लिये वनमें चलनेकी तैयारीके निमित्त सबको आदेश देना
topics.en: Sage Vashishtha urges Bharat to accept the kingdom bequeathed to him by his father and elder brother. Bharat, however, scornfully declines the offer and takes a solemn pledge to depart for the forest and try his level best to bring his elder brother back to Ayodhya. At his instance Sumantra gets a chariot ready to take him to the forest and brings the chariot to his presence

topics.hi: भरतकी वनयात्रा और श्रृङ्गवेरपुरमें रात्रिवास
topics.en: Leaving the capital early next morning, accompanied by the family-priests, artisans, army and the citizens, and covering a long distance, Bharat reaches the bank of the holy Ganga at Shringverpur ruled by Guha and, encamping the army, breaks journey in order to do Shraddh and Tarpan in honour of his deceased father on the bank of the Ganga and also to give rest to his followers

topics.hi: निषादराज गुहका अपने बन्धुओंको नदीकी रक्षा करते हुए युद्धके लिये तैयार रहनेका आदेश दे भेंटकी सामग्री ले भरतके पास जाना और उनसे आतिथ्य स्वीकार करनेके लिये अनुरोध करना
topics.en: Scenting mischief in the mind of Bharat, who was taking a large army with him, Guha orders the ferrymen to guard the boats so as to prevent Bharat’s men from crossing the Ganga, and himself seeks the presence of Bharat in order to know his mind. Being satisfied about his good intention, he entertains Bharat and his men with fruits and roots etc., brought by him and, on his having taken rest awhile and overcome his fatigue, allows him to advance

topics.hi: गुह और भरतकी बातचीत तथा भरतका शोक
topics.en: Highly praising Guha, Bharat, while departing, inquires of him the way to the hermitage of Bharadwaj. Promising to follow the prince as a guide with his servants and placing his misgivings before him, Guha seeks to know his intentions about Shri Ram and consoles the prince, who was constantly bewailing till dusk

topics.hi: निषादराज गुहके द्वारा लक्ष्मणके सद्भाव और विलापका वर्णन
topics.en: Guha reports to Bharat how Shri Ram and his party broke their journey at Shringverpur and reproduces before him the dialogue that took place between Lakshman and himself at night and further tells him how the two brothers entangled their locks into a thick mass, crossed the holy river with Sita and left for the hermitage of Sage Bharadwaj

topics.hi: भरतकी मूर्च्छासे गुह, शत्रुघ्न और माताओंका दु:खी होना, होशमें आनेपर भरतका गुहसे श्रीराम आदिके भोजन और शयन आदिके विषयमें पूछना और गुहका उन्हें सब बातें बताना
topics.en: Overwhelmed with grief to hear from the mouth of Guha how his two brothers got their hair entangled into a mass, Bharat falls unconscious on the ground. On regaining consciousness, he despatches Guha to reassure mother Kaushalya, who is filled with apprehension about the safety of Shri Ram and his party on hearing of Bharat’s swoon, and apprise her of its real cause and also of Shri Ram’s welfare. While doing so Guha also tells her how Shri Ram and Sita lay down on a bed of Kush grass prepared by Lakshman with his own hands when the party broke journey at Shringverpur and how Guha with Lakshman kept watch the whole night for the protection of Shri Ram and Sita

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी कुश-शय्या देखकर भरतका शोकपूर्ण उद्गार तथा स्वयं भी वल्कल और जटाधारण करके वनमें रहनेका विचार प्रकट करना
topics.en: Showing to Kaushalya and others the bed of Kush grass on which Shri Ram and Sita spent their night, and contrasting it with the royal splendour and luxury in which he lived in Ayodhya, Bharat laments for him and, holding himself responsible for this turn of events and complimenting Lakshman and Sita for throwing their lot with Shri Ram and sharing his privations, makes up his mind henceforth to dwell in the forest as a representative of Shri Ram, wearing matted locks on his head like him

topics.hi: भरतका सेनासहित गङ्गापार करके भरद्वाजके आश्रमपर जाना
topics.en: Having encamped his followers including the army, that were ferried across the Ganga by the fishermen enjoined by Guha, Bharat sets out with Sage Vashishtha and others to the hermitage of Sage Bharadwaj with intent to see the latter

topics.hi: भरत और भरद्वाज मुनिकी भेंट एवं बातचीत तथा मुनिका अपने आश्रमपर ही ठहरनेका आदेश देना
topics.en: Leaving his party a couple of miles away on this side of the hermitage, Bharat enters it with Vashishtha and Shatrughna. After exchange of compliments between Sages Vashishtha and Bharadwaj, Bharat bows down at the feet of the latter, who inquires of his health and seeks to know his mind about Shri Ram. Bharat thereupon remorsefully apprises him of his intention to bring Ram back from the forest and questions him about his whereabouts. To this the sage replies that Shri Ram was sojourning on Mount Chitrakoot, and advises Bharat to see the latter the following morning

topics.hi: भरद्वाज मुनिके द्वारा सेनासहित भरतका दिव्य सत्कार
topics.en: The hospitality shown by Sage Bharadwaj, who had acquired rare mystic powers by virtue of his austerities, to Bharat, his army and entourage, the kind of which could not be shown even by a ruler of the entire globe

topics.hi: भरतका भरद्वाज मुनिसे जानेकी आज्ञा लेते हुए श्रीरामके आश्रमपर जानेका मार्ग जानना और मुनिको अपनी माताओंका परिचय देकर वहाँसे चित्रकूटके लिये सेनासहित प्रस्थान करना
topics.en: Questioned with folded hands about the road to Chitrakoot, Bharadwaj shows the way to Bharat and then inquires of him about the names of his three mothers, who stood bowing down to the sage. Having told him the names of all the three of his mothers with the history of each, and commanding the army to get ready for the journey ahead, Bharat proceeds to Chitrakoot with his retinue

topics.hi: सेनासहित भरतकी चित्रकूट-यात्राका वर्णन
topics.en: Setting his foot on the soil of Chitrakoot with his army and camp-followers, and identifying the place with the help of the features pointed out by Bharadwaj, Bharat commands the army men to look out for the hermitage of Shri Ram. Pursuing their search they perceive smoke at some distance and concluding the site to be the hermitage of Shri Ram, Bharat enjoins his army to halt and makes up his mind to walk with Vashishtha and others to that place

topics.hi: श्रीरामका सीताको चित्रकूटकी शोभा दिखाना
topics.en: Diverting his own mind and seeking to please Sita, Shri Ram gives a graphic description of Chitrakoot, stressing the special features

topics.hi: श्रीरामका सीताके प्रति मन्दाकिनी नदीकी शोभाका वर्णन
topics.en: In order to humour Sita, Shri Ram gives a description of the river Mandakini to her

topics.hi: वन-जन्तुओंके भागनेका कारण जाननेके लिये श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे लक्ष्मणका शाल-वृक्षपर चढ़कर भरतकी सेनाको देखना और उनके प्रति अपना रोषपूर्ण उद्गार प्रकट करना
topics.en: While recreating himself in the company of Sita on the lovely hills of Chitrakoot, Shri Ram beholds all of a sudden a large cloud of dust screening the sun and hears a loud noise and despatches Lakshman to ascertain the cause. Lakshman thereupon climbs up the top of a lofty tree and catching sight of an army with the chariot of its leader distinguished by an ensign bearing the device of a Kovidar tree, hastily concludes that Bharat has come all the way to dispose of Shri Ram and thereby to make himself secure on the throne of Ayodhya. Returning apace to the presence of Shri Ram he disburdens himself of his suspicions and speaks angrily about Bharat, swearing that he will kill the intruder

topics.hi: श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणके रोषको शान्त करके भरतके सद्भावका वर्णन करना, लक्ष्मणका लज्जित हो श्रीरामके पास खड़ा होना और भरतकी सेनाका पर्वतके नीचे छावनी डालना
topics.en: Pointing out to Lakshman who was waxing indignant at Bharat, the impropriety of killing the latter, Shri Ram pacifies him by assuring him of the pious intentions of Bharat. Ashamed of himself to hear the opinion of his brother about Bharat, and climbing down the tree, Lakshman hides his shame by changing the topic. Commanded by Bharat, who was anxious to avoid causing disturbance to the hermitage occupied by Shri Ram, the army encamps roundabout Chitrakoot

topics.hi: भरतके द्वारा श्रीरामके आश्रमकी खोजका प्रबन्ध तथा उन्हें आश्रमका दर्शन
topics.en: Telling off Guha and Shatrughna with their followers to find out the hermitage of Shri Ram, Bharat himself, who was keen to see Shri Ram, goes out in search of his hermitage with the ministers, walking all the way and envying the good fortune of Sita and Lakshman, who were living with Shri Ram; and reaching the foot of a sal tree and concluding the place from the presence of smoke nearby to be a human habitation and ruling out the possibility of any other human being living in that lonely forest, he eagerly hastens forward in the hope of meeting Shri Ram

topics.hi: भरतका शत्रुघ्न आदिके साथ श्रीरामके आश्रमपर जाना, उनकी पर्णशालाको देखना तथा रोते-रोते उनके चरणोंमें गिर जाना, श्रीरामका उन सबको हृदयसे लगाना और मिलना
topics.en: Requesting Vashishtha to fetch his mothers and pressing forward, Bharat reaches the hut, made of leafy twigs, in which the three exiles were living. While attempting to hail Shri Ram, Sita and Lakshman on seeing them, he stumbles down even on an even ground, his eyes getting bedimmed with tears at the sight of their ascetic garb. Shri Ram hastens to lift him up and clasps him to his bosom. Sumantra and Guha as well meet Shri Ram and Lakshman

topics.hi: श्रीरामका भरतको कुशल-प्रश्नके बहाने राजनीतिका उपदेश करना
topics.en: Placing Bharat on his lap, Shri Ram gives him instruction in judicature under the pretext of inquiring after the welfare of his father and others

topics.hi: श्रीरामका भरतसे वनमें आगमनका प्रयोजन पूछना, भरतका उनसे राज्य ग्रहण करनेके लिये कहना और श्रीरामका उसे अस्वीकार कर देना
topics.en: Questioned as to what made him give up the sovereignty of Ayodhya and enter the forest in the garb of an ascetic, Bharat reproaches his mother and implores his elder brother to accept the kingship and return to Ayodhya. Shri Ram, however, pleads that the command of their father is supreme and must be implicitly obeyed by both of them, the first part of it enjoining the exile of the elder brother being binding on him and the second part bequeathing the kingdom to Bharat being binding on the latter

topics.hi: भरतका पुन: श्रीरामसे राज्य ग्रहण करनेका अनुरोध करके उनसे पिताकी मृत्युका समाचार बताना
topics.en: Bharat tells Shri Ram that, having been deprived of the privilege of serving his elder brother, he will have nothing to do with sovereignty and requests him to offer water to the spirit of his deceased father, who died with the thought of Shri Ram alone foremost in his mind, and further implores him to get himself consecrated for the sovereignty of Ayodhya, the obsequies of their imperial father having been duly performed by the two brothers, Bharat and Shatrughna, at Ayodhya

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिका विलाप, पिताके लिये जलाञ्जलि-दान, पिण्डदान और रोदन
topics.en: Fallen into a swoon to hear of his father’s ascent to heaven and brought back to consciousness by Bharat and others, who sprinkle water on him and employ other such devices, Shri Ram laments in various ways. Comforted by Bharat and having in his turn consoled Sita and repairing to the bank of the Ganga, nay, offering water and balls of cooked food to the spirit of his departed father, he returns to his hut. Hearing their cry of distress, the troops approach them and are greeted by Shri Ram according to their rank

topics.hi: वसिष्ठजीके साथ आती हुई कौसल्याका मन्दाकिनीके तटपर सुमित्रा आदिके समक्ष दु:खपूर्ण उद्गार, श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीताके द्वारा माताओंकी चरणवन्दना तथा वसिष्ठजीको प्रणाम करके श्रीराम आदिका सबके साथ बैठना
topics.en: Accompanied by Kaushalya and others, Sage Vashishtha proceeds to the hermitage of Shri Ram. Showing to her co-wives the lumps of the pulp of the Ingudi fruit offered to the spirit of his deceased father by Shri Ram on blades of Kush grass placed with their ends pointing to the south along the bank of the Mandakini on the way, Kaushalya grieves for her deceased husband. Reaching the hermitage, Kaushalya and others see the two brothers, Shri Ram and Lakshman, fall at their feet. Kaushalya bewails the lot of Sita when the latter falls at her feet. Bowing down at the feet of his preceptor, Shri Ram takes his seat. Accompanied by the counsellors, Bharat too sits nearby

topics.hi: भरतका श्रीरामको अयोध्यामें चलकर राज्य ग्रहण करनेके लिये कहना, श्रीरामका जीवनकी अनित्यता बताते हुए पिताकी मृत्युके लिये शोक न करनेका भरतको उपदेश देना और पिताकी आज्ञाका पालन करनेके लिये ही राज्य ग्रहण न करके वनमें रहनेका ही दृढ़ निश्चय बताना
topics.en: Bharat implores Shri Ram to oblige him by accepting the throne of Ayodhya being offered by him to Shri Ram with the concurrence of Kaikeyi, even though bestowed on him by their deceased father. Consoling Bharat, who held himself responsible for Shri Ram’s exile to the forest and was languishing with sorrow on that score, Shri Ram, however, tries to pacify him in various ways and urges him to shoulder the burden of rulership

topics.hi: भरतकी पुन: श्रीरामसे अयोध्या लौटने और राज्य ग्रहण करनेकी प्रार्थना
topics.en: Imploring Shri Ram with cogent reasons to accept the throne of Ayodhya, Bharat takes a vow not to return to Ayodhya but to continue in the forest in case Shri Ram does not grant his prayer. Mother Kaushalya and others too join Bharat and urge Shri Ram to grant his request when they find Shri Ram adamant in the matter and insistent on implementing the words of their deceased father

topics.hi: श्रीरामका भरतको समझाकर उन्हें अयोध्या जानेका आदेश देना
topics.en: Shri Ram tries to impress upon Bharat, who believed that Dashrath was prompted by lustful attachment to his mother in making over the kingdom to him, that Dashrath was compelled to do so because, in the first place, he had promised to Kaikeyi’s father while marrying her that the latter’s son alone would succeed to the throne after Dashrath’s death, and secondly he was keen to repay the debt he owed to her for having come to his rescue in his encounter with the demons, and accordingly urges Bharat to assume the rulership of Ayodhya

topics.hi: जाबालिका नास्तिकोंके मतका अवलम्बन करके श्रीरामको समझाना
topics.en: Bharat having been silenced by Shri Ram, an eminent sage, Jabali by name, tries to persuade Shri Ram to accept the throne by advocating the theory of the Nastikas (non-believers) with intent to arouse in him the lust of sovereignty

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा जाबालिके नास्तिक मतका खण्डन करके आस्तिक मतका स्थापन
topics.en: Jabali explains the reasons for his advocating the theory of Nastikas to Shri Ram, who exposes the hollowness of the ethics propounded by the sage, dubbing it as the very antithesis of Dharma

topics.hi: वसिष्ठजीका सृष्टिपरम्पराके साथ इक्ष्वाकुकुलकी परम्परा बताकर ज्येष्ठके ही राज्याभिषेकका औचित्य सिद्ध करना और श्रीरामसे राज्य ग्रहण करनेके लिये कहना
topics.en: Pacifying Shri Ram, who had got angry with Jabali, Sage Vashishtha urges him to get himself consecrated as king since from Ikshvaku, the progenitor of his race, downward the eldest son alone had ascended the throne of Ayodhya and because he was not only the eldest of his father’s sons, but the ablest too

topics.hi: वसिष्ठजीके समझानेपर भी श्रीरामको पिताकी आज्ञाके पालनसे विरत होते न देख भरतका धरना देनेको तैयार होना तथा श्रीरामका उन्हें समझाकर अयोध्या लौटनेकी आज्ञा देना
topics.en: Pleading the superiority of a teacher in comparison to one’s parents, Sage Vashishtha by virtue of his superiority and as a concession to Bharat, a dependant of Shri Ram, whose vow it has been to respect the feelings of his dependants, urges Shri Ram to grant the prayer of Bharat. Shri Ram, however, contends that one’s parents are more worthy of respect even than one’s teacher and is accordingly insistent on implementing the pledge already given by him to his father. Thus discomfited in argument, Bharat makes up his mind to undertake a fast unto death as a last resort to exert pressure on him. On Shri Ram’s dubbing such a step as repugnant to the code of conduct prescribed for a Kshatriya, Bharat requests his elder brother to allow him to remain in exile in the forest as the latter’s proxy. Shri Ram, however, rules out this proposition also as something preposterous, saying that one’s duty is entrusted to a proxy only on the former’s incapacity, which could not be predicated of him, and reaffirms his decision to enter Ayodhya only after fulfilling the pledge given to his father

topics.hi: ऋषियोंका भरतको श्रीरामकी आज्ञाके अनुसार लौट जानेकी सलाह देना, भरतका पुन: श्रीरामके चरणोंमें गिरकर चलनेकी प्रार्थना करना, श्रीरामका उन्हें समझाकर अपनी चरणपादुका देकर उन सबको विदा करना
topics.en: Collected in the heavens to hear the dialogue of Bharat and Shri Ram, heavenly beings applaud the two brothers. Having decided upon his course of action, Shri Ram turns his face towards his hut; while pleading his inability to protect the kingdom, now that his attempts to take Shri Ram back to Ayodhya had been frustrated, Bharat prays to Shri Ram for mercy once more. But when he comes to know that his elder brother cannot be made to swerve an inch from his vow, he places a new pair of wooden sandals decked with gold in front of his brother and requests him to place his feet on them. Readily acceding to his request, Shri Ram hands over the sandals to Bharat, who takes a vow before the former to enter the fire in case he did not return immediately on the expiry of his term of exile. Shri Ram confirms his vow and after embracing Bharat and Shatrughna and bidding good- bye to all with due respect according to the rank of each, enters his cottage

topics.hi: भरतका भरद्वाजसे मिलते हुए अयोध्याको लौट आना
topics.en: Departed back for Ayodhya alongwith Sage Vashishtha and others, Bharat pays his respects on the way to Sage Bharadwaj and, apprising him of what had happened at Chitrakoot and also of the pair of wooden sandals that he had received from Shri Ram as the latter’s representative, and proceeding further, crosses the rivers Ganga and Yamuna alongwith his followers. Departing from Shringverpur, he catches sight of Ayodhya and points out to Sumantra its gloomy appearance

topics.hi: भरतके द्वारा अयोध्याकी दुरवस्थाका दर्शन तथा अन्त:पुरमें प्रवेश करके भरतका दु:खी होना
topics.en: Valmiki portrays the gloomy appearance of Ayodhya with the help of a number of similes. Bharat enters his father’s palace with a heavy heart, speaking to Sumantra about the sorry spectacle which Ayodhya presented at the moment

topics.hi: भरतका नन्दिग्राममें जाकर श्रीरामकी चरणपादुकाओंको राज्यपर अभिषिक्त करके उन्हें निवेदनपूर्वक राज्यका सब कार्य करना
topics.en: Permitted by Vashishtha and accompanied by Shatrughna and others, when the queens had entered the gynaeceum, Bharat proceeds to Nandigram and, installing the wooden sandals of Shri Ram on the royal seat, himself puts on the garb of an ascetic and carries on the rule under orders ascribed to the sandals, holding the royal umbrella over them

topics.hi: वृद्ध कुलपतिसहित बहुत-से ऋषियोंका चित्रकूट छोड़कर दूसरे आश्रममें जाना
topics.en: Learning from outward signs that the ascetics who lived in the vicinity of Shri Ram were anxious to shift to some other forest, the latter asks them why they wished to leave the place. Being told in reply that they were being molested by Rakshasas under the leadership of Khar, he gives his consent and, sending them away with great respect, retires to his own hermitage

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिका अत्रिमुनिके आश्रमपर जाकर उनके द्वारा सत्कृत होना तथा अनसूयाद्वारा सीताका सत्कार
topics.en: Afraid of prolonging his stay at Chitrakoot because of many handicaps, Shri Ram leaves that mountain and, reaching the hermitage of Sage Atri, greets the aforesaid Rishi. Glorifying the ascetic life of his wife, Anasuya, the sage urges Ram to send his consort, Sita, to her. Kindly receiving the princess, who greeted the venerable old lady on reaching her, as instructed by her husband, Anasuya gives her instructions on the duties of a devoted wife

topics.hi: सीता-अनसूया-संवाद, अनसूयाका सीताको प्रेमोपहार देना तथा अनसूयाके पूछनेपर सीताका उन्हें अपने स्वयंवरकी कथा सुनाना
topics.en: At the end of her dialogue with Sita, Anasuya requests her to ask a boon and, highly pleased with her, the hermitess bestows heavenly flowers and ornaments on her. Urged by Anasuya, She relates to the hermitess the story of her marriage

topics.hi: अनसूयाकी आज्ञासे सीताका उनके दिये हुए वस्त्राभूषणोंको धारण करके श्रीरामजीके पास आना तथा श्रीराम आदिका रात्रिमें आश्रमपर रहकर प्रात:काल अन्यत्र जानेके लिये ऋषियोंसे विदा लेना
topics.en: Glorifying the evening shades, that had now fallen, Anasuya sends away Sita, decked with the ornaments bestowed on her by herself, to the presence of Shri Ram. To the latter, who was agreeably surprised to behold Sita resplendent with heavenly jewels, she relates how she received the jewels as a loving gift from the hermitess. Accepting the hospitality of the hermits and staying with them for the night, Shri Ram asks leave of them in the morning to proceed further and, following the route shown by the hermits, the princely party enters the Dandak forest

topics.hi: श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीताका तापसोंके आश्रममण्डलमें सत्कार
topics.en: Reception of Shri Ram, Lakshman and Sita in the hermitages of sages

topics.hi: वनके भीतर श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीतापर विराधका आक्रमण
topics.en: Viradh’s attack on Ram, Lakshman and Sita in the forest

topics.hi: विराध और श्रीरामकी बातचीत, श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा विराधपर प्रहार तथा विराधका इन दोनों भाइयोंको साथ लेकर दूसरे वनमें जाना
topics.en: Conversation between Ram and Viradh; Ram and Lakshman strike at him; he goes with them to another forest

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा विराधका वध
topics.en: Shri Ram and Lakshman kill Viradh

topics.hi: श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीताका शरभङ्ग मुनिके आश्रमपर जाना, देवताओंका दर्शन करना और मुनिसे सम्मानित होना तथा शरभङ्ग मुनिका ब्रह्मलोक-गमन
topics.en: Ram, Lakshman and Sita visit the hermitage of Sharbhang, see the deities, and are honoured by the sage. Sage Sharbhang ascends to Brahmalok

topics.hi: वानप्रस्थ मुनियोंका राक्षसोंके अत्याचारसे अपनी रक्षाके लिये श्रीरामचन्द्रजीसे प्रार्थना करना और श्रीरामका उन्हें आश्वासन देना
topics.en: The sages request Ram for protection from the molestations of the ogres and Ram assures them of it

topics.hi: सीता और भ्रातासहित श्रीरामका सुतीक्ष्णके आश्रमपर जाकर उनसे बातचीत करना तथा उनसे सत्कृत हो रातमें वहीं ठहरना
topics.en: Ram goes to Sutikshna together with Sita and Lakshman and stays with him during the night

topics.hi: प्रात:काल सुतीक्ष्णसे विदा ले श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण, सीताका वहाँसे प्रस्थान
topics.en: In the morning Ram, together with Lakshman and Sita, takes leave of Sutikshna and departs

topics.hi: सीताका श्रीरामसे निरपराध प्राणियोंको न मारने और अहिंसा-धर्मका पालन करनेके लिये अनुरोध
topics.en: Sita requests Ram not to kill innocent animals and to observe non-violence

topics.hi: श्रीरामका ऋषियोंकी रक्षाके लिये राक्षसोंके वधके निमित्त की हुई प्रतिज्ञाके पालनपर दृढ़ रहनेका विचार प्रकट करना
topics.en: Ram expresses his firmness in keeping the vow of killing the ogres for the protection of sages

topics.hi: पञ्चाप्सर तीर्थ एवं माण्डकर्णि मुनिकी कथा, विभिन्न आश्रमोंमें घूमकर श्रीराम आदिका सुतीक्ष्णके आश्रममें आना, वहाँ कुछ कालतक रहकर उनकी आज्ञासे अगस्त्यके भाई तथा अगस्त्यके आश्रमपर जाना तथा अगस्त्यके प्रभावका वर्णन
topics.en: The episode of Sage Mandakarni and the Panchapsar Lake. Ram visits several hermitages and returns to Sutikshna’s hermitage. From there he goes to the hermitage of Agastya

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिका अगस्त्यके आश्रममें प्रवेश, अतिथि-सत्कार तथा मुनिकी ओरसे उन्हें दिव्य अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंकी प्राप्ति
topics.en: Ram and others enter the hermitage of Agastya, enjoy his hospitality and receive divine missiles and weapons

topics.hi: महर्षि अगस्त्यका श्रीरामके प्रति अपनी प्रसन्नता प्रकट करके सीताकी प्रशंसा करना, श्रीरामके पूछनेपर उन्हें पञ्चवटीमें आश्रम बनाकर रहनेका आदेश देना तथा श्रीराम आदिका प्रस्थान
topics.en: Agastya advises Ram and others to stay in Panchavati

topics.hi: पञ्चवटीके मार्गमें जटायुका मिलना और श्रीरामको अपना विस्तृत परिचय देना
topics.en: Meeting with Jatayu

topics.hi: पञ्चवटीके रमणीय प्रदेशमें श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे लक्ष्मणद्वारा सुन्दर पर्णशालाका निर्माण तथा उसमें सीता और लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका निवास
topics.en: Ram, Sita and Lakshman dwell in a cottage built by Lakshman in Panchavati

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणके द्वारा हेमन्त ऋतुका वर्णन और भरतकी प्रशंसा तथा श्रीरामका उन दोनोंके साथ गोदावरी नदीमें स्नान
topics.en: Lakshman describes the early winter. Bath in Godavari

topics.hi: श्रीरामके आश्रममें शूर्पणखाका आना, उनका परिचय जानना और अपना परिचय देकर उनसे अपनेको भार्याके रूपमें ग्रहण करनेके लिये अनुरोध करना
topics.en: The arrival of Shurpanakha at the hermitage

topics.hi: श्रीरामके टाल देनेपर शूर्पणखाका लक्ष्मणसे प्रणययाचना करना, फिर उनके भी टालनेपर उसका सीतापर आक्रमण और लक्ष्मणका उसके नाक-कान काट लेना
topics.en: Lakshman lops the nose and ears of Shurpanakha

topics.hi: शूर्पणखाके मुखसे उसकी दुर्दशाका वृत्तान्त सुनकर क्रोधमें भरे हुए खरका श्रीराम आदिके वधके लिये चौदह राक्षसोंको भेजना
topics.en: Khar sends fourteen ogres with her for despatching Ram

topics.hi: श्रीरामद्वारा खरके भेजे हुए चौदह राक्षसोंका वध
topics.en: Ram kills the fourteen ogres

topics.hi: शूर्पणखाका खरके पास आकर उन राक्षसोंके वधका समाचार बताना और रामका भय दिखाकर उसे युद्धके लिये उत्तेजित करना
topics.en: Shurpanakha again goes to Khar

topics.hi: चौदह हजार राक्षसोंकी सेनाके साथ खर-दूषणका जनस्थानसे पञ्चवटीकी ओर प्रस्थान
topics.en: Khar and Dushan march towards Panchavati with an army of fourteen thousand ogres

topics.hi: भयंकर उत्पातोंको देखकर भी खरका उनकी परवा नहीं करना तथा राक्षस-सेनाका श्रीरामके आश्रमके समीप पहुँचना
topics.en: Evil omens to Khar. The army approaches Ram’s hermitage

topics.hi: श्रीरामका तात्कालिक शकुनोंद्वारा राक्षसोंके विनाश और अपनी विजयकी सम्भावना करके सीतासहित लक्ष्मणको पर्वतकी गुफामें भेजना और युद्धके लिये उद्यत होना
topics.en: Good omens to Ram. Ram prepares for the fight

topics.hi: राक्षसोंका श्रीरामपर आक्रमण और श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके द्वारा राक्षसोंका संहार
topics.en: The ogres attack Shri Ram, Ram kills them all

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा दूषणसहित चौदह सहस्र राक्षसोंका वध
topics.en: Ram kills all the fourteen thousand ogres including Dushan

topics.hi: त्रिशिराका वध
topics.en: Ram kills Trishira

topics.hi: खरके साथ श्रीरामका घोर युद्ध
topics.en: Shri Ram’s encounter with Khar

topics.hi: श्रीरामका खरको फटकारना तथा खरका भी उन्हें कठोर उत्तर देकर उनके ऊपर गदाका प्रहार करना और श्रीरामद्वारा उस गदाका खण्डन
topics.en: Exchange of hot words between Khar and Shri Ram

topics.hi: श्रीरामके व्यङ्ग करनेपर खरका उन्हें फटकारकर उनके ऊपर सालवृक्षका प्रहार करना, श्रीरामका उस वृक्षको काटकर एक तेजस्वी बाणसे खरको मार गिराना तथा देवताओं और महर्षियोंद्वारा श्रीरामकी प्रशंसा
topics.en: Ram kills Khar. Gods and sages applaud Him

topics.hi: रावणका अकम्पनकी सलाहसे सीताका अपहरण करनेके लिये जाना और मारीचके कहनेसे लङ्काको लौट आना
topics.en: Ravan goes over to take away Sita on the advice of Akampan and returns in deference to the advice of Marich

topics.hi: शूर्पणखाका लंकामें रावणके पास जाना
topics.en: Shurpanakha approaches Ravan in Lanka

topics.hi: शूर्पणखाका रावणको फटकारना
topics.en: Shurpanakha twits Ravan

topics.hi: रावणके पूछनेपर शूर्पणखाका उससे राम, लक्ष्मण और सीताका परिचय देते हुए सीताको भार्या बनानेके लिये उसे प्रेरित करना
topics.en: Shurpanakha instigates Ravan to abduct Sita

topics.hi: रावणका समुद्रतटवर्ती प्रान्तकी शोभा देखते हुए पुन: मारीचके पास जाना
topics.en: Ravan calls on Marich once more

topics.hi: रावणका मारीचसे श्रीरामके अपराध बताकर उनकी पत्नी सीताके अपहरणमें सहायताके लिये कहना
topics.en: Ravan tells Marich how he has been wronged by Ram and asks for his help in taking away Sita

topics.hi: मारीचका रावणको श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके गुण और प्रभाव बताकर सीताहरणके उद्योगसे रोकना
topics.en: Marich tries to dissuade Ravan from his purpose

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी शक्तिके विषयमें अपना अनुभव बताकर मारीचका रावणको उनका अपराध करनेसे मना करना
topics.en: Narrating his own experience of Shri Ram’s prowess, Marich asks Ravan not to provoke Shri Ram

topics.hi: मारीचका रावणको समझाना
topics.en: Marich tries to bring Ravan round

topics.hi: रावणका मारीचको फटकारना और सीताहरणके कार्यमें सहायता करनेकी आज्ञा देना
topics.en: Ravan reproaches Marich and commands him to help him in his mission

topics.hi: मारीचका रावणको विनाशका भय दिखाकर पुन: समझाना
topics.en: Once more Marich tries to deter Ravan from his purpose by picturing to him the disastrous consequences of his action

topics.hi: मारीचका सुवर्णमय मृगरूप धारण करके श्रीरामके आश्रमपर जाना और सीताका उसे देखना
topics.en: Assuming the form of a golden deer, Marich reaches the hermitage of Ram and is caught sight of by Sita

topics.hi: कपटमृगको देखकर लक्ष्मणका संदेह, सीताका उस मृगको जीवित या मृत अवस्थामें भी ले आनेके लिये श्रीरामको प्रेरित करना तथा श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणको समझा-बुझाकर सीताकी रक्षाका भार सौंपकर उस मृगको मारनेके लिये जाना
topics.en: Ram goes to hunt the deer at the persistent demand of Sita

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा मारीचका वध और उसके द्वारा सीता और लक्ष्मणके पुकारनेका शब्द सुनकर श्रीरामकी चिन्ता
topics.en: Ram kills Marich and feels concerned to hear his call to Sita and Lakshman

topics.hi: सीताके मार्मिक वचनोंसे प्रेरित होकर लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामके पास जाना
topics.en: Lashed with castigating remarks, Lakshman seeks the presence of Shri Ram

topics.hi: रावणका साधुवेषमें सीताके पास जाकर उनका परिचय पूछना और सीताका आतिथ्यके लिये उसे आमन्त्रित करना
topics.en: Ravan seeks the presence of Sita in the guise of a recluse; Sita invites him to accept her hospitality

topics.hi: सीताका रावणको अपना और पतिका परिचय देकर वनमें आनेका कारण बताना, रावणका उन्हें अपनी पटरानी बनानेकी इच्छा प्रकट करना और सीताका उसे फटकारना
topics.en: Sita tells Ravan about herself and her husband and also the reason of their coming to the forest. Ravan expresses his desire to make her his principal queen. Sita reproaches him

topics.hi: रावणके द्वारा अपने पराक्रमका वर्णन और सीताद्वारा उसको कड़ी फटकार
topics.en: Ravan boasts of his prowess and Sita twits him sharp

topics.hi: रावणद्वारा सीताका अपहरण, सीताका विलाप और उनके द्वारा जटायुका दर्शन
topics.en: Ravan takes away Sita; Sita wails and catches sight of Jatayu

topics.hi: जटायुका रावणको सीताहरणके दुष्कर्मसे निवृत्त होनेके लिये समझाना और अन्तमें युद्धके लिये ललकारना
topics.en: Jatayu tries to deter Ravan from his evil design and eventually challenges him to a duel

topics.hi: जटायु तथा रावणका घोर युद्ध और रावणके द्वारा जटायुका वध
topics.en: Jatayu’s encounter with Ravan; Ravan kills Jatayu

topics.hi: रावणद्वारा सीताका अपहरण
topics.en: Ravan carries away Sita

topics.hi: सीताका रावणको धिक्कारना
topics.en: Sita reproaches Ravan

topics.hi: सीताका पाँच वानरोंके बीच अपने भूषण और वस्त्रको गिराना, रावणका लङ्कामें पहुँचकर सीताको अन्त:पुरमें रखना तथा जनस्थानमें आठ राक्षसोंको गुप्तचरके रूपमें रहनेके लिये भेजना
topics.en: Sita throws her jewels and articles of wearing apparel in the midst of five monkeys; Reaching Lanka, Ravan keeps Sita in his gynaeceum and sends eight ogres to Janasthan for espionage

topics.hi: रावणका सीताको अपने अन्त:पुरका दर्शन कराना और अपनी भार्या बन जानेके लिये समझाना
topics.en: Ravan shows his gynaeceum to Sita and coaxes her to become his wife

topics.hi: सीताका श्रीरामके प्रति अपना अनन्य अनुराग दिखाकर रावणको फटकारना तथा रावणकी आज्ञासे राक्षसियोंका उन्हें अशोकवाटिकामें ले जाकर डराना
topics.en: Giving expression to her undivided love for Shri Ram, Sita reproaches Ravan, whereupon under his orders ogresses take her to the Ashok Garden and intimidate her

topics.hi: ब्रह्माजीकी आज्ञासे देवराज इन्द्रका निद्रासहित लङ्कामें जाकर सीताको दिव्य खीर अर्पित करना और उनसे विदा लेकर लौटना
topics.en: An Interpolated Canto* At the command of Brahma (the creator), Indra, the ruler of gods, goes to Lanka with Nidra and offers a heavenly menu in the form of milk boiled with rice and sugar to Sita

topics.hi: श्रीरामका लौटना, मार्गमें अपशकुन देखकर चिन्तित होना तथा लक्ष्मणसे मिलनेपर उन्हें उलाहना दे सीतापर सङ्कट आनेकी आशङ्का करना
topics.en: While returning to his hermitage Shri Ram feels concerned to perceive ill omens and on meeting Lakshman scolds him for leaving Sita unprotected and feels apprehensive about Sita’s safety

topics.hi: मार्गमें अनेक प्रकारकी आशङ्का करते हुए लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका आश्रममें आना और वहाँ सीताको न पाकर व्यथित होना
topics.en: Indulging in various speculations about the fate of Sita, Shri Ram with Lakshman arrives at his hermitage and is pained not to find Sita there

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी बातचीत
topics.en: Dialogue between Shri Ram and Lakshman

topics.hi: श्रीरामका विलाप करते हुए वृक्षों और पशुओंसे सीताका पता पूछना, भ्रान्त होकर रोना और बारंबार उनकी खोज करना
topics.en: Uttering a loud wail Shri Ram inquires of the trees the whereabouts of Sita, cries like one distracted and looks about for her again and again

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा सीताकी खोज और उनके न मिलनेसे श्रीरामकी व्याकुलता
topics.en: The quest of Shri Ram and Lakshman for Sita; not finding her, Shri Ram gets unnerved

topics.hi: श्रीरामका विलाप
topics.en: Ram’s Lament

topics.hi: श्रीरामका विलाप
topics.en: Shri Ram’s Lament Continue

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा सीताकी खोज, श्रीरामका शोकोद्गार, मृगोंद्वारा संकेत पाकर दोनों भाइयोंका दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर जाना, पर्वतपर क्रोध, सीताके बिखरे हुए फूल, आभूषणोंके कण और युद्धके चिह्न देखकर श्रीरामका देवता आदि सहित समस्त त्रिलोकीपर रोष प्रकट करना
topics.en: Shri Ram and Lakshman carry on the search for Sita; Shri Ram gives vent to his grief over her disappearance; catching a hint from the deer, the two brothers proceed in a southerly direction; Shri Ram shows his anger towards the mountain; descrying the flowers dropped from the person of Sita and particles of her ornaments as well as the vestiges of an encounter, Shri Ram ventilates his anger towards all the three worlds including gods

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामको समझा-बुझाकर शान्त करना
topics.en: Lakshman consoles Shri Ram

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामको समझाना
topics.en: Lakshman seeks to inspire Shri Ram with courage

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी पक्षिराज जटायुसे भेंट तथा श्रीरामका उन्हें गलेसे लगाकर रोना
topics.en: Shri Ram and Lakshman meet Jatayu and, embracing the vulture, Shri Ram bursts into a wail

topics.hi: जटायुका प्राण-त्याग और श्रीरामद्वारा उनका दाह-संस्कार
topics.en: Jatayu gives up the ghost and is cremated by Shri Ram

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका अयोमुखीको दण्ड देना तथा श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका कबन्धके बाहुबन्धमें पड़कर चिन्तित होना
topics.en: Lakshman punishes Ayomukhi. Falling a prey to the grip of Kabandh, Ram and Lakshman give way to anxiety

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका परस्पर विचार करके कबन्धकी दोनों भुजाओंको काट डालना तथा कबन्धके द्वारा उनका स्वागत
topics.en: After deliberation with each other, Shri Ram and Lakshman sever the arms of Kabandh, who extends his welcome to them

topics.hi: कबन्धकी आत्मकथा, अपने शरीरका दाह हो जानेपर उसका श्रीरामको सीताके अन्वेषणमें सहायता देनेका आश्वासन
topics.en: Kabandh narrates his story and gives assurance of help in the discovery of Sita after his cremation

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा चिताकी आगमें कबन्धका दाह तथा उसका दिव्य रूपमें प्रकट होकर उन्हें सुग्रीवसे मित्रता करनेके लिये कहना
topics.en: Appearing in his ethereal form when cremated by Shri Ram and Lakshman, Kabandh counsels them to make an alliance with Sugriv

topics.hi: दिव्य रूपधारी कबन्धका श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणको ऋष्यमूक और पम्पासरोवरका मार्ग बताना तथा मतङ्गमुनिके वन एवं आश्रमका परिचय देकर प्रस्थान करना
topics.en: Appearing in an ethereal form, Kabandh shows to Shri Ram and Lakshman the way to Rishyamook Hill and the Pampa Lake and, giving them information about the grove of Sage Matanga and his hermitage, takes leave of them

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका पम्पासरोवरके तटपर मतङ्गवनमें शबरीके आश्रमपर जाना, उसका सत्कार ग्रहण करना और उसके साथ मतङ्गवनको देखना, शबरीका अपने शरीरकी आहुति दे दिव्यधामको प्रस्थान करना
topics.en: Shri Ram and Lakshman visit the hermitage of Shabari on the brink of the Pampa in the forest named Matangvan, receive her hospitality and go round the forest with her. Casting her body into the sacred fire, Shabari ascends to the heavenly world

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी बातचीत तथा उन दोनों भाइयोंका पम्पासरोवरके तटपर जाना
topics.en: Shri Ram and Lakshman seek the brink of Pampa lake conversing together

topics.hi: पम्पासरोवरके दर्शनसे श्रीरामकी व्याकुलता, श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणसे पम्पाकी शोभा तथा वहाँकी उद्दीपनसामग्रीका वर्णन करना, लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामको समझाना तथा दोनों भाइयोंको ऋष्यमूककी ओर आते देख सुग्रीव तथा अन्य वानरोंका भयभीत होना
topics.en: When Shri Ram approached the Pampa lake, the sight of the lovely surroundings intensified his pangs of separation from Sita. Put in mind of Sita, he laments for her. Living with his ministers on the summit of the Rishyamook hill, Sugriv catches sight of the two princes and gets alarmed

topics.hi: सुग्रीव तथा वानरोंकी आशङ्का, हनुमान्जीद्वारा उसका निवारण तथा सुग्रीवका हनुमान्जीको श्रीराम-लक्ष्मणके पास उनका भेद लेनेके लिये भेजना
topics.en: Seeing the two princely brothers and suspecting them to have been sent by his elder brother, Vali, Sugriv goes into hiding with his counsellors. There Hanuman reassures him by recourse to reasoning. Sugriv then sends Hanuman to ascertain what was in the mind of the two princes

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणसे वनमें आनेका कारण पूछना और अपना तथा सुग्रीवका परिचय देना, श्रीरामका उनके वचनोंकी प्रशंसा करके लक्ष्मणको अपनी ओरसे बात करनेकी आज्ञा देना तथा लक्ष्मणद्वारा अपनी प्रार्थना स्वीकृत होनेसे हनुमान्जीका प्रसन्न होना
topics.en: Approaching in the guise of a mendicant Shri Ram and Lakshman and bowing low to them, Hanuman enquired of them as to who they were and, having narrated to them the story of Sugriv, apprised them of the latter’s anxiety to enlist their goodwill. Pleased with the cleverness of Hanuman, Shri Ram compliments the former on his knowledge of the Veda and grammar. With the approval of Shri Ram, Lakshman gives utterance to the former’s desire to secure Sugriv’s alliance

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका हनुमान्जीसे श्रीरामके वनमें आने और सीताजीके हरे जानेका वृत्तान्त बताना तथा इस कार्यमें सुग्रीवके सहयोगकी इच्छा प्रकट करना, हनुमान्जीका उन्हें आश्वासन देकर उन दोनों भाइयोंको अपने साथ ले जाना
topics.en: Hanuman inquires of Shri Ram the purpose of his visit to Pampa. Having narrated to Hanuman, as urged by Shri Ram, his life-story up to his separation from Sita, Lakshman tells him that cultivation of friendship with Sugriv, in pursuance of the advice of Kabandh, was the purpose of their visit to the Pampa. Observing that Sugriv was in a predicament similar to the one in which Shri Ram found himself placed and as such stood in need of Shri Ram’s sympathy and goodwill, Hanuman resumes his real form and, placing Shri Ram and Lakshman on his shoulders, reaches Rishyamook

topics.hi: श्रीराम और सुग्रीवकी मैत्री तथा श्रीरामद्वारा वालिवधकी प्रतिज्ञा
topics.en: Having presented himself before Sugriv on the Malay mountain and apprised him of his having brought the two scions of Raghu to Rishyamook, Hanuman narrates to him the story of the two princes. Pleased to hear this news and approaching Shri Ram in the form of a human being, Sugriv offers his hand for being clasped by Shri Ram as a token of friendship. Shri Ram responds by clasping it with his own and hugs him to his bosom. Their friendship having been solemnized in the presence of a fire, Sugriv narrates to him his tale of woe and requests Shri Ram to get rid of Vali, his hostile brother. Shri Ram promises this

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका श्रीरामको सीताजीके आभूषण दिखाना तथा श्रीरामका शोक एवं रोषपूर्ण वचन
topics.en: Telling Shri Ram that he had come to know from Hanuman all about his misfortune (in the shape of the abduction of his wife) and assuring him that he will have her traced out wherever she may be and restore her to him, Sugriv fetches from inside his cave an ornament tied in a corner of a silk wrapper and dropped by her from the air while being carried away by Ravan, and shows it to Shri Ram. Recognizing it as belonging to Sita alone, Shri Ram is plunged once more in grief born of separation from his beloved spouse and, violently hissing like a serpent, impatiently inquires who that Ravan was and where from he hailed

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका श्रीरामको समझाना तथा श्रीरामका सुग्रीवको उनकी कार्यसिद्धिका विश्वास दिलाना
topics.en: Consoled by Sugriv with the assurance that, even though ignorant of the abode of that vile ogre who bore away Sita, he would see that Shri Ram is reunited with her; Shri Ram compliments him and promises to kill Vali

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका श्रीरामसे अपना दु:ख निवेदन करना और श्रीरामका उन्हें आश्वासन देते हुए दोनों भाइयोंमें वैर होनेका कारण पूछना
topics.en: Congratulating himself as well as his near and dear ones on his having secured the friendship of Shri Ram, and sitting on a common bough alongwith the latter, Sugriv seeks protection from Vali. Dilating once more on the wrongs done to him by Vali in the shape of wresting his wife and so on, he solicits Vali’s death at the hands of Shri Ram. Asked to account for this hostile attitude of Vali, Sugriv proceeds to relate the circumstances which led to it

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका श्रीरामचन्द्रजीको वालीके साथ अपने वैर होनेका कारण बताना
topics.en: Sugriv tells Shri Ram how challenged to a duel at dead of night by a demon, Mayavi by name, who owed him a grudge on the score of a woman, Vali sallied forth with Sugriv and following at the heels of the demon, who ran away on seeing him, and reaching the mouth of a cave, asked Sugriv on oath to stay out, himself entering the cave. Since Vali did not come out for a whole year and as from a confused din coming out of the cave as well as from a stream of blood issuing from it, it was concluded that Vali had met his death at the hands of the demon, Sugriv closed the mouth of the cave with a rock and, offering water to the spirit of his deceased elder brother, returned to Kishkindha, where the ministers of Vali installed him on the latter’s throne in his absence. In the meantime Vali returned from the cave and reprimanded Sugriv for his having usurped Vali’s throne

topics.hi: भाईके साथ वैरका कारण बतानेके प्रसङ्गमें सुग्रीवका वालीको मनाने और वालीद्वारा अपने निष्कासित होनेका वृत्तान्त सुनाना
topics.en: While giving out the reasons of his hostility with Vali, Sugriv tells Shri Ram how in spite of his trying to pacify his elder brother, the latter exiled him

topics.hi: सुग्रीवके द्वारा वालीके पराक्रमका वर्णन— वालीका दुन्दुभि दैत्यको मारकर उसकी लाशको मतङ्गवनमें फेंरुकना, मतङ्गमुनिका वालीको शाप देना, श्रीरामका दुन्दुभिके अस्थिसमूहको दूर फेंरुकना और सुग्रीवका उनसे साल-भेदनके लिये आग्रह करना
topics.en: With a view to ascertaining Shri Ram’s actual strength, Sugriv expatiates on the prowess of Vali and tells him how Mayavi’s brother, the demon Dundubhi too challenged him to a duel and how, having made short work of him, Vali listlessly hurled his dead body crossing over to the precincts of the hermitage of Sage Matanga, and how the site of the hermitage having been desecrated with blood, spattered here and there from it’s mouth, Sage Matanga pronounced a curse forbidding the individual who had perpetrated the sacrilege to enter the hermitage on pain of death, thus enabling Sugriv to live unmolested in that retreat. In order to convince Sugriv of his superior might Shri Ram kicks the skeleton of Dundubhi away with his toe. Belittling this feat on the ground of the skeleton havng shrunk as a result of exposure, Sugriv further asks Shri Ram to pierce with his arrow one of the seven sal trees standing there and thus demonstrate his strength

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा सात साल-वृक्षोंका भेदन, श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे सुग्रीवका किष्किन्धामें आकर वालीको ललकारना और युद्धमें उससे पराजित होकर मतंगवनमें भाग जाना, वहाँ श्रीरामका उन्हें आश्वासन देना और गलेमें पहचानके लिये गजपुष्पीलता डालकर उन्हें पुन: युद्धके लिये भेजना
topics.en: Amazed to behold Shri Ram’s arrow re-enter his quiver after piercing all the seven sal trees and penetrating the bowels of the earth, and applauding Shri Ram, Sugriv implores him to make short work of Vali. Sending Sugriv to challenge Vali to a combat, Shri Ram sits in hiding behind a tree. When a passage at arms commenced with Vali who would not brook a challenge, Shri Ram did not hit Vali with an arrow because the two brothers so closely resembled each other that it was difficult for him to distinguish one from the other. The result was that Sugriv lost heart and ultimately taking to his heels, returned to Rishyamook. Explaining to Sugriv the reason of his failure to hit Vali, Shri Ram reassures Sugriv and encourages him to seek an encounter with Vali again. Urged by Shri Ram, Lakshman uproots a blossomed Gajapushpi creeper and ties it about the neck of Sugriv for identification

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिका मार्गमें वृक्षों, विविध जन्तुओं, जलाशयों तथा सप्तजन आश्रमका दूरसे दर्शन करते हुए पुन: किष्किन्धापुरीमें पहुँचना
topics.en: While going to Kishkindha alongwith Sugriv and others with intent to make short work of Vali, Shri Ram sees a delightful grove and inquires of Sugriv as to whose hermitage it was. Sugriv tells him in reply that the hermitage belonged to a group of sages known by the name of Saptajanas, who had bodily ascended to heaven

topics.hi: वाली-वधके लिये श्रीरामका आश्वासन पाकर सुग्रीवकी विकट गर्जना
topics.en: Shri Ram and others remain hiding behind the trees of a grove in the vicinity of Kishkindha, Sugriv implores Shri Ram to implement his vow of killing Vali. Assuring Sugriv that this will be done, Shri Ram encourages the latter to go and challenge his elder brother and Sugriv does accordingly

topics.hi: सुग्रीवकी गर्जना सुनकर वालीका युद्धके लिये निकलना और ताराका उसे रोककर सुग्रीव और श्रीरामके साथ मैत्री कर लेनेके लिये समझाना
topics.en: Angrily issuing forth for an encounter on hearing the roar of Sugriv, Vali is discouraged with cogent reasons by his wife, Tara

topics.hi: वालीका ताराको डाँटकर लौटाना और सुग्रीवसे जूझना तथा श्रीरामके बाणसे घायल होकर पृथ्वीपर गिरना
topics.en: Spurning the advice of Tara and reproaching her, Vali goes forth to meet Sugriv and there ensues a fierce encounter between the two brothers. When, however, Sugriv is found losing ground, Vali is struck with an arrow by Shri Ram and he falls to the ground

topics.hi: वालीका श्रीरामचन्द्रजीको फटकारना
topics.en: Still retaining his life and vital energy by virtue of the gold chain bestowed on him by Indra, though pierced in the breast with a deadly arrow, Vali indignantly reproaches Shri Ram in many ways

topics.hi: श्रीरामका वालीकी बातका उत्तर देते हुए उसे दिये गये दण्डका औचित्य बताना, वालीका निरुत्तर होकर भगवान्से अपने अपराधके लिये क्षमा माँगते हुए अङ्गदकी रक्षाके लिये प्रार्थना करना और श्रीरामका उसे आश्वासन देना
topics.en: Shri Ram justifies his action by saying that the punishment meted out to Vali in the form of taking his life was meet, having regard to the sin of depriving his own younger brother of his wedded wife, of which Vali was guilty. Repenting for his having reproached Shri Ram, Vali now seeks the latter’s forgiveness and requests him to take care of his son, Angad. Agreeing to do so, Shri Ram comforts Vali

topics.hi: अङ्गदसहित ताराका भागे हुए वानरोंसे बात करके वालीके समीप आना और उसकी दुर्दशा देखकर रोना
topics.en: Agonized with grief to hear about the death of her husband, Tara, wife of Vali, sallied forth from Kishkindha to arrive in the presence of Vali. Fleeing helter-skelter through fear of Shri Ram and meeting Tara on the way, the monkeys try to send her back inspiring fear in her and advise her to make arrangements for the defence of the city and install Angad on the throne. Rushing to the scene of contest after dismissing them, Tara catches sight of Vali lying on the ground, as well as of Shri Ram and others

topics.hi: ताराका विलाप
topics.en: Clasping Vali to her bosom and wailing piteously for the sake of Angad, Tara resolves upon a fast unto death

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका ताराको समझाना और ताराका पतिके अनुगमनका ही निश्चय करना
topics.en: Comforting Tara, who was lamenting through a variety of expressions, Hanuman urges her to have the obsequies performed in respect of the departed soul by Angad and attend to the earthly good of Angad. Tara, however, refuses to flinch from her resolve and prefers to follow her husband to the other world rather than bestow any thought on the earthly welfare of her son

topics.hi: वालीका सुग्रीव और अङ्गदसे अपने मनकी बात कहकर प्राणोंको त्याग देना
topics.en: Craving the forgiveness of Sugriv, though he was younger than he, and applauding the resolve of Tara (to follow her husband), nay, urging Sugriv to follow the advice of Tara, look after Angad affectionately and accomplish the purpose of Shri Ram, Vali asks Sugriv to take off the gold chain from the former’s neck, and gives up the ghost while tendering wholesome advice to Angad. Extolling the wonderful exploits of Vali, hordes of monkeys lament in many ways. Stricken with agony caused by separation from Vali, Tara falls to the ground, embracing Vali

topics.hi: ताराका विलाप
topics.en: Though endeavouring, after smelling Vali’s face, to embrace him, Tara finds herself unable to do so, bathed as he was in blood and daubed with dust. Neel pulls out Shri Ram’s arrow from his heart and, urged by Tara, Angad bows down at his feet

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका शोकमग्न होकर श्रीरामसे प्राणत्यागके लिये आज्ञा माँगना, ताराका श्रीरामसे अपने वधके लिये प्रार्थना करना और श्रीरामका उसे समझाना
topics.en: Beseeching Angad and others to conduct the search for Sita, Sugriv, whose heart melted to hear the laments of Tara, seeks Shri Ram’s permission to enter fire to atone for Vali’s death, making Shri Ram sad. Approaching Shri Ram in her turn, Tara extols him with devotion and expresses her intention to give up the ghost, on which Shri Ram expostulates with her and urges her to survive for the earthly good of Angad

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका सुग्रीव, तारा और अङ्गदको समझाना तथा वालीके दाह-संस्कारके लिये आज्ञा प्रदान करना, फिर तारा आदिसहित सब वानरोंका वालीके शवको श्मशानभूमिमें ले जाकर अङ्गदके द्वारा उसका दाह-संस्कार कराना और उसे जलाञ्जलि देना
topics.en: Shri Ram consoles Sugriv and others. Entrusting Sugriv with the work of getting firewood for the cremation of Vali, Lakshman asks Tara to arrange for a palanquin to carry Vali in state to the crematory. Placing the dead body of Vali as commanded by Shri Ram on the palanquin brought by Tara, Sugriv and others carry the palanquin to the riverside and, taking it down on a sandy bank, prepare a pyre. Vanar women comfort Tara mourning the death of Vali with his head placed in her lap. Placing the dead body of Vali on the pyre, Angad sets fire to it. At the end of the cremation they all offer water to the spirit of the deceased and return to Shri Ram’s presence

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका सुग्रीवके अभिषेकके लिये श्रीरामचन्द्रजीसे किष्किन्धामें पधारनेकी प्रार्थना, श्रीरामका पुरीमें न जाकर केवल अनुमति देना, तत्पश्चात् सुग्रीव और अङ्गदका अभिषेक
topics.en: Requested by Hanuman to visit Kishkindha, Shri Ram declines to do so on the ground of his having been prohibited by his father to enter the limits of a village or town and, directing that Sugriv may be installed on the throne of Kishkindha and Angad may assume the office of Prince Regent, he himself takes a vow to live in a cave till the end of the monsoon and leaves instructions to initiate a search for Sita after the monsoon

topics.hi: प्रस्रवणगिरिपर श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी परस्पर बातचीत
topics.en: Arrived at a cave of Mount Prasravan and seeing the place suitable for his residence, Shri Ram takes up his abode there. One day when he is seized with anguish caused by his separation from Sita, Lakshman comforts him

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा वर्षा-ऋतुका वर्णन
topics.en: Even though unable to bear the cool weather during the monsoon, emaciated as he was due to the agony of his separation from Sita, and chatting with Lakshman on the unbearability of his said separation from Sita, Shri Ram describes the rainy season

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके समझानेसे सुग्रीवका नीलको वानर-सैनिकोंको एकत्र करनेका आदेश देना
topics.en: Recounting the virtues of Shri Ram to Sugriv, who had due to his love of the pleasures of sense forgotten all about Shri Ram’s business and was neglecting it even after the advent of autumn—and reminding him of the work of Shri Ram, Hanuman urges Sugriv to collect an army with a view to conducting a search for Sita. Awakened to a sense of his duty, Sugriv enjoins Neel to dispatch messengers to bring all the Vanar hordes together

topics.hi: शरद्-ऋतुका वर्णन तथा श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणको सुग्रीवके पास जानेका आदेश देना
topics.en: Glorifying Shri Ram as a hero, Lakshman comforts his brother who was wailing in many ways at the thought of Sita, his agony of separation from her having been accentuated by the sight of the autumnal full moon and the water-lilies opening their petals during the night, His heart being captured by the wealth of beauties of autumn, Shri Ram extols the autumnal season and seeing Sugriv inactive even during this season, sends Lakshman to whip the latter into activity

topics.hi: सुग्रीवपर लक्ष्मणका रोष, श्रीरामका उन्हें समझाना, लक्ष्मणका किष्किन्धाके द्वारपर जाकर अङ्गदको सुग्रीवके पास भेजना, वानरोंका भय तथा प्लक्ष और प्रभावका सुग्रीवको कर्तव्यका उपदेश देना
topics.en: Concluding from the angry words of Shri Ram that he was wroth against Sugriv, Lakshman gets ready to kill the latter. Pacifying Lakshman, Shri Ram, however, sends him to Sugriv with instructions to adopt a conciliatory attitude towards him. Reaching Kishkindha with a bow and arrow in hand and assuming an angry demeanour, Lakshman asks Angad to announce his arrival to Sugriv. Even when apprised of Lakshman’s arrival by Angad, Sugriv, who was drunk with wine, is unable to follow Angad and comes to realize the gravity of the situation only on hearing the clamour of the alarmed monkeys and on being awakened to the reality by two of his foremost ministers and implored by them to pacify Lakshman

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका चिन्तित हुए सुग्रीवको समझाना
topics.en: Seeing Sugriv dismayed to hear of Lakshman’s wrath from the mouth of Angad, Hanuman tells Sugriv that the delay in honouring the understanding arrived at with Shri Ram was at the root of the latter’s displeasure, and advises Sugriv to pacify Lakshman and initiate the search for Sita

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका किष्किन्धापुरीकी शोभा देखते हुए सुग्रीवके महलमें प्रवेश करके क्रोधपूर्वक धनुषको टंकारना, भयभीत सुग्रीवका ताराको उन्हें शान्त करनेके लिये भेजना तथा ताराका समझा-बुझाकर उन्हें अन्त:पुरमें ले आना
topics.en: Ushered into Kishkindha by Angad and others, Lakshman beholds stately mansions and other curios on both sides of the main road and, hearing the sound of vocal music accompanied by the sound of various musical instruments as well as the sweet jingling of anklets etc., coming from the palace of Sugriv, twangs his bowstring. Hearing the twang of his bow, Sugriv dispatches Tara to him and the latter tries to pacify Lakshman by apprising him of Sugriv having already sent his generalissimo Neel to collect all the monkey forces scattered here and there. His anger having been appeased to some extent by the news, he is led by Tara to the gynaeceum and sees Sugriv

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका लक्ष्मणके पास जाना और लक्ष्मणका उन्हें फटकारना
topics.en: Lakshman warns Sugriv to rectify his mistake in neglecting his duty of conducting a search for Sita, which amounted to ingratitude on his part, and not to follow the path of his elder brother, Vali

topics.hi: ताराका लक्ष्मणको युक्तियुक्त वचनोंद्वारा शान्त करना
topics.en: Consoling Lakshman, who was wroth against Sugriv, by showing reasons for the delay, Tara requests the former to compose himself, assuring him that everything will be accomplished

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका अपनी लघुता तथा श्रीरामकी महत्ता बताते हुए लक्ष्मणसे क्षमा माँगना और लक्ष्मणका उनकी प्रशंसा करके उन्हें अपने साथ चलनेके लिये कहना
topics.en: When Lakshman gets pacified by the conciliatory words of Tara, Sugriv glorifies Shri Ram and requests Lakshman to forgive his delinquency. Regaining his normal self, Lakshman too craves the forgiveness of Sugriv for the harsh language employed by him in a fit of anger and asks him to approach Shri Ram and beg his pardon

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका हनुमान्जीको वानरसेनाके संग्रहके लिये दोबारा दूत भेजनेकी आज्ञा देना, उन दूतोंसे राजाकी आज्ञा सुनकर समस्त वानरोंका किष्किन्धाके लिये प्रस्थान और दूतोंका लौटकर सुग्रीवको भेंट देनेके साथ ही वानरोंके आगमनका समाचार सुनाना
topics.en: Sugriv commands Hanuman to dispatch messengers for collecting troops from all the four quarters. Receiving the message of Sugriv, monkeys flock from all sides into his presence. Giving presents of fruits and roots etc., to their king, the messengers sent in advance by Neel, announce to him the arrival of all the monkey hordes

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणसहित सुग्रीवका भगवान् श्रीरामके पास आकर उनके चरणोंमें प्रणाम करना, श्रीरामका उन्हें समझाना, सुग्रीवका अपने किये हुए सैन्यसंग्रहविषयक उद्योगको बताना और उसे सुनकर श्रीरामका प्रसन्न होना
topics.en: Embracing Sugriv, who came all the way on a palanquin with Lakshman, and bowed down at Shri Ram’s feet, and offering him a seat, the latter instructs him in a nutshell in statecraft and reminds him of his business. Expressing his indebtedness to Shri Ram for the unique favour done to him and giving to him an account of the efforts made by him, Sugriv in his turn gratifies him by apprising him of the arrival of countless monkeys from all the parts of globe

topics.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्रजीका सुग्रीवके प्रति कृतज्ञता प्रकट करना तथा विभिन्न वानर-यूथपतियोंका अपनी सेनाओंके साथ आगमन
topics.en: While Shri Ram and Sugriv were deliberating with each other, Shatabali and other generals of the monkey army, followed by hordes of countless monkeys of various species, which covered the sky with the clouds of dust raised by them, arrive in their presence and bow down at their feet

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे सुग्रीवका सीताकी खोजके लिये पूर्व दिशामें वानरोंको भेजना और वहाँके स्थानोंका वर्णन करना
topics.en: Pointing out in pursuance of Shri Ram’s command to one of his generals, Vinata by name, the regions in the east which could be penetrated into by monkeys, detailing the tracts worthy of note, and entrusting him with the task of conducting a search for Sita in those regions, Sugriv enjoins the general to return within a month after the work, adding that anyone returning after a month will be punished

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका दक्षिण दिशाके स्थानोंका परिचय देते हुए वहाँ प्रमुख वानर वीरोंको भेजना
topics.en: Specifying the different regions of the southern quarter and fixing a limit of one month for their return, Sugriv dispatches Hanuman, Neel, Angad and others to that quarter for finding out the whereabouts of Sita

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका पश्चिम दिशाके स्थानोंका परिचय देते हुए सुषेण आदि वानरोंको वहाँ भेजना
topics.en: Fixing a time-limit of one month, Sugriv dispatches Sushen and others to conduct a search for Sita in the western quarter

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका उत्तर दिशाके स्थानोंका परिचय देते हुए शतबलि आदि वानरोंको वहाँ भेजना
topics.en: Sugriv dispatches a contingent of monkeys under the leadership of Shatabali in order to seek for Sita in the northern quarter

topics.hi: श्रीरामका हनुमान्जीको अँगूठी देकर भेजना
topics.en: With a view to inspiring confidence in Sita, when found, Shri Ram hands over to Hanuman his signet ring as a token of recognition while sending him away to the south. Bowing down at Shri Ram’s feet, Hanuman leaves his presence alongwith a contingent of the Vanar forces

topics.hi: विभिन्न दिशाओंमें जाते हुए वानरोंका सुग्रीवके समक्ष अपने उत्साहसूचक वचन सुनाना
topics.en: Bowing to the command of Sugriv and leading their respective bands, Vinata and other monkey chiefs set forth towards the quarter assigned to them by Sugriv

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका श्रीरामचन्द्रजीको अपने भूमण्डल-भ्रमणका वृत्तान्त बताना
topics.en: While Sugriv gave instructions to his various generals mentioning in detail the places they were to visit in the course of their expedition in search of Sita, Shri Ram was struck by the knowledge of world geography revealed by Sugriv and inquired of the latter how he had come to acquire such wonderful and accurate knowledge of geography. In reply to this Sugriv tells him of the encounter of Vali with Dundubhi, which led the former to conceive an inveterate hatred towards him (Sugriv) who when pursued by Vali had to range from one end of the world to another and this enabled him (Sugriv) to gather a first-hand knowledge of all parts of the globe

topics.hi: पूर्व आदि तीन दिशाओंमें गये हुए वानरोंका निराश होकर लौट आना
topics.en: Even after scouring more than once the regions comprised in the quarter assigned to them, Vinata and others fail to get any clue to the whereabouts of Sita. Returning despondent even before a month, they bow down to Shri Ram and Sugriv and report their inability to find out Sita. They feel convinced for many reasons that Hanuman alone will be able to discover Sita

topics.hi: दक्षिण दिशामें गये हुए वानरोंका सीताकी खोज आरम्भ करना
topics.en: Accompanied by Angad and others, Hanuman seeks for Sita in the dense forests and caves of the Vindhyan range. Making their way into a forest whose trees had ceased to flower and bear fruits because of a curse pronounced by Sage Kandu, overwhelmed with grief occasioned by the loss of his son, the monkeys, who felt exhausted due to exertion, behold a demon. As the latter swoops upon the monkeys with a raised fist, Angad makes short work of him thinking him to be Ravan. Feeling exhausted through peregrination in the forest, the monkeys seek the foot of a tree

topics.hi: अङ्गद और गन्धमादनके आश्वासन देनेपर वानरोंका पुन: उत्साहपूर्वक अन्वेषण-कार्यमें प्रवृत्त होना
topics.en: Asking the monkeys who accompanied him to the south and who had begun to feel diffident about their success to take note of the delay that was taking place in carrying out the command of Sugriv and to beware of Sugriv’s wrath, which was sure to follow in consequence of the delay, Angad advises them to take heart and encourages them to pursue their search vigorously. Encouraged by his enlivening words, they sally forth once more to renew their search in the cave of the Silver Mountain and, getting exhausted after a strenuous search, repose awhile in a grove and get ready to resume their efforts

topics.hi: भूखे-प्यासे वानरोंका एक गुफामें घुसकर वहाँ दिव्य वृक्ष, दिव्य सरोवर, दिव्य भवन तथा एक वृद्धा तपस्विनीको देखना और हनुमान्जीका उससे उसका परिचय पूछना
topics.en: The time appointed by Sugriv for finding out the whereabouts of Sita in the southern quarter having been exceeded in ransacking the caves of the Vindhyan range, which were hard to explore, Hanuman and others, who were tormented with hunger and thirst, catch sight of a cave known by the name of Rikshabil. Concluding, from the presence of birds with wet wings at the entrance of the cave, that there must be water inside, the monkeys enter the cave, which was enveloped in thick darkness, in a line holding the hand of one another. Proceeding to a short distance, the monkeys behold an ascetic woman in a strange spot illumined by trees of gold. Greeting her, Hanuman inquires of her the name of the place

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके पूछनेपर वृद्धा तापसीका अपना तथा उस दिव्य स्थानका परिचय देकर सब वानरोंको भोजनके लिये कहना
topics.en: Telling the monkeys how the cave was brought into existence, the ascetic woman, whose name was Swayamprabha, feeds the newcomers, the monkeys, with fruits and roots etc., and, when they had taken rest, inquires of them what brought them to that spot

topics.hi: तापसी स्वयंप्रभाके पूछनेपर वानरोंका उसे अपना वृत्तान्त बताना और उसके प्रभावसे गुफाके बाहर निकलकर समुद्रतटपर पहुँचना
topics.en: Narrating the whole story from the entry of Shri Ram into the forest round about the Pampa lake down to the entry of the monkeys into the cave, and complimenting Swayamprabha on the hospitality shown by her and wishing to repay her hospitality, Hanuman inquires of her if he can be of any service to her. Swayamprabha, however, declines his offer saying that, being engaged in the practice of virtue, she has no purpose to achieve through another

topics.hi: लौटनेकी अवधि बीत जानेपर भी कार्य सिद्ध न होनेके कारण सुग्रीवके कठोर दण्डसे डरनेवाले अङ्गद आदि वानरोंका उपवास करके प्राण त्याग देनेका निश्चय
topics.en: While the monkeys were feeling dejected on coming out of the cave to see the trees covered with blossom, which led them to conclude that the latter half of winter had approached, Prince Angad reminds them of the fierceness of Sugriv and says that a fasting till death on their part will be preferable to an ignominious death at the latter’s cruel hands. Another monkey general, Tara, for his part suggests that they should take shelter in Swayamprabha’s cave and thus escape the wrath of Sugriv, who dare not enter the cave. The monkeys fall in with the latter’s view and make up their mind to re-enter the cave and take up their abode in it

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका भेदनीतिके द्वारा वानरोंको अपने पक्षमें करके अङ्गदको अपने साथ चलनेके लिये समझाना
topics.en: Seeking to divert the minds of the other monkeys from the rebellious note struck by Tara, whose advice readily found favour with Angad and others, Hanuman warns Angad of the dire consequences which were sure to follow in case he chose to stay away from home and, assuring him of Sugriv’s amiability and disarming all his fears about him, tries to convince him that they had better return to Kishkindha and report themselves to their king

topics.hi: अङ्गदसहित वानरोंका प्रायोपवेशन
topics.en: Sick of hearing the praises of Sugriv uttered by Hanuman and pointing out the faults of Sugriv and denouncing him, Angad proclaims to the monkeys his decision to undertake a fast unto death and actually sits down to fast. Condemning Sugriv with tears in their eyes and making the mountain caverns resound with their tale of woe commencing from the appearance of Shri Ram on the scene and ending with their determination to observe a fast till death, the other monkeys too follow suit

topics.hi: सम्पातिसे वानरोंको भय, उनके मुखसे जटायुके वधकी बात सुनकर सम्पातिका दु:खी होना और अपनेको नीचे उतारनेके लिये वानरोंसे अनुरोध करना
topics.en: Praising Providence out of joy at the prospect of deriving sustenance for a long time on seeing a band of monkeys even as it emerged from a cave of the Vindhyan range on hearing their noise, the vulture king, Sampati (the elder brother of Jatayu), expresses his determination to eat them all up one after another. Depressed to hear the vow and declaring Jatayu, who had met his death at the hands of Ravan in the service of Shri Ram, while trying to deliver Sita from the former’s clutches, as more fortunate than any of them, who were threatened with death even before accomplishing the purpose of Shri Ram, Angad reproaches Kaikeyi who was at the root of the whole mischief. Distressed to hear these words of Angad and telling Angad that he was the elder brother of Jatayu, and at the same time inquiring about the death of his younger brother, Sampati requests Angad to help him slide down from his high post adding that, his wings having been burnt, he was unable to fly

topics.hi: अङ्गदका सम्पातिको पर्वत-शिखरसे नीचे उतारकर उन्हें जटायुके मारे जानेका वृत्तान्त बताना तथा राम-सुग्रीवकी मित्रता एवं वालिवधका प्रसंग सुनाकर अपने आमरण उपवासका कारण निवेदन करना
topics.en: Having helped Sampati to climb down the mountain, Angad narrates to him the whole story from the entry of Shri Ram into the Dandak forest to his own fasting

topics.hi: सम्पातिका अपने पंख जलनेकी कथा सुनाना, सीता और रावणका पता बताना तथा वानरोंकी सहायतासे समुद्र-तटपर जाकर भाईको जलाञ्जलि देना
topics.en: Sampati tells Angad how having once soared with his younger brother to the neighbourhood of the solar orb in his eagerness to test their relative strength and flying power, he had his own wings burnt in trying to save the wings of Jatayu by spreading his own wings over them as a canopy, and dropped on a peak of the Vindhyan range. Inquired by Angad if he knew anything about the abduction of Sita, he acknowledged his having seen a youthful lady being borne away by Ravan and crying out ‘Ram, which now leads him to think that she was no other than Shri Ram’s beloved spouse. Sampati further tells Angad how, gifted as he was with an inordinately long vision, he could see Lanka, the capital of Ravan, at a distance of one hundred Yojanas, as well as the place where Sita has been lodged. On his expressing a desire to offer water to the spirit of his deceased brother, the monkeys take him to the seashore and bring him back on his having concluded the rite

topics.hi: सम्पातिका अपने पुत्र सुपार्श्वके मुखसे सुनी हुई सीता और रावणको देखनेकी घटनाका वृत्तान्त बताना
topics.en: Interrogated by Jambavan as to how Sampati came to know about Sita’s, abduction by Ravan, the vulture tells him that it was his son, Suparshva, who related to him how, one day, while he was ranging along the seashore in search of food, he had seen a young lady, shining brightly as gold, being borne away by an ogre, of whom he had come to know later on from the words of an eminent sage that they were no other than Sita and Ravan, respectively

topics.hi: सम्पातिकी आत्मकथा
topics.en: Having inspired confidence in the monkeys, Sampati proceeds to relate to Angad and others, who longed to hear more about Sita, the story of Sita’s abduction in greater detail. He tells them how, having fallen on the Vindhyan range with his wings completely burnt by the scorching sun, he swooned and regained consciousness only on the seventh day, when he came to know that it was the Vindhyan range on which he had fallen. Descending with difficulty from the eminence, he made his way into the hermitage of a sage named Nishakar, and bowed down to him. Recognizing him to be Sampati, the sage inquired as to how his wings had come to be burnt

topics.hi: सम्पातिका निशाकर मुनिको अपने पंखके जलनेका कारण बताना
topics.en: Relating to Sage Nishakar the circumstances which led to his being burnt, Sampati takes before the sage a vow to give up the ghost by leaping from a mountain-peak

topics.hi: निशाकर मुनिका सम्पातिको सान्त्वना देते हुए उन्हें भावी श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके कार्यमें सहायता देनेके लिये जीवित रहनेका आदेश देना
topics.en: Sampati communicates to the monkeys the prediction made by Sage Nishakar, who could foresee future events by dint of his intuitive perception, that descending as Shri Ram elsewhere the Lord will dispatch monkeys in quest of Sita to the Vindhyan range and that Sampati will get back his wings as soon as he tells the monkeys the whereabouts of Sita

topics.hi: सम्पातिका पंखयुक्त होकर वानरोंको उत्साहित करके उड़ जाना और वानरोंका वहाँसे दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर प्रस्थान करना
topics.en: Even while Sampati was thus talking with the monkeys, a pair of beautiful wings shoot forth on his sides. Feeling transported with joy at their sight and showing them to the monkeys, nay, assuring them that their purpose too will likewise be achieved, Sampati soars to the sky in order to test the power of his wings. Feeling encouraged by this, the monkeys too resume their journey further south

topics.hi: समुद्रकी विशालता देखकर विषादमें पड़े हुए वानरोंको आश्वासन दे अङ्गदका उनसे पृथक्-पृथक् समुद्र-लङ्घनके लिये उनकी शक्ति पूछना
topics.en: On the monkey heroes getting despondent at the sight of the (Indian) ocean, which they found difficult to cross, Angad inquires of them if anyone of them was capable of leaping across the sea dividing India from Lanka. When all keep mum, he encourages all to proclaim each his own leaping capacity and prowess

topics.hi: बारी-बारीसे वानर-वीरोंके द्वारा अपनी-अपनी गमनशक्तिका वर्णन, जाम्बवान् और अङ्गदकी बातचीत तथा जाम्बवान्का हनुमान्जीको प्रेरित करनेके लिये उनके पास जाना
topics.en: Questioned by Angad, Gaja and other leaders of monkey hordes proclaim each his own leaping capacity ranging in an increasing degree from tenYojanas or eighty miles to ninety Yojanas or seven hundred and twenty miles. Jambavan in his turn submits that he can leap full one hundred Yojanas or eight hundred miles but is doubtful about his capacity to return. On Angad declaring the same thing, Jambavan submits that for a work, which can be entrusted to a servant alone, the services of a ruler would be out of place, and encourages Hanuman to take up the gauntlet

topics.hi: जाम्बवान्का हनुमान्जीको उनकी उत्पत्तिकथा सुनाकर समुद्रलङ्घनके लिये उत्साहित करना
topics.en: Reminding Hanuman of his descent from the loins of the wind-god through Anjana and of the circumstances which led to his getting the name of Hanuman and also how he received boons from Brahma (the creator) and others, and glorifying him, Jambavan encourages Hanuman to leap across the sea and thereby deliver the monkeys from their wretched plight

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका समुद्र लाँघनेके लिये उत्साह प्रकट करना, जाम्बवान्के द्वारा उनकी प्रशंसा तथा वेगपूर्वक छलाँग मारनेके लिये हनुमान्जीका महेन्द्र पर्वतपर चढ़ना
topics.en: Proclaiming his own glory in order to dispel the fears of the monkeys after assuming enormous proportions with a view to leaping across the sea, and climbing up Mount Mahendra, Hanuman prepares to take a leap across the sea

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके द्वारा समुद्रका लङ्घन, मैनाकके द्वारा उनका स्वागत, सुरसापर उनकी विजय तथा सिंहिकाका वध करके उनका समुद्रके उस पार पहुँचकर लंकाकी शोभा देखना
topics.en: Desirous of reaching Lanka in order to discover Sita, Hanuman takes a leap from a peak of Mount Mahendra and honouring with the touch of his hand Mount Mainak, which rose from the bottom of the sea to provide rest on its peak to Hanuman, encounters Surasa (mother of Nagas), sent by the gods in the form of an ogress, who was waiting for Hanuman with her mouth open to devour him. He enters her belly assuming a minute form and comes out without killing her. Further, he is met by another ogress, Sinhika by name, standing with her mouth wide open to gulp Hanuman. He enters her mouth after assuming a minute form and comes out after splitting her belly open and killing her. Then contracting his body into a minute form again in order to preclude the attention of the ogres, he descends on a mountain peak outside Lanka

topics.hi: लंकापुरीका वर्णन, उसमें प्रवेश करनेके विषयमें हनुमान्जीका विचार, उनका लघुरूपसे पुरीमें प्रवेश तथा चन्द्रोदयका वर्णन
