topics.en: Reflecting on the difficulty of penetrating into Lanka, which was strongly guarded by ogres, Hanuman further contracts his body and enters it at moonrise

topics.hi: लंकापुरीका अवलोकन करके हनुमान्जीका विस्मित होना, उसमें प्रवेश करते समय निशाचरी लंकाका उन्हें रोकना और उनकी मारसे विह्वल होकर उन्हें पुरीमें प्रवेश करनेकी अनुमति देना
topics.en: Appearing in person before Hanuman, while he was making his way into Lanka at night, the mighty ogress, Lanka, presiding over the city, stops him, striking him with the palm of her hand. Getting unnerved, even though gently smitten with his left fist, she permits the monkey to enter, repeating the words of Brahma, the creator, that the destruction of Lanka should be concluded as imminent when she is overpowered by a monkey

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका लंकापुरी एवं रावणके अन्त:पुरमें प्रवेश
topics.en: Entering Lanka and hearing the music of various instruments being played upon inside, and also observing the enemy’s forces armed with various weapons, Hanuman finds his way into the royal gynaeceum

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका रावणके अन्त:पुरमें घर-घरमें सीताको ढूँढ़ना और उन्हें न देखकर दु:खी होना
topics.en: Even though seeing ogres and ogresses of various grades and orders while the moon was ascending the heavens, Hanuman gives way to anxiety on his not being able to find Sita

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका रावण तथा अन्यान्य राक्षसोंके घरोंमें सीताजीकी खोज करना
topics.en: Reaching the palace of Ravan, which served as an adornment to Lanka, and having looked for Sita in the adjoining mansions of Prahast and others, Hanuman now enters the palace of Ravan

topics.hi: रावणके भवन एवं पुष्पक विमानका वर्णन
topics.en: The poet incidentally draws a pen-picture of Ravan’s palace and his aerial car known by the name of Pushpak

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके द्वारा पुन: पुष्पक विमानका दर्शन
topics.en: A further description of the aerial car, Pushpak

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका रावणके श्रेष्ठ भवन पुष्पक विमान तथा रावणके रहनेकी सुन्दर हवेलीको देखकर उसके भीतर सोयी हुई सहस्रों सुन्दरी स्त्रियोंका अवलोकन करना
topics.en: Leaping up the Pushpak in the course of his quest for Sita in the palace of Ravan, Hanuman gazes from that vantage-ground on the hosts of women lying asleep in the women’s apartments in diverse states

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका अन्त:पुरमें सोये हुए रावण तथा गाढ़ निद्रामें पड़ी हुई उसकी स्त्रियोंको देखना तथा मन्दोदरीको सीता समझकर प्रसन्न होना
topics.en: Hanuman catches sight of Ravan reposing on an excellent couch decked with various ornaments, himself adorned with jewels of every description. Perceiving Mandodari graced with bright jewels and lying asleep on a wonderful couch not far from her husband in the midst of dancing girls lying in a disorderly state with diverse musical instruments clasped to their bosom, and taking her to be Sita, Hanuman gets enraptured and exhibits his joy through various simian gestures such as kissing the end of his tail

topics.hi: वह सीता नहीं है—ऐसा निश्चय होनेपर हनुमान्जीका पुन: अन्त:पुरमें और उसकी पानभूमिमें सीताका पता लगाना, उनके मनमें धर्मलोपकी आशंका और स्वत: उसका निवारण होना
topics.en: Banishing by recourse to reason the thought that the lady whom he had seen was Sita, Hanuman searches for Sita once more in the gynaeceum as well as in the banqueting hall and sees there a number of women lying in various states, as well as drinking vessels. He is seized with fear of having incurred the sin of gazing on others’ wives; but the thought that he had looked on them with a lust-free mind eases his conscience

topics.hi: सीताके मरणकी आशंकासे हनुमान्जीका शिथिल होना, फिर उत्साहका आश्रय लेकर अन्य स्थानोंमें उनकी खोज करना और कहीं भी पता न लगनेसे पुन: उनका चिन्तित होना
topics.en: Having failed to discover Sita even after searching for her in the picture gallery and other places, Hanuman suspects that she might have been disposed of by Ravan and, thus meeting with frustration, falls into the quagmire of despair. On second thought, however, he deprecates despair as harmful and, falling back upon self-reliance, resumes the search. But, failing to find her even on searching for her all round, he becomes despondent again

topics.hi: सीताजीके नाशकी आशंकासे हनुमान्जीकी चिन्ता, श्रीरामको सीताके न मिलनेकी सूचना देनेसे अनर्थकी सम्भावना देख हनुमान्जीका न लौटनेका निश्चय करके पुन: खोजनेका विचार करना और अशोकवाटिकामें ढूँढ़नेके विषयमें तरह-तरहकी बातें सोचना
topics.en: Coming out of the aerial car, Pushpak, and not finding Sita even on searching for her on all sides, Hanuman concludes her to have been killed. Believing that her untraceability, no matter whether it is reported to Shri Ram or not, may lead to disastrous consequences, Hanuman decides not to return to the mainland. Meanwhile, as he contemplates fasting till death or suicide or the killing of Ravan, he catches sight of a grove which he does not remember to have seen and before proceeding to explore it mentally invokes the succour of Rishis and gods for success in his undertaking

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका अशोकवाटिकामें प्रवेश करके उसकी शोभा देखना तथा एक अशोकवृक्षपर छिपे रहकर वहींसे सीताका अनुसन्धान करना
topics.en: Leaping down to the enclosure of the Ashok grove and watching the loveliness of the grove from the top of the wall, Hanuman enters the grove and, leaping from tree to tree in the course of his search for Sita, catches sight of an Ashok tree. Espying a stream running beside it and expecting that Sita might turn up on the bank of the stream to say her Sandhya prayers, he takes up his position on that Ashok tree, hiding himself behind its leafy boughs

topics.hi: वनकी शोभा देखते हुए हनुमान्जीका एक चैत्यप्रासाद (मन्दिर)-के पास सीताको दयनीय अवस्थामें देखना, पहचानना और प्रसन्न होना
topics.en: Casting his eyes all round while remaining perched on the top of that Shinshapa tree, Hanuman catches sight of Sita in a temple and recognizes her by virtue of her characteristics and age

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका मन-ही-मन सीताजीके शील और सौन्दर्यकी सराहना करते हुए उन्हें कष्टमें पड़ी देख स्वयं भी उनके लिये शोक करना
topics.en: Admiring the virtue and propitious bodily marks etc., of Sita, Hanuman grieves at the thought of that lady, for whose sake Khar, Viradh and other ogres were killed, having been reduced to such a sad plight

topics.hi: भयंकर राक्षसियोंसे घिरी हुई सीताके दर्शनसे हनुमान्जीका प्रसन्न होना
topics.en: His eyes filled with joy on beholding Sita surrounded by ogresses with hideous and deformed faces while the moon was at the meridian, Hanuman mentally bows to Shri Ram and Lakshman and remains hidden behind the boughs of the Shinshapa tree

topics.hi: अपनी स्त्रियोंसे घिरे हुए रावणका अशोकवाटिकामें आगमन और हनुमान्जीका उसे देखना
topics.en: Perceiving Ravan surrounded by hundreds of young women and approaching Sita towards the close of night, swayed by passion as he was, Hanuman, who was perched on the top of the Shinshapa tree, silently comes down in order to scan the figure of Ravan and hides himself in the boughs in order to avoid observation

topics.hi: रावणको देखकर दु:ख, भय और चिन्तामें डूबी हुई सीताकी अवस्थाका वर्णन
topics.en: Finding himself unable, as it were, to depict the mental state of Sita, who got withered up and began to shudder at the sight of Ravan, the poet tries to portray her with the help of similes. Arrived in her presence, Ravan tries to win her

topics.hi: रावणका सीताजीको प्रलोभन
topics.en: Seeking to cajole Sita by means of coaxing words, Ravan implores her to accept him

topics.hi: सीताजीका रावणको समझाना और उसे श्रीरामके सामने नगण्य बताना
topics.en: Placing a blade of grass between herself and Ravan in order to avoid direct contact with a man of evil intentions and expostulating with him by showing him the right path, Sita praises Shri Ram and, impressing on Ravan the consequences of the latter befriending or antagonizing Shri Ram, advises Ravan to make friends with Shri Ram through self-surrender

topics.hi: रावणका सीताको दो मासकी अवधि देना, सीताका उसे फटकारना, फिर रावणका उन्हें धमकाकर राक्षसियोंके नियन्त्रणमें रखकर स्त्रियोंसहित पुन: महलको लौट जाना
topics.en: Nettled by the censure uttered by Sita, Ravan allows her a time-limit of two months to revise her decision and threatens her with death if she does not listen to reason. Restored to confidence by the glances of Ravan’s consorts, however, Sita condemns him once more. Leaving instructions with ogresses of terrible and ugly aspect to bring her to reason by recourse to intimidation and persuasion, Ravan thereupon leaves the presence of Sita alongwith his womenfolk

topics.hi: राक्षसियोंका सीताजीको समझाना
topics.en: Extolling Ravan, Ekajat and other ogresses posted in the Ashok grove coax her to accept his proposal

topics.hi: सीताजीका राक्षसियोंकी बात माननेसे इनकार कर देना तथा राक्षसियोंका उन्हें मारने-काटनेकी धमकी देना
topics.en: Citing the examples of Shachi, Arundhati and other devoted wives, even though threatened by the ogresses, Sita with a stout heart boldly proclaims her resolve not to submit to anyone else other than her own husband even on pain of death. Hanuman silently watches her being menaced by the ogresses by means of harsh words and show of weapons, and weeping

topics.hi: राक्षसियोंकी बात माननेसे इनकार करके शोक-संतप्त सीताका विलाप करना
topics.en: Unable to endure the threats of the ogresses and calling aloud Shri Ram and others, Sita bursts into a wail

topics.hi: सीताका करुण-विलाप तथा अपने प्राणोंको त्याग देनेका निश्चय करना
topics.en: Making up her mind not to submit to the advances of Ravan even on pain of death, when menaced by the ogresses, and indulging in speculation as to why Shri Ram was not turning up to rescue her, Sita wails in various ways

topics.hi: त्रिजटाका स्वप्न, राक्षसोंके विनाश और श्रीरघुनाथजीकी विजयकी शुभ सूचना
topics.en: Risen from sleep, an ogress, Trijata by name, speaks to her companions intimidating Sita, of a dream she saw only a few minutes before revealing the triumph of Shri Ram and the discomfiture of Ravan, and stops them from molesting Sita. Pressed by them, she relates the dream to them and also speaks of the omens portending the triumph of Sita

topics.hi: विलाप करती हुई सीताका प्राण-त्यागके लिये उद्यत होना
topics.en: The moment Sita, who was unable to bear the reproaches and threats of the ogresses, endeavours after wailing a good deal to strangle herself to death with the cord used for tying her hair, a propitious omen, never seen before, appears on her person

topics.hi: सीताजीके शुभ शकुन
topics.en: The omens described. Concluding them to be auspicious, from the thrill that ran through her body at their sight, Sita experiences great joy

topics.hi: सीताजीसे वार्तालाप करनेके विषयमें हनुमान्जीका विचार करना
topics.en: Weighing the pros and cons of comforting Sita or remaining mum, now that he had come to know everything about Sita at first hand, Hanuman decides upon the former course at the psychological moment

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका सीताको सुनानेके लिये श्रीराम-कथाका वर्णन करना
topics.en: Transported with joy to hear the story commencing from the birth of Shri Ram and ending with Hanuman’s espying Sita, narrated in a human tongue by Hanuman, remaining perched on the Shinshapa tree and casting her eyes all round, Sita catches sight of Hanuman sitting on a bough of the same Shinshapa tree beneath which she stood

topics.hi: सीताजीका तर्क-वितर्क
topics.en: Imagining Hanuman to have been seen in a dream, though actually perceived by her, and believing the sight of a monkey in a dream to be ominous, Sita becomes anxious about the welfare of Shri Ram and others. Then concluding him on other grounds to have been seen in her waking hours, she prays to Brahma and other gods that the statement of Hanuman may come out to be true

topics.hi: सीताजीका हनुमान्जीको अपना परिचय देते हुए अपने वनगमन और अपहरणका वृत्तान्त बताना
topics.en: Keen to hear of Sita’s identity from her own lips, even though he had identified her, Hanuman inquires of her whether she was a goddess or anyone else and asks her to disclose her identity in case she was Sita. In reply to this query Sita narrates to him her whole life- story ending with her abduction by Ravan and tells him how Ravan was going to kill her two months later, and how in the event of her not being delivered from his clutches before that, she has resolved to end her life by herself

topics.hi: सीताजीका हनुमान्जीके प्रति संदेह और उसका समाधान तथा हनुमान्जीके द्वारा श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके गुणोंका गान
topics.en: Inferring from the suitable reply to his queries received from Sita and the trust reposed in him by the latter, Hanuman reveals to her the role of an envoy allotted to him by Shri Ram and repeat the inquiries made by the two brothers about her welfare. Taking him to be Ravan disguised as a monkey, Sita, on the other hand, reproaches him when the latter approaches her in order to bow down at her feet. In order to allay her fears, Hanuman for his part discloses to her his reality as a minister of Sugriv as well as requests her to give credence to his words

topics.hi: सीताजीके पूछनेपर हनुमान्जीका श्रीरामके शारीरिक चिह्नों और गुणोंका वर्णन करना तथा नर-वानरकी मित्रताका प्रसङ्ग सुनाकर सीताजीके मनमें विश्वास उत्पन्न करना
topics.en: Questioned by Sita, who was anxious to ascertain the bonafides of the monkey, Hanuman, after cataloguing the marks on the person of Shri Ram and Lakshman, narrates his own life-story from his birth onwards including his role as a minister of Sugriv, and ending with his seeing of Sita

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका सीताको मुद्रिका देना, सीताका ‘श्रीराम कब मेरा उद्धार करेंगे’ यह उत्सुक होकर पूछना तथा हनुमान्जीका श्रीरामके सीताविषयक प्रेमका वर्णन करके उन्हें सान्त्वना देना
topics.en: Hanuman delivers Shri Ram’s signet ring to Sita in order to strengthen her confidence in him. Applauding Hanuman, Sita, who was rejoiced to receive the token, inquires about the health of Shri Ram and others. In order to appease the lady, who felt indignant at the thought that Shri Ram did not care to come to her rescue so far, which led her to suspect that he had ceased to love her, Hanuman attributes his non-appearance to his ignorance about her whereabouts. Describing Shri Ram’s desolation in order to betoken his excessive love for her, he consoles her with the assurance that Shri Ram is sparing no pains to rescue her from her confinement

topics.hi: सीताका हनुमान्जीसे श्रीरामको शीघ्र बुलानेका आग्रह, हनुमान्जीका सीतासे अपने साथ चलनेका अनुरोध तथा सीताका अस्वीकार करना
topics.en: Sita, who was distressed to hear of Shri Ram’s excessive grief caused by his separation from her, implores Hanuman to bring Shri Ram at once to her. Hanuman, who could not bear to see Sita’s sad plight, offers to carry her on his back to the presence of Shri Ram and girds up his loins to do so. In order to inspire confidence in Sita, who doubts his capacity to do it looking to his small size, Hanuman assumes a gigantic form; Sita, however, declines to go with him and urges Hanuman to bring Shri Ram to her

topics.hi: सीताजीका हनुमान्जीको पहचानके रूपमें चित्रकूट पर्वतपर घटित हुए एक कौएके प्रसंगको सुनाना, भगवान् श्रीरामको शीघ्र बुला लानेके लिये अनुरोध करना और चूड़ामणि देना
topics.en: Asked by Hanuman for a token, Sita narrates the episode of a crow, which occurred on the Chitrakoot mountain, and asks Hanuman to repeat the story to Shri Ram by way of a token. She further sends her greetings both to Shri Ram and Lakshman, conveys her inquiry after their welfare and communicates to them her resolve to survive only for a month after the expiry of the time-limit prescribed by Ravan; and last of all, she hands over to him her jewel for the head as a token

topics.hi: चूड़ामणि लेकर जाते हुए हनुमान्जीसे सीताका श्रीराम आदिको उत्साहित करनेके लिये कहना तथा समुद्र-तरणके विषयमें शङ्कित हुई सीताको वानरोंका पराक्रम बताकर हनुमान्जीका आश्वासन देना
topics.en: Sita asks Hanuman, when the latter is about to depart with the jewel for her head, to apprise Shri Ram and Lakshman of her own welfare and urge them to rescue her. When Sita expresses her misgivings about the capacity of the heroes on Shri Ram’s side to cross the sea, Hanuman expatiates on the might of the monkey heroes and assures her of their ability to cross it, and in the end consoles her by promising to bring Shri Ram and Lakshman on his back across the sea in any case

topics.hi: सीताका श्रीरामसे कहनेके लिये पुन: संदेश देना तथा हनुमान्जीका उन्हें आश्वासन दे उत्तर-दिशाकी ओर जाना
topics.en: Asking Hanuman, who was ready to depart, to remind Shri Ram of his having once painted a decorative mark on her cheek with red realgar, and also of how he threw a reed at the crow assailing her, destroying his right eye thereby, as further tokens of Hanuman having met her, and urging him to apprise Shri Ram of her wretched plight, Sita grants him leave to depart with her blessings

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके द्वारा प्रमदावन (अशोकवाटिका)-का विध्वंस
topics.en: Accounting his purpose not fully accomplished till he had ascertained the strength of the ogres, even though he had received the message of Sita, and making up his mind to lay waste the royal pleasure-garden as a means of ascertaining the strength of the enemy, Hanuman proceeds to do it

topics.hi: राक्षसियोंके मुखसे एक वानरके द्वारा प्रमदावनके विध्वंसका समाचार सुनकर रावणका किंकर नामक राक्षसोंको भेजना और हनुमान्जीके द्वारा उन सबका संहार
topics.en: Perceiving the devastation of the royal pleasance at the hands of Hanuman, the ogresses keeping watch over Sita asked her who he was. On Sita’s pleading her ignorance in the matter, some of them hurriedly seek the presence of Ravan and report the matter to him. Hanuman makes short work of a company of ogres known by the name of Kinkaras, despatched by Ravan. Thereupon Ravan sends Prahast’s son to punish the intruder

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके द्वारा चैत्यप्रासादका विध्वंस तथा उसके रक्षकोंका वध
topics.en: Having disposed of the Kinkaras sent by Ravan and making up his mind to demolish the sanctuary sacred to the guardian deity of ogres, Hanuman climbs it up and, killing the guards posted there, exhibits his prowess by uttering the name of Shri Ram in a thundering voice. Nay, uprooting a pillar of the sanctuary, he brandishes it and burns the sanctuary with the fire produced thereby

topics.hi: प्रहस्त-पुत्र जम्बुमालीका वध
topics.en: Dispatched by Ravan to capture Hanuman, Jambumali is killed in battle by the former

topics.hi: मन्त्रीके सात पुत्रोंका वध
topics.en: Having made short work of the seven sons of Ravan’s chief minister too, Hanuman climbs up the archway again and takes up his position there

topics.hi: रावणके पाँच सेनापतियोंका वध
topics.en: Having killed five more generals sent by Ravan, Hanuman returns again to the archway of the Ashok grove

topics.hi: रावणपुत्र अक्षकुमारका पराक्रम और वध
topics.en: Prince Aksh, son of Ravan, who came to meet Hanuman in combat, is killed

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित् और हनुमान्जीका युद्ध, उसके दिव्यास्त्रके बन्धनमें बँधकर हनुमान्जीका रावणके दरबारमें उपस्थित होना
topics.en: Dispatched by Ravan, Indrajit, Ravan’s eldest son, marches against Hanuman. On his shafts being rendered ineffective by Hanuman through his extreme agility, Indrajit takes him captive by discharging the unfailing missile presided over by Brahma (the creator). Even though capable of rendering it ineffective, Hanuman yields to its influence, eager as he was to meet Ravan, to whose presence he is led by his son

topics.hi: रावणके प्रभावशाली स्वरूपको देखकर हनुमान्जीके मनमें अनेक प्रकारके विचारोंका उठना
topics.en: Wonderstruck to behold the splendour and glory of Ravan, Hanuman believes that he could even rule over heaven but for his gross unrighteousness, which dragged him down

topics.hi: रावणका प्रहस्तके द्वारा हनुमान्जीसे लङ्कामें आनेका कारण पुछवाना और हनुमान्का अपनेको श्रीरामका दूत बताना
topics.en: Commanded by Ravan, Prahast inquires of Hanuman as to who he was as also his motive in devastating the royal pleasance and killing the ogres. In reply Hanuman says that he destroyed the grove in order that he might be taken captive and dragged to the presence of Ravan, whom he was eager to see, and was compelled in self-defence to kill those who stood in his way. In the end he declares himself to be a messenger of Shri Ram and adds that, though protected against the missile presided over by Brahma, he submitted to its influence only in order to be able to see Ravan

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका श्रीरामके प्रभावका वर्णन करते हुए रावणको समझाना
topics.en: Narrating the story of Shri Ram from the latter’s entry into the forest, to his own sight of Sita being borne away by Ravan through the air over the Rishyamook mountain, and celebrating the glory of Shri Ram, Hanuman points out to Ravan that if he longed to survive he should restore Sita to Shri Ram and that he should be prepared for the worst if, on the other hand, he chooses not to part with her

topics.hi: विभीषणका दूतके वधको अनुचित बताकर उसे दूसरा कोई दण्ड देनेके लिये कहना तथा रावणका उनके अनुरोधको स्वीकार कर लेना
topics.en: Provoked by the harsh words of Hanuman, Ravan orders him to be put to death. Vibhishan, however, exhorts the latter to desist from this dastardly act, pointing out that the killing of an envoy is forbidden by the Shastras

topics.hi: राक्षसोंका हनुमान्जीकी पूँछमें आग लगाकर उन्हें नगरमें घुमाना
topics.en: Wrapping up the tail of Hanuman in rags and soaking it in oil, and then lighting it up, the ogres, as urged by Ravan, take Hanuman round the city to the accompaniment of beat of drums. Hearing this news from the lips of the ogresses, Sita prays to the god of fire on oath to see that Hanuman remains unscathed. Climbing up the gate and shedding the fire by attenuating his body, and then resuming vast proportions and seizing the iron bar of the gate, Hanuman kills with it the ogres guarding the gate

topics.hi: लङ्कापुरीका दहन और राक्षसोंका विलाप
topics.en: Making up his mind to set fire to the city of Lanka, which was the only work left for him to do, and coming out into the open, Hanuman burns the entire city barring the abode of Vibhishan. Astonished to see the city burning, the gods and Gandharvas (celestial musicians) are filled with supreme joy

topics.hi: सीताजीके लिये हनुमान्जीकी चिन्ता और उसका निवारण
topics.en: Seeing the whole of Lanka reduced to ashes and presuming Sita too to have shared its lot, Hanuman begins to reproach himself and gets overwhelmed with grief. In the meantime, he hears of her safety from the lips of Siddhas, Charanas (celestial bards) and others and feels comforted

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका पुन: सीताजीसे मिलकर लौटना और समुद्रको लाँघना
topics.en: Hanuman sees Sita once more and bidding adieu to her, takes a leap across the sea

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका समुद्रको लाँघकर जाम्बवान् और अङ्गद आदि सुहृदोंसे मिलना
topics.en: Having leapt from the coast of Lanka and touching the Mainak mountain, which he came across in the way, nay, advancing further, Hanuman roars at the top of his voice at the sight of the Mahendra mountain in order to bring joy to the monkeys awaiting his return there. Jambavan tells the monkeys, who got up impetuously on hearing the roar, that Hanuman has returned successful from his expedition as was evident from his jubilant roar. Having greeted Jambavan and others on alighting on the summit of the Mahendra mountain, Hanuman narrates to them in a nutshell the story of his discovery of Sita. Applauding Hanuman, Prince Angad, who was eager to hear the story, sits down to do so on an extensive flat rock alongwith all

topics.hi: जाम्बवान्के पूछनेपर हनुमान्जीका अपनी लङ्कायात्राका सारा वृत्तान्त सुनाना
topics.en: Enquired by Jambavan, seated alongwith the monkey hordes, Hanuman narrates in extenso how he saw Mount Mainak in the course of his journey to Lanka, reached Lanka, beheld Janak’s daughter and returned to Mount Mahendra

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका सीताकी दुरवस्था बताकर वानरोंको लङ्कापर आक्रमण करनेके लिये उत्तेजित करना
topics.en: Picturing to his fellow monkeys the said plight of Sita, and feeling that it behoved them all to see Shri Ram only after recovering Sita from Lanka, nay, recounting the past heroic exploits of Jambavan and others, Hanuman incites them all to have recourse to the arbitrament of war

topics.hi: अङ्गदका लङ्काको जीतकर सीताको ले आनेका उत्साहपूर्ण विचार और जाम्बवान्के द्वारा उसका निवारण
topics.en: Feeling encouraged by the tributes paid to his valour by his fellow monkeys, Prince Angad undertakes to exterminate the entire ogre race including Ravan and bring back Sita from Lanka. Jambavan, however, who is more sagacious and practical-minded, discourages him by recourse to potent counter-arguments

topics.hi: वानरोंका मधुवनमें जाकर वहाँके मधु एवं फलोंका मनमाना उपभोग करना और वनरक्षकको घसीटना
topics.en: Set out from the Mahendra mountain in the direction of Kishkindha, the monkeys halt at Madhuvan, a grove guarded by the monkey Dadhimukh, and most beloved of Sugriv, which falls on their way. When the monkeys began to enjoy the fruits of the grove with the permission of Prince Angad, Dadhimukh, comes in their way and is lacerated with their claws and teeth

topics.hi: वानरोंद्वारा मधुवनके रक्षकों और दधिमुखका पराभव तथा सेवकोंसहित दधिमुखका सुग्रीवके पास जाना
topics.en: Having entered Madhuvan and partaken of honey, as permitted by Hanuman, and singing and dancing like drunken people, the monkeys were forbidden by those guarding the grove and they belaboured the latter. Repulsed by them, the guards reported the matter to their leader, Dadhimukh, who appeared on the scene with his entourage and on remonstrating with the monkeys was thrashed by Angad, who dashed him to the ground. The guards headed by Dadhimukh then move en masse to Kishkindha to report the matter to Sugriv and bow down at the latter’s feet

topics.hi: दधिमुखसे मधुवनके विध्वंसका समाचार सुनकर सुग्रीवका हनुमान् आदि वानरोंकी सफलताके विषयमें अनुमान
topics.en: Having heard from the mouth of Dadhimukh the story of Madhuvan having been laid waste by the monkeys, Sugriv concludes from the jubilation of the monkeys that Sita has been traced out. Comforting Dadhimukh, he asks him to send Angad and others without delay

topics.hi: दधिमुखसे सुग्रीवका संदेश सुनकर अङ्गद-हनुमान् आदि वानरोंका किष्किन्धामें पहुँचना और हनुमान्जीका श्रीरामको प्रणाम करके सीता देवीके दर्शनका समाचार बताना
topics.en: Returning to Madhuvan as commanded by Sugriv, and craving the forgiveness of Angad, Dadhimukh submits to the latter that he is urgently summoned by Sugriv. Set out in the company of Hanuman and others, and approaching Sugriv, Prince Angad apprises Shri Ram, after saluting him, of the discovery of Sita and other events

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका श्रीरामको सीताका समाचार सुनाना
topics.en: Asked by Shri Ram to tell him the news about Sita, Hanuman apprises Shri Ram of her presence at the foot of a Shinshapa tree in the midst of ogresses and delivers her message after narrating the incidents related by her as a token

topics.hi: चूडामणिको देखकर और सीताका समाचार पाकर श्रीरामका उनके लिये विलाप
topics.en: Pressing to his bosom the jewel for the head sent by Sita and piteously wailing in many ways, Shri Ram urges Hanuman to repeat the message of Sita

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका भगवान् श्रीरामको सीताका संदेश सुनाना
topics.en: Hanuman reproduces at length the incident connected with a crow that took place during the sojourn of Sita with Shri Ram at Chitrakoot, related by her by way of a token, and further describes her piteous lament and the way in which she was comforted by Hanuman

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका सीताके संदेह और अपने द्वारा उनके निवारणका वृत्तान्त बताना
topics.en: Hanuman tells Shri Ram, how Sita expressed her doubt in the first instance about a monkey being able to leap across a vast sea and how her doubt was resolved by him

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीकी प्रशंसा करके श्रीरामका उन्हें हृदयसे लगाना और समुद्रको पार करनेके लिये चिन्तित होना
topics.en: Hearing the report of Hanuman, and highly rejoiced at his having done something worthy of a noble servant, which could not be accomplished by anyone else, Shri Ram applauds him and clasps him to his bosom

topics.hi: सुग्रीवका श्रीरामको उत्साह प्रदान करना
topics.en: Sugriv heartens Shri Ram, who is tormented with grief, by asking him to take courage

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका लङ्काके दुर्ग, फाटक, सेना-विभाग और संक्रम आदिका वर्णन करके भगवान् श्रीरामसे सेनाको कूच करनेकी आज्ञा देनेके लिये प्रार्थना करना
topics.en: Enquired about Lanka by Shri Ram on his hearing the appeal of Sugriv, Hanuman gives a detailed description of Lanka as he saw it

topics.hi: श्रीराम आदिके साथ वानर-सेनाका प्रस्थान और समुद्र-तटपर उसका पड़ाव
topics.en: Hearing the report of Hanuman, Shri Ram fixes a propitious hour for the departure of his forces for Lanka, and perceives good omens

topics.hi: श्रीरामका सीताके लिये शोक और विलाप
topics.en: While talking with Lakshman, Shri Ram is reminded of Sita and, smitten with pangs of love, gives way to grief and lamentation

topics.hi: रावणका कर्तव्य-निर्णयके लिये अपने मन्त्रियोंसे समुचित सलाह देनेका अनुरोध करना
topics.en: At Lanka Ravan holds consultation with the ogres on the means of victory in the contingency of a conflict with the monkeys

topics.hi: राक्षसोंका रावण और इन्द्रजित्के बल-पराक्रमका वर्णन करते हुए उसे रामपर विजय पानेका विश्वास दिलाना
topics.en: Indulging in praise of their own might on hearing the command of Ravan, all the ogres present stimulate him with confidence, asking him not to give way to despondency

topics.hi: प्रहस्त, दुर्मुख, वज्रदंष्ट्र, निकुम्भ और वज्रहनुका रावणके सामने शत्रु-सेनाको मार गिरानेका उत्साह दिखाना
topics.en: Prahast and others reassure Ravan by vauntingly vowing the death of Shri Ram and others

topics.hi: विभीषणका रावणसे श्रीरामकी अजेयता बताकर सीताको लौटा देनेके लिये अनुरोध करना
topics.en: Restraining the ogres, who were boasting each of his own strength, Vibhishan begins to talk wisdom, on which Ravan retires to his own palace

topics.hi: विभीषणका रावणके महलमें जाना, उसे अपशकुनोंका भय दिखाकर सीताको लौटा देनेके लिये प्रार्थना करना और रावणका उनकी बात न मानकर उन्हें वहाँसे विदा कर देना
topics.en: Making his way into the palace of his eldest (half-) brother early next morning and drawing his attention to the evil portents, Vibhishan appeals to his good sense by making a timely submission

topics.hi: रावण और उसके सभासदोंका सभाभवनमें एकत्र होना
topics.en: When Ravan entered the assembly hall to hold consultations with his counsellors, other leading ogres as well as Vibhishan follow suit

topics.hi: नगरकी रक्षाके लिये सैनिकोंकी नियुक्ति, रावणका सीताके प्रति अपनी आसक्ति बताकर उनके हरणका प्रसंग बताना और भावी कर्तव्यके लिये सभासदोंकी सम्मति माँगना, कुम्भकर्णका पहले तो उसे फटकारना, फिर समस्त शत्रुओंके वधका स्वयं ही भार उठाना
topics.en: Ravan orders his Commander-in-Chief, Prahast, to make adequate arrangements for the defence of the city and to apprise Kumbhkaran of the whole situation now that he had woken from his long slumber

topics.hi: महापार्श्वका रावणको सीतापर बलात्कारके लिये उकसाना और रावणका शापके कारण अपनेको ऐसा करनेमें असमर्थ बताना तथा अपने पराक्रमके गीत गाना
topics.en: Advised by Mahaparshva to use violence against Sita, Ravan pleads his inability to do so because of a curse pronounced against him in the past by Brahma, and boasts of his own valour

topics.hi: विभीषणका रामको अजेय बताकर उनके पास सीताको लौटा देनेकी सम्मति देना
topics.en: Vibhishan exhorts Ravan to restore Sita to Shri Ram before the latter’s arrows pierced the heads of the ogres

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित्द्वारा विभीषणका उपहास तथा विभीषणका उसे फटकारकर सभामें अपनी उचित सम्मति देना
topics.en: Reproaching in a language which, though harsh, was yet conformable to truth, Indrajit, who was indulging in a boastful speech, on hearing the advice of Vibhishan, the latter repeats that concilliation of Ram was the only opportune and salutary course

topics.hi: रावणके द्वारा विभीषणका तिरस्कार और विभीषणका भी उसे फटकारकर चल देना
topics.en: Annoyed to hear this advice of his youngest half-brother, Vibhishan, which, though unpleasant to hear, was most wholesome, Ravan, on whom it made no impression, castigates him with harsh words

topics.hi: विभीषणका श्रीरामकी शरणमें आना और श्रीरामका अपने मन्त्रियोंके साथ उन्हें आश्रय देनेके विषयमें विचार करना
topics.en: Vibhishan seeks the protection of Shri Ram and the latter holds consultation with his counsellors on the question of giving him shelter

topics.hi: भगवान् श्रीरामका शरणागतकी रक्षाका महत्त्व एवं अपना व्रत बताकर विभीषणसे मिलना
topics.en: Having heard the arguments of his counsellors, Shri Ram decides to accept Vibhishan as his own

topics.hi: विभीषणका आकाशसे उतरकर भगवान् श्रीरामके चरणोंकी शरण लेना, उनके पूछनेपर रावणकी शक्तिका परिचय देना और श्रीरामका रावण-वधकी प्रतिज्ञा करके विभीषणको लङ्काके राज्यपर अभिषिक्त कर उनकी सम्मतिसे समुद्रतटपर धरना देनेके लिये बैठना
topics.en: Falling at the feet of Shri Ram on coming down to the earth alongwith his ministers, when he had received an assurance of safety from Shri Ram, Vibhishan submits to the former that, having been reprimanded by his eldest brother, Ravan, he has sought refuge with him, and on being questioned by Shri Ram tells him everything about Ravan.

topics.hi: शार्दूलके कहनेसे रावणका शुकको दूत बनाकर सुग्रीवके पास संदेश भेजना, वहाँ वानरोंद्वारा उसकी दुर्दशा, श्रीरामकी कृपासे उसका संकटसे छूटना और सुग्रीवका रावणके लिये उत्तर देना
topics.en: Told by an ogre, Shardul by name, that an army of monkeys led by Sugriv was advancing towards Lanka, Ravan dispatched an ogre, Shuk by name, as an envoy to carry his message to Sugriv. While commencing to deliver the message to Sugriv, Shuk is captured by the monkeys; but Shri Ram causes him to be set free and he delivers the message to Sugriv

topics.hi: श्रीरामका समुद्रके तटपर कुशा बिछाकर तीन दिनोंतक धरना देनेपर भी समुद्रके दर्शन न देनेसे कुपित हो उसे बाण मारकर विक्षुब्ध कर देना
topics.en: When the sea did not, even when requested, allow a passage to Shri Ram, who was keen to cross it, nor did the sea-god care to appear in person before him, Shri Ram discharges fierce arrows which cause a stir among the creatures inhabiting the sea and make the sea-water overflow

topics.hi: समुद्रकी सलाहके अनुसार नलके द्वारा सागरपर सौ योजन लंबे पुलका निर्माण तथा उसके द्वारा श्रीराम आदिसहित वानरसेनाका उस पार पहुँचकर पड़ाव डालना
topics.en: Seized with terror to see a missile presided over by Brahma (the creator) fitted to his bow by Shri Ram in fury, and appearing in person with joined palms, the sea- god undertakes to sustain on his bosom a bridge to be constructed by Nal, and goes out of sight. Nal accordingly builds a bridge across the sea

topics.hi: श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणसे उत्पातसूचक लक्षणोंका वर्णन और लङ्कापर आक्रमण
topics.en: Shri Ram speaks of evil portents to Lakshman

topics.hi: श्रीरामका लक्ष्मणसे लङ्काकी शोभाका वर्णन करके सेनाको व्यूहबद्ध खड़ी होनेके लिये आदेश देना, श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे बन्धनमुक्त हुए शुकका रावणके पास जाकर उनकी सैन्यशक्तिकी प्रबलता बताना तथा रावणका अपने बलकी डींग हाँकना
topics.en: Beholding Lanka and applauding it, nay, drawing up his army in battle array, Shri Ram orders the release of Shuk (a spy of Ravan), who was captured earlier and kept under detention by the monkeys. Going back to Ravan the ogre speaks to him about the military strength of Shri Ram. Infuriated by this report, Ravan vauntingly harps on his own prowess

topics.hi: रावणका शुक और सारणको गुप्तरूपसे वानरसेनामें भेजना, विभीषणद्वारा उनका पकड़ा जाना, श्रीरामकी कृपासे छुटकारा पाना तथा श्रीरामका संदेश लेकर लङ्कामें लौटकर उनका रावणको समझाना
topics.en: On Shri Ram having crossed over to the other side of the sea, Ravan commands his ministers, Shuk and Saran, to enter the enemy’s ranks and tell him everything about them. Detected while doing the work of a spy, they are captured by Vibhishan, but let go by Shri Ram. Going back to Ravan, they exhort the latter to hand over Sita to Shri Ram

topics.hi: सारणका रावणको पृथक्-पृथक् वानरयूथपतियोंका परिचय देना
topics.en: Climbing up the roof of his palace on hearing the submission of Saran and surveying the entire army of monkeys, Ravan inquires about the monkey leaders and Saran shows to him Hanuman and others alongwith their distinguishing marks

topics.hi: वानरसेनाके प्रधान यूथपतियोंका परिचय
topics.en: Mentioning the names of other monkey-generals, Saran proceeds to describe their individual valour

topics.hi: शुकके द्वारा सुग्रीवके मन्त्रियोंका, मैन्द और द्विविदका, हनुमान्का, श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण, विभीषण और सुग्रीवका परिचय देकर वानरसेनाकी संख्याका निरूपण करना
topics.en: Shuk completes the account given by Saran

topics.hi: रावणका शुक और सारणको फटकारकर अपने दरबारसे निकाल देना, उसके भेजे हुए गुप्तचरोंका श्रीरामकी दयासे वानरोंके चंगुलसे छूटकर लङ्कामें आना
topics.en: Snubbing Shuk and Saran, Ravan expels them from his court and dispatches Shardul and other ogres for espionage. Captured by the monkeys, the ogres are thrashed by them and get released by Shri Ram. Returning to Lanka, they too speak to Ravan about the army of monkeys

topics.hi: रावणके भेजे हुए गुप्तचरों एवं शार्दूलका उससे वानर-सेनाका समाचार बताना और मुख्य-मुख्य वीरोंका परिचय देना
topics.en: Dispatched by Ravan to ascertain the strength of the simian army, the ogre Shardul acquaints his master with the topmost leaders of the monkeys

topics.hi: मायारचित श्रीरामका कटा मस्तक दिखाकर रावणद्वारा सीताको मोहमें डालनेका प्रयत्न
topics.en: Perturbed to learn from the spies sent by him that Shri Ram had taken up his position near the Suvel mountain, Ravan takes counsel with his ministers and, after dismissing them, approaches Sita with Vidyujjihva, who was a past master in conjuring tricks. Telling her how her husband had been killed by him with his entire army, he produces before her as an evidence the counterfeit head of Shri Ram brought by Vidyujjihva

topics.hi: श्रीरामके मारे जानेका विश्वास करके सीताका विलाप तथा रावणका सभामें जाकर मन्त्रियोंके सलाहसे युद्धविषयक उद्योग करना
topics.en: Sita bursts into a wail at the sight of Shri Ram’s head and bow, when Ravan is abruptly called away by an emissary and after consultation with his ministers prepares his forces for action against the army of Shri Ram

topics.hi: सरमाका सीताको सान्त्वना देना, रावणकी मायाका भेद खोलना, श्रीरामके आगमनका प्रिय समाचार सुनाना और उनके विजयी होनेका विश्वास दिलाना
topics.en: Sarama reassures Sita by telling her that the head brought before her was not of Shri Ram, who was alive and would soon be able to see her, and asks her not to be afraid

topics.hi: सीताके अनुरोधसे सरमाका उन्हें मन्त्रियोंसहित रावणका निश्चित विचार बताना
topics.en: Urged by Sita, Sarama discloses to her the definite plans of Ravan devised by him in consultation with his ministers

topics.hi: माल्यवान्का रावणको श्रीरामसे संधि करनेके लिये समझाना
topics.en: Observing in Lanka evil portents and startling phenomena foreboding the destruction of ogres, Malyavan exhorts Ravan to make peace with Shri Ram

topics.hi: माल्यवान्पर आक्षेप और नगरकी रक्षाका प्रबन्ध करके रावणका अपने अन्त:पुरमें जाना
topics.en: Deriding the exhortation of Malyavan, even though conducive to his good, nay, holding consultation with his ministers and detailing Prahast (the Commander-in-Chief) and others to guard the four main gates against the inroads of the enemy, Ravan complacently retires into his gynaeceum

topics.hi: विभीषणका श्रीरामसे रावणद्वारा किये गये लङ्काकी रक्षाके प्रबन्धका वर्णन तथा श्रीरामद्वारा लङ्काके विभिन्न द्वारोंपर आक्रमण करनेके लिये अपने सेनापतियोंकी नियुक्ति
topics.en: While, on reaching the precincts of Lanka, Shri Ram and Sugriv as well as other monkeys headed by Hanuman were deliberating as to how to achieve success in their expedition, Vibhishan apprises them of the arrangements made by Ravan at the four gates for the defence of Lanka, as reported to him by his four ministers, who had entered Lanka in the disguise of birds and witnessed everything with their own eyes. Shri Ram too after detailing monkeys to storm the four gates climbs up the Suvel mountain with his army

topics.hi: श्रीरामका प्रमुख वानरोंके साथ सुवेल पर्वतपर चढ़कर वहाँ रातमें निवास करना
topics.en: Climbing up the Suvel mountain in consultation with and in the company of Lakshman and Vibhishan as well as of Sugriv and others, Shri Ram surveys the city from that vantage-ground. The eminent heroes among the monkeys too, who were eager to fight, roar at the top of their voice and spend the night on the mountain itself with Shri Ram

topics.hi: वानरोंसहित श्रीरामका सुवेल-शिखरसे लङ्कापुरीका निरीक्षण करना
topics.en: Having passed the night on the summit of the Suvel mountain, the commanders of simian troops entered the parks and gardens in the outskirts of Lanka, which were laden with blossom etc., while others make their way into Lanka itself. Shri Ram, however, feels amazed to behold from the mountain-top Lanka, which was charming in every respect

topics.hi: सुग्रीव और रावणका मल्लयुद्ध
topics.en: Ascending the highest peak of the Suvel mountain alongwith a division of his army, Shri Ram catches sight of Ravan perched on the top of a gate of his palace. Infuriated at his very sight, Sugriv springs upon him by surprise from the mountain-top, throws down the diadem from his head, struggles with him for a long time and, eluding him, returns victorious to the presence of Shri Ram

topics.hi: श्रीरामका सुग्रीवको दु:साहससे रोकना, लङ्काके चारों द्वारोंपर वानरसैनिकोंकी नियुक्ति, रामदूत अङ्गदका रावणके महलमें पराक्रम तथा वानरोंके आक्रमणसे राक्षसोंको भय
topics.en: Shri Ram is not very pleased with the daring act of Sugriv inasmuch as he had seen evil portents. Warning him against such action on the ground of his being a sovereign, and commanding the monkey generals to besiege all the four gates of Lanka, he dispatches Angad to expostulate with Ravan and bring him to reason. Angad tries his best to bring him round, but in vain, and returns unsuccessful to the presence of Shri Ram after threatening the ogres

topics.hi: लङ्कापर वानरोंकी चढ़ाई तथा राक्षसोंके साथ उनका घोर युद्ध
topics.en: Approaching Ravan, the ogres break to him the news about Lanka having been laid siege to by the monkeys led by Shri Ram. Ascending the roof of his palace and taxing his brain about the means of putting an end to the monkeys, he casts a look at Shri Ram and the monkeys. Pained at the thought that Sita was being bullied by Ravan on his account, and commanding the monkeys to besiege all the four gates of Lanka and to destroy the ogres, Shri Ram, on the other side, takes up his position alongwith Lakshman near the northern gate. Apprised of these developments, Ravan mobilizes his army and, encouraged by him, the ogres beat their drums and emit a terrible roar

topics.hi: द्वन्द्वयुद्धमें वानरोंद्वारा राक्षसोंकी पराजय
topics.en: In the course of duels the ogres and the monkeys, in which Angad closes with Indrajit, the heads of Durdharsh, Mitraghna, Agniketu and Yajnakopan are lopped off by Shri Ram and that of Nikumbh by Neel and, killed by Sushen, Vidyunmali drops down dead

topics.hi: रातमें वानरों और राक्षसोंका घोर युद्ध, अङ्गदके द्वारा इन्द्रजित्की पराजय, मायासे अदृश्य हुए इन्द्रजित्का नागमय बाणोंद्वारा श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणको बाँधना
topics.en: During the nocturnal engagement the monkeys too dauntlessly offer a stiff fight to the ogres even though they were fighting against heavy odds inasmuch as the strength of ogres gets doubled at night, and felt highly rejoiced to find Indrajit vanquished by Angad. Shri Ram and Lakshman too put to flight numberless foes with their shower of arrows. Eventually, however, they are both bound by Indrajit in a noose of serpents

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित्के बाणोंसे श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका अचेत होना और वानरोंका शोक करना
topics.en: Distressed to perceive the two scions of Raghu bound by Indrajit in a network of arrows and pierced with other fierce arrows, the monkeys give way to utter despondency

topics.hi: श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणको मूर्च्छित देख वानरोंका शोक, इन्द्रजित्का हर्षोद्गार, विभीषणका सुग्रीवको समझाना, इन्द्रजित्का लङ्कामें जाकर पिताको शत्रुवधका वृत्तान्त बताना और प्रसन्न हुए रावणके द्वारा अपने पुत्रका अभिनन्दन
topics.en: Though itching to killl the enemy on beholding Shri Ram and Lakshman enmeshed in a network of snakes, the monkeys, who were unable to perceive him, feel frustrated. Vibhishan exhorts Sugriv, who was seized with fear on finding Indrajit hidden under the cloak of witchcraft, to take heart and not to give way to fear. Concluding the two brothers to be dead, Indrajit, for his part, triumphantly enters Lanka and is welcomed by his father

topics.hi: वानरोंद्वारा श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी रक्षा, रावणकी आज्ञासे राक्षसियोंका सीताको पुष्पकविमानद्वारा रणभूमिमें ले जाकर श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका दर्शन कराना और सीताका दु:खी होकर रोना
topics.en: Indrajit having re-entered Lanka, Hanuman and other monkeys encompass Shri Ram and Lakshman and guard their bodies. Having dismissed Indrajit, Ravan commands the ogresses guarding Sita to take her to the field of battle and show her the plight of Shri Ram and Lakshman. The ogresses, headed by Trijata, accordingly take her in the aerial car, known by the name of Pushpak, and show her the two princes lying unconscious and motionless on the ground. Sita bursts into a piteous wail on seeing her husband and brother-in-law in that plight

topics.hi: सीताका विलाप और त्रिजटाका उन्हें समझा-बुझाकर श्रीराम-लक्ष्मणके जीवित होनेका विश्वास दिलाकर पुन: लङ्कामें ही लौटा लाना
topics.en: “Those well-versed in physiognomy and palmistry had prophesied that I would never be widowed and would bear sons. How could their predictions prove untrue?” While Sita was absorbed in these thoughts on beholding Shri Ram and Lakshman, Trijata reassures her on the strength of good omens and, cheering her soul, takes her back to the Ashok grove

topics.hi: श्रीरामका सचेत होकर लक्ष्मणके लिये विलाप करना और स्वयं प्राणत्यागका विचार करके वानरोंको लौट जानेकी आज्ञा देना
topics.en: Returning to consciousness, Shri Ram wails over the lot of Lakshman and the monkeys too fall a prey to extreme despondency on seeing Shri Ram wailing as aforesaid. Seeing Vibhishan approach Shri Ram in the meantime, they all take to their heels, mistaking him for Indrajit

topics.hi: विभीषणको इन्द्रजित् समझकर वानरोंका पलायन और सुग्रीवकी आज्ञासे जाम्बवान्का उन्हें सान्त्वना देना, विभीषणका विलाप और सुग्रीवका उन्हें समझाना, गरुड़का आना और श्रीराम-लक्ष्मणको नागपाशसे मुक्त करके चला जाना
topics.en: Beholding Vibhishan, Sugriv asks Jambavan to restore the fleeing monkeys to confidence and himself reassures Vibhishan. In the meantime, Garud, the king of birds, makes his appearance on the scene and liberates Shri Ram and Lakshman from their bondage

topics.hi: श्रीरामके बन्धनमुक्त होनेका पता पाकर चिन्तित हुए रावणका धूम्राक्षको युद्धके लिये भेजना और सेनासहित धूम्राक्षका नगरसे बाहर आना
topics.en: Hearing the tumultuous noise of the monkeys, the servants of Ravan, detailed for the purpose, report to him how the two scions of Raghu were freed from the bondage of arrows. Depressed by this news, Ravan dispatches Dhumraksh to dispose of Shri Ram. Though perturbed at the sight of evil portents, yet unwilling to retrace his steps on any account, Dhumraksh surveys the army of the monkeys

topics.hi: धूम्राक्षका युद्ध और हनुमान्जीके द्वारा उसका वध
topics.en: Dhumraksh fights and is killed by Hanuman

topics.hi: वज्रदंष्ट्रका सेनासहित युद्धके लिये प्रस्थान, वानरों और राक्षसोंका युद्ध, वज्रदंष्ट्रद्वारा वानरोंका तथा अङ्गदद्वारा राक्षसोंका संहार
topics.en: The monkeys’ tough fight with the ogre Vajradanshtra dispatched by Ravan, who is provoked by the death of Dhumraksh

topics.hi: वज्रदंष्ट्र और अङ्गदका युद्ध तथा अङ्गदके हाथसे उस निशाचरका वध
topics.en: An encounter between Vajradanshtra and Angad, who kills the former

topics.hi: रावणकी आज्ञासे अकम्पन आदि राक्षसोंका युद्धमें आना और वानरोंके साथ उनका घोर युद्ध
topics.en: Akampan and other ogres appear on the field of battle under orders of Ravan and wage a deadly conflict with the monkeys

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके द्वारा अकम्पनका वध
topics.en: Hanuman kills Akampan

topics.hi: प्रहस्तका रावणकी आज्ञासे विशाल सेनासहित युद्धके लिये प्रस्थान
topics.en: Under orders of Ravan, Prahast sallies forthwith a large army for the battlefield

topics.hi: नीलके द्वारा प्रहस्तका वध
topics.en: Neel kills Prahast

topics.hi: प्रहस्तके मारे जानेसे दु:खी हुए रावणका स्वयं ही युद्धके लिये पधारना, उसके साथ आये हुए मुख्य वीरोंका परिचय, रावणकी मारसे सुग्रीवका अचेत होना, लक्ष्मणका युद्धमें आना, हनुमान् और रावणमें थप्पड़ोंकी मार, रावणद्वारा नीलका मूर्च्छित होना, लक्ष्मणका शक्तिके आघातसे मूर्च्छित एवं सचेत होना तथा श्रीरामसे परास्त होकर रावणका लङ्कामें घुस जाना
topics.en: Disconsolate at the death of Prahast, Ravan himself appears on the battle-field for an encounter. After a tough fight with Sugriv, Lakshman, Hanuman and Neel, Ravan meets Shri Ram and, sustaining an ignominious defeat at the latter’s hands and escaping with his life, withdraws to Lanka

topics.hi: अपनी पराजयसे दु:खी हुए रावणकी आज्ञासे सोये हुए कुम्भकर्णका जगाया जाना और उसे देखकर वानरोंका भयभीत होना
topics.en: The slumbering Kumbhkaran is roused by the ogres under orders of their king, who felt disconsolate at his own defeat, and the monkeys get alarmed to see the former

topics.hi: विभीषणका श्रीरामसे कुम्भकर्णका परिचय देना और श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे वानरोंका युद्धके लिये लङ्काके द्वारोंपर डट जाना
topics.en: Vibhishan acquaints Shri Ram with Kumbhkaran and the monkeys take up their position firmly at the gates of Lanka for an encounter under orders of Shri Ram

topics.hi: कुम्भकर्णका रावणके भवनमें प्रवेश तथा रावणका रामसे भय बताकर उसे शत्रुसेनाके विनाशके लिये प्रेरित करना
topics.en: Kumbhkaran enters the palace of Ravan, who warns him of the danger from Shri Ram and urges him to destroy the enemy’s army

topics.hi: कुम्भकर्णका रावणको उसके कुकृत्योंके लिये उपालम्भ देना और उसे धैर्य बँधाते हुए युद्धविषयक उत्साह प्रकट करना
topics.en: Kumbhkaran twits Ravan for all his misdeeds and, reassuring him, shows his determination for a conflict

topics.hi: महोदरका कुम्भकर्णके प्रति आक्षेप करके रावणको बिना युद्धके ही अभीष्ट वस्तुकी प्राप्तिका उपाय बताना
topics.en: Mahodar twits Kumbhkaran and suggests to Ravan a device to achieve his end without a struggle

topics.hi: कुम्भकर्णकी रणयात्रा
topics.en: Kumbhkaran’s sally for an encounter

topics.hi: कुम्भकर्णके भयसे भागे हुए वानरोंका अङ्गदद्वारा प्रोत्साहन और आवाहन, कुम्भकर्णद्वारा वानरोंका संहार, पुन: वानर-सेनाका पलायन और अङ्गदका उसे समझा-बुझाकर लौटाना
topics.en: Angad reassures and rallies the monkeys scared away by Kumbhkaran; their carnage at the hands of Kumbhkaran puts them to flight again and Angad restores them to confidence once more

topics.hi: कुम्भकर्णका भयंकर युद्ध और श्रीरामके हाथसे उसका वध
topics.en: Kumbhkaran’s terrible encounter with Shri Ram and death at his hands

topics.hi: कुम्भकर्णके वधका समाचार सुनकर रावणका विलाप
topics.en: Ravan’s lament over Kumbhkaran’s fall

topics.hi: रावणके पुत्रों और भाइयोंका युद्धके लिये जाना और नरान्तकका अङ्गदके द्वारा वध
topics.en: Ravan’s sons and brothers sally forth for an encounter and Narantak meets with his death at the hands of Angad

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके द्वारा देवान्तक और त्रिशिराका, नीलके द्वारा महोदरका तथा ऋषभके द्वारा महापार्श्वका वध
topics.en: Death of Devantak and Trishira at the hands of Hanuman, of Mahodar at the hands of Neel and of Mahaparshva at the hands of Rishabh

topics.hi: अतिकायका भयंकर युद्ध और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा उसका वध
topics.en: Atikay puts up a fierce fight and is killed by Lakshman

topics.hi: रावणकी चिन्ता तथा उसका राक्षसोंको पुरीकी रक्षाके लिये सावधान रहनेका आदेश
topics.en: Ravan feels anxious for the safety of Lanka and enjoins the ogres to guard the city jealously

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित्के ब्रह्मास्त्रसे वानरसेनासहित श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका मूर्च्छित होना
topics.en: A missile presided over by Brahma and shot by Indrajit renders Shri Ram and Lakshman as well as the whole army of monkeys unconscious

topics.hi: जाम्बवान्के आदेशसे हनुमान्जीका हिमालयसे दिव्य ओषधियोंके पर्वतको लाना और उन ओषधियोंकी गन्धसे श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण एवं समस्त वानरोंका पुन: स्वस्थ होना
topics.en: Under instructions from Jambavan, the lord of bears, Hanuman fetched a hillock covered with celestial herbs; and inhaling the odour of those herbs, Shri Ram, Lakshman and all the monkeys regained their normal health

topics.hi: लङ्कापुरीका दहन तथा राक्षसों और वानरोंका भयंकर युद्ध
topics.en: Lanka is set fire to by the monkeys, on which a terrible conflict ensues between the ogres and the monkeys

topics.hi: अङ्गदके द्वारा कम्पन और प्रजङ्घका, द्विविदके द्वारा शोणिताक्षका, मैन्दके द्वारा यूपाक्षका और सुग्रीवके द्वारा कुम्भका वध
topics.en: Death of Kampana and Prajangha at the hands of Angad, of Shonitaksh at the hands of Dwivid, of Yupaksh at the hands of Mainda and of Kumbh at the hands of Sugriv

topics.hi: हनुमान्के द्वारा निकुम्भका वध
topics.en: Nikumbh’s death at the hands of Hanuman

topics.hi: रावणकी आज्ञासे मकराक्षका युद्धके लिये प्रस्थान
topics.en: Makaraksh sets out for an encounter under orders of Ravan

topics.hi: श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके द्वारा मकराक्षका वध
topics.en: Death of Makaraksh at the hands of Shri Ram

topics.hi: रावणकी आज्ञासे इन्द्रजित्का घोर युद्ध तथा उसके वधके विषयमें श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी बातचीत
topics.en: Indrajit puts up a formidable fight under orders of Ravan and Shri Ram and Lakshman discuss the ways and means of putting an end to him

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित्के द्वारा मायामयी सीताका वध
topics.en: Indrajit kills an illusory living image of Sita

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीके नेतृत्वमें वानरों और निशाचरोंका युद्ध, हनुमान्जीका श्रीरामके पास लौटना और इन्द्रजित्का निकुम्भिला-मन्दिरमें जाकर होम करना
topics.en: Led by Hanuman, the monkeys meet the ogres in an encounter; Hanuman returns to the presence of Shri Ram and Indrajit pours oblations into the sacred fire at the sanctuary of Nikumbhila

topics.hi: सीताके मारे जानेकी बात सुनकर श्रीरामका शोकसे मूर्च्छित होना और लक्ष्मणका उन्हें समझाते हुए पुरुषार्थके लिये उद्यत होना
topics.en: Shri Ram faints away on being told that Sita has been done to death. After consoling him, Lakshman prepares for action

topics.hi: विभीषणका श्रीरामको इन्द्रजित्की मायाका रहस्य बताकर सीताके जीवित होनेका विश्वास दिलाना और लक्ष्मणको सेनासहित निकुम्भिला-मन्दिरमें भेजनेके लिये अनुरोध करना
topics.en: Telling Shri Ram the secret of the conjuring trick practised by Indrajit, Vibhishan assures him of Sita being still alive and urges him to send Lakshman with an army to the sanctuary of Nikumbhila

topics.hi: विभीषणके अनुरोधसे श्रीरामचन्द्रजीका लक्ष्मणको इन्द्रजित्के वधके लिये जानेकी आज्ञा देना और सेनासहित लक्ष्मणका निकुम्भिला-मन्दिरके पास पहुँचना
topics.en: Importuned by Vibhishan, Shri Ram commands Lakshman to march against Indrajit to make short work of him, and Lakshman arrives with an army near the sanctuary of Nikumbhila

topics.hi: वानरों और राक्षसोंका युद्ध, हनुमान्जीके द्वारा राक्षससेनाका संहार और उनका इन्द्रजित्को द्वन्द्वयुद्धके लिये ललकारना तथा लक्ष्मणका उसे देखना
topics.en: In the course of an encounter of the monkeys with the ogres, Hanuman plays havoc among the hostile army and challenges Indrajit to a duel and Lakshman catches sight of the ogre

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित् और विभीषणकी रोषपूर्ण बातचीत
topics.en: Exchange of hot words between Indrajit and Vibhishan

topics.hi: लक्ष्मण और इन्द्रजित्की परस्पर रोषभरी बातचीत और घोर युद्ध
topics.en: Exchange of hot words between Lakshman and Indrajit, followed by a fierce fight

topics.hi: विभीषणका राक्षसोंपर प्रहार, उनका वानर-यूथपतियोंको प्रोत्साहन देना, लक्ष्मणद्वारा इन्द्रजित्के सारथिका और वानरोंद्वारा उसके घोड़ोंका वध
topics.en: Vibhishan takes the offensive against the ogres and encourages the commanders of monkey-troops to carry on the struggle. Lakshman kills the charioteer of Indrajit and the monkeys make short work of his horses

topics.hi: इन्द्रजित् और लक्ष्मणका भयंकर युद्ध तथा इन्द्रजित्का वध
topics.en: A fierce contest between Indrajit and Lakshman and Indrajit’s fall

topics.hi: लक्ष्मण और विभीषण आदिका श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके पास आकर इन्द्रजित्के वधका समाचार सुनाना, प्रसन्न हुए श्रीरामके द्वारा लक्ष्मणको हृदयसे लगाकर उनकी प्रशंसा तथा सुषेणद्वारा लक्ष्मण आदिकी चिकित्सा
topics.en: Lakshman, Vibhishan and others approach Shri Ram with the news of Indrajit’s fall. Delighted with the news, Shri Ram embraces Lakshman and applauds him and gets Lakshman and others treated by Sushen

topics.hi: रावणका शोक तथा सुपार्श्वके समझानेसे उसका सीता-वधसे निवृत्त होना
topics.en: Stricken with grief at the death of Indrajit, Ravan proceeds to kill Sita, who, he feels was the root of all trouble, but desists from this dastardly act at the intercession of Suparshva

topics.hi: श्रीरामद्वारा राक्षससेनाका संहार
topics.en: Destruction of ogre-troops at the hands of Shri Ram

topics.hi: राक्षसियोंका विलाप
topics.en: Lament of the ogresses

topics.hi: रावणका अपने मन्त्रियोंको बुलाकर शत्रुवधविषयक अपना उत्साह प्रकट करना और सबके साथ रणभूमिमें आकर पराक्रम दिखाना
topics.en: Ravan calls together his generals and, marching with them to the field of battle, exhibits his valour against the enemy

topics.hi: सुग्रीवद्वारा राक्षससेनाका संहार और विरूपाक्षका वध
topics.en: Destruction of the army of ogres at the hands of Sugriv and the fall of Virupaksh

topics.hi: सुग्रीवके साथ महोदरका घोर युद्ध तथा वध
topics.en: The fearful encounter of Mahodar with Sugriv and his fall at the latter’s hands

topics.hi: अंगदके द्वारा महापार्श्वका वध
topics.en: Fall of Mahaparshva at the hands of Angad

topics.hi: श्रीराम और रावणका युद्ध
topics.en: Shri Ram’s encounter with Ravan

topics.hi: राम और रावणका युद्ध, रावणकी शक्तिसे लक्ष्मणका मूर्च्छित होना तथा रावणका युद्धसे भागना
topics.en: Encounter of Shri Ram with Ravan; Lakshman swoons under a blow of Ravan’s javelin and Ravan flees away from the battlefield

topics.hi: श्रीरामका विलाप तथा हनुमान्जीकी लायी हुई ओषधिके सुषेणद्वारा किये गये प्रयोगसे लक्ष्मणका सचेत हो उठना
topics.en: Shri Ram laments over the precarious condition of Lakshman. The latter regains consciousness under the treatment of the monkey Sushen with the help of a herb brought at his instance all the way from the Himalaya mountain by Hanuman

topics.hi: इन्द्रके भेजे हुए रथपर बैठकर श्रीरामका रावणके साथ युद्ध करना
topics.en: Seated in a chariot sent by Indra (the ruler of gods), Shri Ram renews his combat with Ravan

topics.hi: श्रीरामका रावणको फटकारना और उनके द्वारा घायल किये गये रावणको सारथिका रणभूमिसे बाहर ले जाना
topics.en: Shri Ram upbraids Ravan, who, when wounded by the former is removed from the battlefield by his charioteer

topics.hi: रावणका सारथिको फटकारना और सारथिका अपने उत्तरसे रावणको संतुष्ट करके उसके रथको रणभूमिमें पहुँचाना
topics.en: Ravan reproaches the charioteer and the latter after satisfying his master with his reply drives his chariot back to the battlefield

topics.hi: अगस्त्य मुनिका श्रीरामको विजयके लिये ‘आदित्यहृदय’* के पाठकी सम्मति देना
topics.en: Sage Agastya advises Shri Ram to recite the ‘Aditya Hriday’, a collection of verses in praise of the sun-god, with a view to gaining victory

topics.hi: रावणके रथको देख श्रीरामका मातलिको सावधान करना, रावणकी पराजयके सूचक उत्पातों तथा रामकी विजय सूचित करनेवाले शुभ शकुनोंका वर्णन
topics.en: Catching sight of Ravan’s chariot, Shri Ram asks Matali to be on his guard. A description of portents prognosticating the fall of Ravan and good omens predicting the victory of Shri Ram

topics.hi: श्रीराम और रावणका घोर युद्ध
topics.en: Fierce encounter of Shri Ram with Ravan

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा रावणका वध
topics.en: Ravan’s death at Shri Ram’s hands

topics.hi: विभीषणका विलाप और श्रीरामका उन्हें समझाकर रावणके अन्त्येष्टि-संस्कारके लिये आदेश देना
topics.en: Vibhishan bursts into a lament and Shri Ram comforts him and asks him to perform the obsequies in relation to his deceased eldest brother

topics.hi: रावणकी स्त्रियोंका विलाप
topics.en: The lament of Ravan’s consorts

topics.hi: मन्दोदरीका विलाप तथा रावणके शवका दाहसंस्कार
topics.en: Mandodari’s lament and the funeral of Ravan

topics.hi: विभीषणका राज्याभिषेक और श्रीरघुनाथजीका हनुमान्जीके द्वारा सीताके पास संदेश भेजना
topics.en: Installation of Vibhishan on the throne of Lanka; Shri Ram sends his message to Sita through Hanuman

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका सीताजीसे बातचीत करके लौटना और उनका संदेश श्रीरामको सुनाना
topics.en: Hanuman delivers Shri Ram’s message to Sita and brings back her message to him

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे विभीषणका सीताको उनके समीप लाना और सीताका प्रियतमके मुखचन्द्रका दर्शन करना
topics.en: At the command of Shri Ram, Vibhishan escorts Sita to the former’s presence and she feasts her eyes on the moon-like countenance of her darling

topics.hi: सीताके चरित्रपर संदेह करके श्रीरामका उन्हें ग्रहण करनेसे इनकार करना और अन्यत्र जानेके लिये कहना
topics.en: Regarding with suspicion the character of Sita, Shri Ram repudiates her and asks her to seek shelter elsewhere

topics.hi: सीताका श्रीरामको उपालम्भपूर्ण उत्तर देकर अपने सतीत्वकी परीक्षा देनेके लिये अग्निमें प्रवेश करना
topics.en: With a taunting reply, Sita undergoes a fire-ordeal in order to prove her conjugal fidelity

topics.hi: भगवान् श्रीरामके पास देवताओंका आगमन तथा ब्रह्माद्वारा उनकी भगवत्ताका प्रतिपादन एवं स्तवन
topics.en: Gods seek the presence of Shri Ram, and Brahma (the creator) proclaims his divinity and extols him

topics.hi: मूर्तिमान् अग्निदेवका सीताको लेकर चितासे प्रकट होना और श्रीरामको समर्पित करके उनकी पवित्रताको प्रमाणित करना तथा श्रीरामका सीताको सहर्ष स्वीकार करना
topics.en: The god of fire emerges in person from the burning pyre with Sita and, restoring her to Shri Ram, testifies to her purity and the latter joyfully accept her

topics.hi: महादेवजीकी आज्ञासे श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका विमानद्वारा आये हुए राजा दशरथको प्रणाम करना और दशरथका दोनों पुत्रों तथा सीताको आवश्यक संदेश दे इन्द्रलोकको जाना
topics.en: As enjoined by Lord Shiv, Shri Ram and Lakshman pay their respects to the soul of Emperor Dashrath, who appears in an ethereal form, a replica of his extinct personality, and ascends once more to heaven after giving necessary instructions to his two former sons and daughter-in-law

topics.hi: श्रीरामके अनुरोधसे इन्द्रका मरे हुए वानरोंको जीवित करना, देवताओंका प्रस्थान और वानरसेनाका विश्राम
topics.en: At the instance of Shri Ram, Indra brings back to life all the monkeys who had lost their life in combat, the gods disperse and the simian army enjoy their well-earned rest

topics.hi: श्रीरामका अयोध्या जानेके लिये उद्यत होना और उनकी आज्ञासे विभीषणका पुष्पकविमानको मँगाना
topics.en: Shri Ram prepares to leave for Ayodhya and at his instance Vibhishan orders the presence of the aerial car, Pushpak, to take him to Ayodhya

topics.hi: श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे विभीषणद्वारा वानरोंका विशेष सत्कार तथा सुग्रीव और विभीषणसहित वानरोंको साथ लेकर श्रीरामका पुष्पकविमानद्वारा अयोध्याको प्रस्थान करना
topics.en: In obedience to the command of Shri Ram, Vibhishan heaps special honours on the monkeys and taking Sugriv, Vibhishan and other monkeys with them, Shri Ram, Sita and Lakshman start on their aerial journey by Pushpak

topics.hi: अयोध्याकी यात्रा करते समय श्रीरामका सीताजीको मार्गके स्थान दिखाना
topics.en: In the course of their flight to Ayodhya, Shri Ram shows to Sita the places over which they were flying

topics.hi: श्रीरामका भरद्वाज-आश्रमपर उतरकर महर्षिसे मिलना और उनसे वर पाना
topics.en: Landing the aerial car at the hermitage of Sage Bharadwaj, Shri Ram sees the great Rishi and receives boons from him

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका निषादराज गुह तथा भरतजीको श्रीरामके आगमनकी सूचना देना और प्रसन्न हुए भरतका उन्हें उपहार देनेकी घोषणा करना
topics.en: Preceding Shri Ram to Shringverpur and Nandigram, Hanuman apprises Guha and Bharat of Shri Ram’s impending return soon and Bharat offers him a number of valuable gifts in recompense for the delightful news

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीका भरतको श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीताके वनवाससम्बन्धी सारे वृत्तान्तोंको सुनाना
topics.en: Hanuman recounts to Bharat broad details relating to the sojourn of Shri Ram, Sita and Lakshman in the forest

topics.hi: अयोध्यामें श्रीरामके स्वागतकी तैयारी, भरतके साथ सबका श्रीरामकी अगवानीके लिये नन्दिग्राममें पहुँचना, श्रीरामका आगमन, भरत आदिके साथ उनका मिलाप तथा पुष्पकविमानको कुबेरके पास भेजना
topics.en: Arrangements for the reception of Shri Ram in Ayodhya; the departure of Bharat with all others for Nandigram to receive Shri Ram; Shri Ram’s meeting with Bharat and others and his sending back the aerial car, Pushpak, to Kuber, the ruler of Yakshas (a class of demigods), to whom it originally belonged

topics.hi: भरतका श्रीरामको राज्य लौटाना, श्रीरामकी नगरयात्रा, राज्याभिषेक, वानरोंकी विदाई तथा ग्रन्थका माहात्म्य
topics.en: Bharat renders back the kingdom of Ayodhya to Shri Ram, who drives in a procession to the city; his consecration on the throne of Ayodhya; His farewell to the monkeys and the glory of the epic

topics.hi: श्रीरामके दरबारमें महर्षियोंका आगमन, उनके साथ उनकी बातचीत तथा श्रीरामके प्रश्न
topics.en: Great seers meet Shri Ram in the audience hall, his conversation with them and the questions he addresses to them

topics.hi: महर्षि अगस्त्यके द्वारा पुलस्त्यके गुण और तपस्याका वर्णन तथा उनसे विश्रवा मुनिकी उत्पत्तिका कथन
topics.en: Agastya discourses on the good qualities and Tapas of Pulastya and the origin of Vishrava

topics.hi: विश्रवासे वैश्रवण (कुबेर) की उत्पत्ति, उनकी तपस्या, वरप्राप्ति तथा लङ्कामें निवास
topics.en: Vaishravan’s birth from the loins of Vishrava; his obtaining boons through Tapas and his residence in Lanka

topics.hi: राक्षसवंशका वर्णन—हेति, विद्युत्केश और सुकेशकी उत्पत्ति
topics.en: A description of the race of Rakshasas and the origin of Heti, Vidyutkesh and Sukesh

topics.hi: सुकेशके पुत्र माल्यवान्, सुमाली और मालीकी संतानोंका वर्णन
topics.en: Description of the descendants of Malyavan, Sumali and Mali, sons of Sukesh

topics.hi: देवताओंका भगवान् शङ्करकी सलाहसे राक्षसोंके वधके लिये भगवान् विष्णुकी शरणमें जाना और उनसे आश्वासन पाकर लौटना, राक्षसोंका देवताओंपर आक्रमण और भगवान् विष्णुका उनकी सहायताके लिये आना
topics.en: Under the advice of Lord Shiv, the gods seek the help of Shri Vishnu for the destruction of the Rakshasas; they return reassured; the Rakshasas usurp the region of the gods; the coming of Shri Vishnu to help the gods

topics.hi: भगवान् विष्णुद्वारा राक्षसोंका संहार और पलायन
topics.en: The destruction of the Rakshasas by Lord Vishnu; the survivors take to flight

topics.hi: माल्यवान्का युद्ध और पराजय तथा सुमाली आदि सब राक्षसोंका रसातलमें प्रवेश
topics.en: Malyavan’s fight and his defeat; retreat of Sumali and other Rakshasas into the nether world

topics.hi: रावण आदिका जन्म और उनका तपके लिये गोकर्ण-आश्रममें जाना
topics.en: The origin of Ravan and others, their stay in Gokarna to perform Tapas (askesis)

topics.hi: रावण आदिकी तपस्या और वर-प्राप्ति
topics.en: Ravan and his younger brothers perform Tapas and obtain boons

topics.hi: रावणका संदेश सुनकर पिताकी आज्ञासे कुबेरका लङ्काको छोड़कर कैलासपर जाना, लङ्कामें रावणका राज्याभिषेक तथा राक्षसोंका निवास
topics.en: Kuber listens to the ultimatum of Ravan, leaves Lanka at the command of his father and proceeds to Kailash to live there. The Rakshasas occupy Lanka and Ravan is installed as its ruler

topics.hi: शूर्पणखा तथा रावण आदि तीनों भाइयोंका विवाह और मेघनादका जन्म
topics.en: The marriage of Shurpanakha, of Ravan and his brothers and the birth of Meghnad

topics.hi: रावणद्वारा बनवाये गये शयनागारमें कुम्भकर्णका सोना, रावणका अत्याचार, कुबेरका दूत भेजकर उसे समझाना तथा कुपित हुए रावणका उस दूतको मार डालना
topics.en: Kumbhkaran goes to sleep in the mansion built at the command of Ravan; Ravan’s transgressions; Kuber sends a messenger to pull him up; the messenger is put to death by the enraged Ravan

topics.hi: मन्त्रियोंसहित रावणका यक्षोंपर आक्रमण और उनकी पराजय
topics.en: An attack by Ravan and his ministers on the Yakshas and the defeat (of the latter)

topics.hi: माणिभद्र तथा कुबेरकी पराजय और रावणद्वारा पुष्पकविमानका अपहरण
topics.en: Defeat of Manibhadra and Kuber; Ravan takes hold of the Pushpak

topics.hi: नन्दीश्वरका रावणको शाप, भगवान् शङ्करद्वारा रावणका मान-भङ्ग तथा उनसे चन्द्रहास नामक खड्गकी प्राप्ति
topics.en: Nandishwar curses Ravan; Lord Shankar curbs the pride of Ravan, who obtains a sword from Lord Shankar

topics.hi: रावणसे तिरस्कृत ब्रह्मर्षि कन्या वेदवतीका उसे शाप देकर अग्निमें प्रवेश करना और दूसरे जन्ममें सीताके रूपमें प्रादुर्भूत होना
topics.en: Vedavati, daughter of a Brahmarshi, insulted by Ravan, pronounces a curse on him and enters the fire. She appears as Sita in another birth

topics.hi: रावणद्वारा मरुत्तकी पराजय तथा इन्द्र आदि देवताओंका मयूर आदि पक्षियोंको वरदान देना
topics.en: Marutta’s discomfiture at the hands of Ravan; Indra and the other gods confer boons on the peacock and other birds

topics.hi: रावणके द्वारा अनरण्यका वध तथा उनके द्वारा उसे शापकी प्राप्ति
topics.en: Ravan kills Anaranya and receives a curse from him

topics.hi: नारदजीका रावणको समझाना, उनके कहनेसे रावणका युद्धके लिये यमलोकको जाना तथा नारदजीका इस युद्धके विषयमें विचार करना
topics.en: Ravan is pulled up by Narad; at his suggestion he seeks the abode of Yama for combat; Narad’s curiosity on that account

topics.hi: रावणका यमलोकपर आक्रमण और उसके द्वारा यमराजके सैनिकोंका संहार
topics.en: Ravan invades the domain of Yama and destroys the forces of Yama

topics.hi: यमराज और रावणका युद्ध, यमका रावणके वधके लिये उठाये हुए कालदण्डको ब्रह्माजीके कहनेसे लौटा लेना, विजयी रावणका यमलोकसे प्रस्थान
topics.en: Duel between Yama and Ravan; Yama holds back, at the intervention of Brahma, his rod of destruction which was raised to make short work of Ravan; the triumphant Ravan leaves the domain of Yama

topics.hi: रावणके द्वारा निवातकवचोंसे मैत्री, कालकेयोंका वध तथा वरुणपुत्रोंकी पराजय
topics.en: Ravan makes friends with the Nivatakavachas, kills the Kalakeyas and vanquishes the sons of Varun

topics.hi: रावणद्वारा अपहृत हुई देवता आदिकी कन्याओं और स्त्रियोंका विलाप एवं शाप, रावणका रोती हुई शूर्पणखाको आश्वासन देना और उसे खरके साथ दण्डकारण्यमें भेजना
topics.en: Lament of the celestial damsels and other ladies forcibly carried off by Ravan and the curse pronounced by them; Ravan consoles his wailing sister, Shurpanakha and sends her to the Dandak forest with Khar

topics.hi: यज्ञोंद्वारा मेघनादकी सफलता, विभीषणका रावणको पर-स्त्री-हरणके दोष बताना, कुम्भीनसीको आश्वासन दे मधुको साथ ले रावणका देवलोकपर आक्रमण करना
topics.en: Meghnad attains success through sacrifices; Vibhishan describes to Ravan the evil consequences of bearing away others’ wives; after consoling Kumbhinasi, Ravan, accompanied by Madhu, invades the realm of the gods

topics.hi: रावणका रम्भापर बलात्कार करना और नलकूबरका रावणको भयंकर शाप देना
topics.en: Ravan violates the celestial nymph Rambha and receives a terrible curse from Nalakubar

topics.hi: सेनासहित रावणका इन्द्रलोकपर आक्रमण, इन्द्रकी भगवान् विष्णुसे सहायताके लिये प्रार्थना, भविष्यमें रावण-वधकी प्रतिज्ञा करके विष्णुका इन्द्रको लौटाना, देवताओं और राक्षसोंका युद्ध तथा वसुके द्वारा सुमालीका वध
topics.en: Ravan, accompanied by his army, invades the realm of Indra; Indra invokes the help of Lord Vishnu; Vishnu dismisses Indra with a vow to kill Ravan; encounter of the ogres with the gods; Sumali is killed by Vasu

topics.hi: मेघनाद और जयन्तका युद्ध, पुलोमाका जयन्तको अन्यत्र ले जाना, देवराज इन्द्रका युद्धभूमिमें पदार्पण, रुद्रों तथा मरुद्गणोंद्वारा राक्षससेनाका संहार और इन्द्र तथा रावणका युद्ध
topics.en: A duel between Meghnad and Jayant (Indra’s son); Jayant is removed to another place by Puloma (his maternal grandfather); the appearance of Indra (the ruler of gods) on the field of battle; the destruction of the Rakshasa army by the Rudras and the wind-gods; a duel between Indra and Ravan

topics.hi: रावणका देवसेनाके बीचसे होकर निकलना, देवताओंका उसे कैद करनेके लिये प्रयत्न, मेघनादका मायाद्वारा इन्द्रको बन्दी बनाना तथा विजयी होकर सेनासहित लङ्काको लौटना
topics.en: Ravan carves his way through the army of the gods; the gods try to capture him; Meghnad captures Indra by employing conjuring tricks and coming out victorious returns to Lanka with his army

topics.hi: ब्रह्माजीका इन्द्रजित्को वरदान देकर इन्द्रको उसकी कैदसे छुड़ाना और उनके पूर्वकृत पापकर्मको याद दिलाकर उनसे वैष्णव-यज्ञका अनुष्ठान करनेके लिये कहना, उस यज्ञको पूर्ण करके इन्द्रका स्वर्गलोकमें जाना
topics.en: Brahma grants boons to Indrajit and prevails on him to release Indra from captivity; nay, reminding the latter of his past sin, Brahma asks him to perform a sacrifice to propitiate Lord Vishnu; at the conclusion of the said sacrifice Indra returns to heaven

topics.hi: रावणका माहिष्मतीपुरीमें जाना और वहाँके राजा अर्जुनको न पाकर मन्त्रियोंसहित उसका विन्ध्यगिरिके समीप नर्मदामें नहाकर भगवान् शिवकी आराधना करना
topics.en: Ravan goes to Mahishmati; unable to find its ruler, Arjun, he takes a dip in the holy Narmada and offers worship to Lord Shiv

topics.hi: अर्जुनकी भुजाओंसे नर्मदाके प्रवाहका अवरुद्ध होना, रावणके पुष्पोपहारका बह जाना, फिर रावण आदि निशाचरोंका अर्जुनके साथ युद्ध तथा अर्जुनका रावणको कैद करके अपने नगरमें ले जाना
topics.en: The flow of the Narmada gets intercepted by the arms of Arjun; the heap of flowers collected for Ravan’s worship of Lord Shiv is swept away by the reversed current; the encounter of Ravan and the other ogres with Arjun; Arjun captures Ravan and bears him away to his city

topics.hi: पुलस्त्यजीका रावणको अर्जुनकी कैदसे छुटकारा दिलाना
topics.en: Pulastya secures the deliverance of Ravan from the bondage of Arjun

topics.hi: वालीके द्वारा रावणका पराभव तथा रावणका उन्हें अपना मित्र बनाना
topics.en: Ravan’s humiliation at the hands of Vali; Ravan makes friends with him

topics.hi: हनुमान्जीकी उत्पत्ति, शैशवावस्थामें इनका सूर्य, राहु और ऐरावतपर आक्रमण, इन्द्रके वज्रसे इनकी मूर्च्छा, वायुके कोपसे संसारके प्राणियोंको कष्ट और उन्हें प्रसन्न करनेके लिये देवताओंसहित ब्रह्माजीका उनके पास जाना
topics.en: The descent of Hanuman; he rushes against the sun, the planet Rahu and Airavat (the mount of Indra) even as an infant; he is rendered unconscious as the result of a stroke of lightning by Indra; the entire creation gets suffocated due to the displeasure of the wind-god; the gods under the leadership of Brahma seek the presence of the wind-god to pacify him

topics.hi: ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओंका हनुमान्जीको जीवित करके नाना प्रकारके वरदान देना और वायुका उन्हें लेकर अञ्जनाके घर जाना, ऋषियोंके शापसे हनुमान्जीको अपने बलकी विस्मृति, श्रीरामका अगस्त्य आदि ऋषियोंसे अपने यज्ञमें पधारनेके लिये प्रस्ताव करके उन्हें विदा देना
topics.en: After bringing Hanuman back to life, Brahma and other gods grant boons of various kinds in his favour. The wind-god takes him to Anjana. Due to a curse pronounced on him by some Rishis, Hanuman remains unconscious of his might. Shri Ram permits Agastya and other sages to depart after requesting them to be present at the sacrifice to be performed by Him

topics.hi: श्रीरामका सभासदोंके साथ राजसभामें बैठना
topics.en: Shri Ram sits in court with His courtiers

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारा राजा जनक, युधाजित्, प्रतर्दन तथा अन्य नरेशोंकी विदाई
topics.en: Shri Ram grants leave to Kings—Janak, Yudhajit, Pratardan and others to proceed to their respective dominions

topics.hi: राजाओंका श्रीरामके लिये भेंट देना और श्रीरामका वह सब लेकर अपने मित्रों, वानरों, रीछों और राक्षसोंको बाँट देना तथा वानर आदिका वहाँ सुखपूर्वक रहना
topics.en: The princes send presents to Shri Ram, who after accepting them distributes them to His friends, the monkeys, the bears and the ogres; and they all sojourn happily with Him

topics.hi: वानरों, रीछों और राक्षसोंकी बिदाई
topics.en: Shri Ram sends back the monkeys, the bears and ogres to their respective abodes

topics.hi: कुबेरके भेजे हुए पुष्पकविमानका आना और श्रीरामसे पूजित एवं अनुगृहीत होकर अदृश्य हो जाना, भरतके द्वारा श्रीरामराज्यके विलक्षण प्रभावका वर्णन
topics.en: The arrival in Ayodhya of the aerial car Pushpak sent by Kuber; its disappearance after receiving honours and blessings from Shri Ram; Bharat’s description of the unique glory of Shri Ram’s rule

topics.hi: अशोकवनिकामें श्रीराम और सीताका विहार, गर्भिणी सीताका तपोवन देखनेकी इच्छा प्रकट करना और श्रीरामका इसके लिये स्वीकृति देना
topics.en: Recreation of Shri Ram and Shri Sita in the Ashok grove; the enceinte Shri Sita expresses her desire to visit penance-groves and Shri Ram accords His consent

topics.hi: भद्रका पुरवासियोंके मुखसे सीताके विषयमें सुनी हुई अशुभ चर्चासे श्रीरामको अवगत कराना
topics.en: Bhadra apprises Shri Ram of the ugly remarks made by the citizens about Shri Sita

topics.hi: श्रीरामके बुलानेसे सब भाइयोंका उनके पास आना
topics.en: On being sent for by Him all the brothers present themselves before Shri Ram

topics.hi: श्रीरामका भाइयोंके समक्ष सर्वत्र फैले हुए लोकापवादकी चर्चा करके सीताको वनमें छोड़ आनेके लिये लक्ष्मणको आदेश देना
topics.en: Annoyed with the ill-report about Sita, Shri Ram orders Lakshman to take Sita away in the forest and leave her in the vicinity of Valmiki Ashram

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका सीताको रथपर बिठाकर उन्हें वनमें छोड़नेके लिये ले जाना और गङ्गाजीके तटपर पहुँचना
topics.en: Lakshman proceeds to the forest, alongwith Sita in order to leave her in the vicinity of Valmiki’s Ashram and reaches on the bank of Ganga

topics.hi: लक्ष्मणका सीताजीको नावसे गङ्गाजीके उस पार पहुँचाकर बड़े दु:खसे उन्हें उनके त्यागे जानेकी बात बताना
topics.en: Carrying Sita across the Ganga, Lakshman laments agony and talks with a heavy heart thinking of her future

topics.hi: सीताका दु:खपूर्ण वचन, श्रीरामके लिये उनका संदेश, लक्ष्मणका जाना और सीताका रोना
topics.en: Sita’s plaintive utterance, Her message to Shri Ram, Lakshman’s departure and the wail of Sita

topics.hi: मुनिकुमारोंसे समाचार पाकर वाल्मीकिका सीताके पास आ उन्हें सान्त्वना देना और आश्रममें लिवा ले जाना
topics.en: Hearing Sita’s crying, from young ascetics sage Valmiki approaches her and carries her to his hermitage

topics.hi: लक्ष्मण और सुमन्त्रकी बातचीत
topics.en: Dialogue between Lakshman and Sumantra

topics.hi: मार्गमें सुमन्त्रका दुर्वासाके मुखसे सुनी हुई भृगुऋषिके शापकी कथा कहकर तथा भविष्यमें होनेवाली कुछ बातें बताकर दु:खी लक्ष्मणको शान्त करना
topics.en: On his way to Ayodhya Sumantra narrates the account of Bhrigu’s curse which he heard from Durvasa and tells Lakshman some future events to console him

topics.hi: अयोध्याके राजभवनमें पहुँचकर लक्ष्मणका दु:खी श्रीरामसे मिलना और उन्हें सान्त्वना देना
topics.en: Lakshman meets Shri Ram in the Royal chamber and comforts Him

topics.hi: श्रीरामका कार्यार्थी पुरुषोंकी उपेक्षासे राजा नृगको मिलनेवाली शापकी कथा सुनाकर लक्ष्मणको देखभालके लिये आदेश देना
topics.en: Shri Ram narrates the story of king Nrig, who was cursed for not attending to his subjects, and instructs Lakshman, to perform obligatory duties towards citizens

topics.hi: राजा नृगका एक सुन्दर गड्ढा बनवाकर अपने पुत्रको राज्य दे स्वयं उसमें प्रवेश करके शाप भोगना
topics.en: King Nrig gets a cosy pit prepared for himself, entrusts the kingdom to his son and enters the pit and suffers the consequences of curse

topics.hi: राजा निमि और वसिष्ठका एक-दूसरेके शापसे देहत्याग
topics.en: King Nimi and sage Vashishtha leave their bodies as a result of mutual curse

topics.hi: ब्रह्माजीके कहनेसे वसिष्ठका वरुणके वीर्यमें आवेश, वरुणका उर्वशीके समीप एक कुम्भमें अपने वीर्यका आधान तथा मित्रके शापसे उर्वशीका भूतलमें राजा पुरूरवाके पास रहकर पुत्र उत्पन्न करना
topics.en: At the instance of Brahma Vashishtha enters the semen of Varun; Varun places his semen in a pitcher near Urvashi; as a consequence of Mitra’s curse Urvashi lives with king Pururava on the earth and bears him a son

topics.hi: वसिष्ठका नूतन शरीर-धारण और निमिका प्राणियोंके नयनोंमें निवास
topics.en: Sage Vashishtha is re-incarnated and king Nimi resides in the eye-lids of living beings

topics.hi: ययातिको शुक्राचार्यका शाप
topics.en: Shukracharya curses king Yayati

topics.hi: ययातिका अपने पुत्र पूरुको अपना बुढ़ापा देकर बदलेमें उसका यौवन लेना और भोगोंसे तृप्त होकर पुन: दीर्घकालके बाद उसे उसका यौवन लौटा देना, पूरुका अपने पिताकी गद्दीपर अभिषेक तथा यदुको शाप
topics.en: King Yayati borrows youth from his son Puru, in exchange for his own old age. Satisfied after a long time with the enjoyment of the objects of pleasure, he returns his youth to Puru and consecrates him king and pronounces curse on Yadu

topics.hi: श्रीरामके द्वारपर कार्यार्थी कुत्तेका आगमन और श्रीरामका उसे दरबारमें लानेका आदेश
topics.en: A dog arrives at the Royal palace-gate with a request, Shri Ram orders for ushering

topics.hi: कुत्तेके प्रति श्रीरामका न्याय, उसकी इच्छाके अनुसार उसे मारनेवाले ब्राह्मणको मठाधीश बना देना और कुत्तेका मठाधीश होनेका दोष बताना
